Opposition MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports on the Dutch economic contraction and German recession, their causes, competitiveness impact, sectoral outlook and employment. The minister answered that the Dutch downturn is mild and largely temporary, that trade diversification and innovation policy are being pursued, and that the German economy faces more structural problems.
Despite two quarters of economic contraction, the CPB still expects annual economic growth of 0.7%.
Ondanks de twee kwartalen van economische krimp verwacht het CPB nog steeds economische groei op jaarbasis van 0,7%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Minister gooit satellietbedrijf Inmarsat van 5G-frequentie'

MPs Amhaouch and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked why Inmarsat cannot get a longer licence in Greece, whether its demand for ten years of certainty is proportionate, and about the 3.5 GHz auction timing. The minister replied that Greece can grant only 5-year licences with a renewal already provided for, that no compensation has been agreed, and that the auction will move to 2024 depending on a pending court case.
However, I do not control whether interested parties initiate legal proceedings against the decisions I take.
Ik heb daarbij echter niet in de hand dat belanghebbende partijen juridische procedures aanspannen tegen de besluiten die ik neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Niet-afgedekt renterisico maakt private equity opeens kwetsbaar'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether unhedged interest rate risk threatens private equity funds and their portfolio companies, and what regulation or monitoring is needed. The minister answered that PE funds and portfolio firms are responsible for hedging their own rate risk, that additional rules are not currently warranted, and that DNB and the AFM will discuss the economic impact with the minister.
I will discuss the possible impact on the Dutch economy of interest rate rises for PE funds and their companies with DNB and the AFM.
Ik zal de mogelijke impact op de Nederlandse economie als gevolg van rentestijgingen voor PE-fondsen en hun bedrijven bespreken met DNB en de AFM.
Antwoord op ragen van Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht Koester familiebedrijven, ze dragen de economie

MPs Inge van Dijk, Palland and Amhaouch asked whether family businesses deserve protection and whether the planned tightening of the business succession exemption (BOR) risks harming them, citing commentary by Maarten de Groot. The State Secretary agreed family firms add substantial economic value and should be supported, but rejected claims that the BOR changes would threaten them, citing a CPB evaluation, and promised to report after a pending study requested by a motion.
The cabinet does not expect that the announced adjustments to the BOR will lead to this.
Het kabinet verwacht niet dat de aangekondigde aanpassingen in de BOR hier toe zullen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Den Haag verwaarloost innovatief mkb in de regio'

MPs Romke de Jong and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report claiming The Hague neglects innovative SMEs in the regions, and whether regional development companies (ROMs) should play a bigger role and receive more funding. The minister acknowledges the potential, describes existing instruments and ROM funding, denies that ROMs received disproportionately little, and says a multi-year plan for the ROMs is being prepared with provinces, to be reported by end of Q4.
A multi-year plan for the ROMs is currently being prepared, precisely to examine where they can be structurally deployed and how the supra-regional system can be better used.
Op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan een meerjarenplan voor de ROM’s, juist om te kijken waar zij structureel ingezet kunnen worden en het bovenregionale stelsel beter benut kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘VDL Nedcar kondigt massaontslag aan: helft personeel eruit’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about VDL Nedcar's announced mass dismissals, the consequences for regional employment and suppliers, and the extent of central government involvement in finding new clients. The minister answered that the government is closely involved and supportive, but withheld specific details of contacts with individual companies citing confidentiality and ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet is generally reticent about giving specific information on contacts with individual companies, because of the usually confidential nature of those contacts.
Het kabinet is over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van specifieke informatie over contacten met individuele bedrijven, omwille van het doorgaans vertrouwelijke karakter van die contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Belasting betalen over geld dat je nooit hebt verdiend: box 3 'desastreus' voor start-ups'

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance how the planned box 3 reform, taxing actual returns through an unrealised-gains (vermogensaanwas) tax, would affect startup employees and angel investors, and how this squares with the stock-option rules. The State Secretary acknowledges the concerns, notes the liquidity problem and that the final design, including a possible realisation-based alternative, is not yet decided, and promises to take the signals into account and consider mitigating measures.
Measures to mitigate the identified liquidity problem are currently being examined.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht welke maatregelen getroffen kunnen worden om het gesignaleerde liquiditeitsprobleem te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ministerie plant eindtoets basisscholen tijdens carnaval en suggereert: verplaats carnaval maar’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether the 2024 end-of-primary test (doorstroomtoets) clashes with carnival and whether the ministry suggested carnival be moved. The minister says the test window is set by law at the first two full weeks of February, that schools can schedule around carnival, and withdraws the ill-chosen wording suggesting carnival be moved, while stating no change to the test window is planned for now.
In answering a citizen's question there was an unfortunate choice of words, which I hereby withdraw.
Bij het beantwoorden van een burgervraag is sprake geweest van een ongelukkige woordkeuze, die ik hierbij wil terugnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Trek stikstofdossier los door specifieke Nederlandse regels terug te draaien' van VNO-NCW

MPs Boswijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers about VNO-NCW's proposals to loosen nitrogen permitting rules (AERIUS link, a 0.5 mol/ha/yr threshold, a national nitrogen bank, ending the intern salderen bill). The minister responded point by point, defending the current legal framework, stating a threshold is not yet ecologically feasible, and promising further dialogue and a study of alternatives to the KDW, but declined to give a project count for the threshold scenario.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Amhaouch over de berichten 'Wat moet je met dassen onder het spoor? 'Uitgraven en weghalen'' en het bericht 'Dassen verlammen Brabants treinverkeer nog zeker drie weken'

CDA MPs Krul and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about news reports on badger burrows disrupting rail traffic between Den Bosch and Boxtel, and asked whether ProRail should get a generic exemption to remove badger setts and whether burrow removal should be the policy. The State Secretary answered that ProRail needs a per-location exemption from the competent authority (RVO), that a generic exemption and an evaluation with the ministries are being explored, and that ProRail now has a code of conduct for monitoring and early action.
Following the problems in Molkwerum and Esch, the Ministry of IenW, ProRail, the Ministry of LNV and RVO will evaluate how it came to the point that no trains could run.

Het Ministerie van IenW, ProRail, het Ministerie van LNV en RVO gaan naar aanleiding van de problemen in Molkwerum en Esch evalueren hoe het zo ver heeft kunnen komen dat er geen treinen meer konden rijden.
Antwoorden op vragen die de leden Krul en Amhaouch over het helpen van ons MKB bij de omschakeling naar onderhoudsprojecten.

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government will halt road and rail construction due to nitrogen, inflation and labour shortages, and what this means for infrastructure SMEs and public transport and road safety. The minister confirmed a shift from new construction to maintenance on the national road and waterway networks, said affected projects are not yet identified, and promised updates before the July MIRT debate.
Since it is currently not known which projects are involved, it is also not possible at this time to reflect on the impact per project.
Gezien het momenteel niet bekend is om welke projecten het gaat, is het op dit moment ook niet mogelijk te reflecteren op de impact per project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Den Haag schiet tekort voor het Limburgs’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior about a report that the Dutch government pays too little attention to the Limburgish dialect, and about calls for legal language rights and wider use in education and media. The minister replied that Limburgish is recognised under the European Charter, that the province of Limburg leads language policy under a 2019 covenant, and that the covenant is being evaluated with results expected in autumn.
At present the Covenant on the Dutch recognition of the Limburgish language is being jointly evaluated by the Ministry of BZK and the Province of Limburg.
Op dit moment wordt het Convenant inzake de Nederlandse erkenning van de Limburgse taal door het Ministerie van BZK en de Provincie Limburg gezamenlijk geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het krantenartikel ‘US touts Biden green subsidies to lure clean tech from Europe’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether US states are luring European clean-tech firms with Inflation Reduction Act subsidies and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister reports no observed increase in US recruitment in the Netherlands, acknowledges a risk to investment and the investment climate, and points to Dutch and EU instruments in response.
That is why last October I sent my strategic agenda for the business climate to the House of Representatives.
Ik heb daarom afgelopen oktober mijn strategische agenda Ondernemingsklimaat aan de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Stoffer over het bericht 'Scheepsbouwer IHC zet kroonjuweel in etalage'

MPs Amhaouch and Stoffer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that IHC was offering its profitable subsidiary IQIP for sale, its effect on maritime capabilities, state exposure and financial risk, and whether the Netherlands can keep the knowledge and the shipyard. The minister answered that the state has some influence over the IQIP sale through the 2020 rescue terms but withheld details as confidential, declined to assess the company's viability, gave outstanding exposure figures, and promised a maritime sector agenda by summer.

The State is not a shareholder in IHC. In the 2020 rescue operation the State did secure influence over the sale of IQIP. How far this influence extends is commercially confidential information and is therefore not shared.

De Staat is geen aandeelhouder in IHC. Bij de steunoperatie in 2020 heeft de Staat wel invloed bedongen op de verkoop van IQIP. Hoe ver deze invloed reikt, betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die derhalve niet gedeeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Terwijl Amerikanen zwaar materieel aanvoeren voor de oorlog, verkopen EU-staten havens aan China'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about Chinese stakes in European ports, including Dutch ports, and what the Netherlands and EU should do to protect strategic interests. The minister answered that no full overview of Chinese stakes exists, that Dutch port authorities remain publicly owned, that Chinese firms are strongly present in container logistics, and that the government will raise the issue with the Commission, Germany, France and Belgium and push for a joint European approach.
The cabinet does not keep track of this per port.
Het kabinet houdt dit niet per haven bij.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bontenbal over de berichten 'Steeds meer productie wordt stilgelegd vanwege de hoge energieprijs' en 'De Croo: 'We dreigen in oorlogseconomie te belanden als EU niet ingrijpt''

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that production is being halted due to high energy prices and about the risk of a war economy. The minister answered that some firms have curtailed output, that industrial production has so far held up overall, and that targeted support (TEK scheme, Dutch price cap, EU temporary crisis framework) and a letter on energy-intensive industry are in preparation.
As announced in the Business Policy committee debate of 19 October, I will therefore send Parliament a letter before the end of the year on energy-intensive industry addressing the current situation.

Ik zal zoals aangekondigd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfslevenbeleid van 19 oktober, daarom voor het einde van het jaar een brief aan uw Kamer sturen over de energie-intensieve industrie waarin op de huidige situatie zal worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over Albanië wil ‘gouden paspoorten’ verkopen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Albania's plan to sell 'golden passports' and the risks this poses for EU accession and sanctions evasion. The minister agreed with the Commission that such schemes create security and corruption risks, said the Netherlands opposes them within the EU and bilaterally, and noted the issue will be raised with Albania and in Brussels where appropriate.
The cabinet has no insight into how many passports are issued through such schemes within EU member states.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op hoeveel paspoorten via dergelijke regelingen verstrekt worden binnen EU-lidstaten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de Kamerbrief Beleidsinstrumentarium ten behoeve van de borging van het vestigings- en investeringsklimaat, maatschappelijke langetermijnwaardecreatie en nat

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government views the practical difficulties of applying their adopted amendment bringing campus operators under the investment screening law, and whether it will be implemented. The minister answered that an external study by Birch Consultants and HCSS, started 25 July 2022, will define which firms qualify as campus operators, and that the government intends to implement the amendment depending on the study's findings.
The research assignment shows that I am working on implementing the amendment.
Uit de opdracht tot onderzoek blijkt dat ik werk maak van de uitvoering van het amendement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het artikel 'Knip open voor Europese chips'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the prospects for Dutch semiconductor firms, the Chips Act, a possible state contribution to a European chip plant, and IPCEI funding. The minister answered that the government stays in contact with industry but does not discuss individual firms, gave no hard forecasts, described the Chips Act alignment and IPCEI status, and withheld details on subsidies citing confidentiality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht "Rechter steunt grensondernemers over Tozo"

MPs Palland and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that cross-border entrepreneurs may be entitled to the Tozo support scheme, asking about the consequences, number of affected people, contact with neighbouring countries, and the status of earlier motions. The minister answered that officials are studying the ruling, the municipality of Maastricht intends to appeal, and no substantive answers on the scope, implications or motions can be given until legal proceedings are complete.
For this reason I cannot yet respond substantively to your questions concerning the municipality's operational framework.
Daarom kan ik op dit moment nog niet inhoudelijk ingaan op uw vragen met betrekking tot het handelingskader van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Project Panda: hoe 'kroonjuweel' High Tech Campus toch in buitenlandse handen kwam'

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why the government did not prevent the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to foreign owners, whether a state stake or Dutch counteroffer was considered, and how campuses can be protected from unwanted takeovers. The minister replied that the ministry checked for national security risks, found none, saw no reason to intervene in a market transaction, rejected a state stake, and judged the investment screening law disproportionate for property deals, pointing to other instruments.
Under the motion by Amhaouch and Inge van Dijk, I am exploring the desirability and feasibility of applying the investment screening bill to real estate transactions involving high-tech campuses.

In het kader van de motie-Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk verken ik de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheid van toepassing van het wetsvoorstel Veiligheidstoets investeringen, fusies en overnames op vastgoedtransacties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht dat bewoners van de nieuwbouw rond de Roermondse Roertunnel hinder ondervinden van laagfrequent geluid

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about low-frequency noise and vibration affecting new housing near the Roermond Roertunnel, including the Movares findings, the state's responsibility, possible fixes, the 2023 maintenance, communication with local authorities, health effects and the absence of legal noise standards. The minister confirmed the Movares study indicates 129 addresses may be affected, that Rijkswaterstaat and Roermond are jointly investigating, listed possible measures needing further study, and stated no legal standard for low-frequency noise currently exists.

Rijkswaterstaat is therefore jointly investigating with the municipality of Roermond, in the interest of residents' quality of life, the cause of this nuisance to see which possible solutions could be implemented.

Rijkswaterstaat onderzoekt daarom samen met de gemeente Roermond – in het belang van de leefkwaliteit van bewoners – de oorzaak van deze hinder, om te bezien welke mogelijke oplossingen getroffen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese douanescanners Schiphol en Rotterdamse haven onder vuur: 'Dit is onbegrijpelijk''

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that Chinese-owned Nuctech scanners are used by Dutch customs and whether Nuctech's ties to the Chinese state, low bids and security risks were properly assessed. The government answered that it weighs national security risks case by case, found no abnormally low bids, cannot guarantee that the Chinese state has no access to the scanners, and is conducting follow-up security research.
The cabinet cannot give any guarantees about this.
Het kabinet kan hier geen garanties over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen over fors hogere elektriciteits- en gasprijzen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Climate and Energy whether the government's figures on Dutch gas storage fill levels were too optimistic, whether the storage was sufficiently full to secure supply to protected customers in a cold winter, and whether the government should call on consumers to reduce gas use earlier. The minister acknowledged that the earlier figures mixed Dutch storage with cross-border German storage, referred to the Norg Agreement for protected customers, and explained the three crisis levels of the Protection and Recovery Plan, noting that no member state had declared a crisis level.

The presented 45% was the fill level at the beginning of the second week of December of the Dutch high-calorific gas storages combined with the fill level of storages just across the German border that are directly accessible from the Netherlands.

De gepresenteerde 45% was de vulgraad aan het begin van de tweede week van december van de Nederlandse opslagen voor hoogcalorisch gas gecombineerd met de vulgraad net over de grens met Duitsland gelegen opslagen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rutte gaat in gesprek met bedrijfsleven over toenemende 'ellende''

CDA MPs asked the government about reports that Prime Minister Rutte would talk with business about rising hardship, debt built up during COVID, the hardship-fund and TVL/NOW subsidy gaps, bank refinancing costs, retail support and Bbz/TONK uptake. The ministers answered that talks with business continue, that a broad set of debt-relief tools exists, that subsidy rules cannot easily cover edge cases without slowing payments, and that some follow-up letters and reviews will come.
The cabinet realises that the current support package does not fit every individual situation, and that feels uncomfortable.
Het kabinet beseft dat het huidige steunpakket niet op iedere individuele situatie aansluit, en dat voelt ongemakkelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Familiebedrijf Balk Shipyard in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the reported takeover of family shipyard Balk Shipyard by a Chinese investment group, including fit with industrial policy, financing instruments, screening under the investment screening law, and whether the firm will stay on Urk. The minister answered that the takeover is welcomed for enabling growth, that no screening obligation appears to apply, and that no reason exists to expect the firm to leave, while giving only generic information about the investor and no commitments on local agreements.
The cabinet does not collect information on business locations, corporate or ownership structures of companies unless required by laws and regulations.
Het kabinet verzamelt geen informatie over vestigingslocaties, bedrijfs- en/of eigendomsstructuren van bedrijven zolang dit niet is vereist voor wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Boris Johnson wil VDL Nedcar aftroeven: Britse premier zet zich persoonlijk in voor komst Rivian naar Engeland'

CDA MP Amhaouch asked whether the Dutch government is actively working to attract Rivian's European plant to VDL Nedcar in Born, including whether the Prime Minister is personally involved, and how it responds to Johnson's competing offer. The minister confirms active support via NFIA and ongoing contact, but declines to disclose the stage of decision-making, contacts with prospective clients, or the content of Johnson's offer citing confidentiality.
Because of commercial confidentiality and because premature disclosure could harm the process, the cabinet is generally reticent about giving information on developments in current corporate cases.

Omwille van de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid en omdat voortijdige mededelingen het proces kunnen schaden is het kabinet over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van informatie over ontwikkelingen rond actuele bedrijfscasussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het beschermen van kleine ondernemers bij zakelijke financiering

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether small business borrowers, who resemble consumers, should be protected in non-bank business lending, given the AFM's finding that the sector lacks effective self-regulation and that the AFM has no supervisory mandate there. The minister acknowledges the vulnerability, is studying whether legal protection is needed, and will reassess self-regulation by mid-2022 before considering legislation.
I am currently examining whether it is necessary and desirable that entrepreneurs also be protected by law.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment of het noodzakelijk en wenselijk is dat ook ondernemers bij wet worden beschermd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht dat European Sleeper de dienstregeling van de nieuwe nachttrein tussen Brussel, Rotterdam, Amsterdam, Berlijn en Praag heeft bekendgemaakt

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked about the European Sleeper night train timetable, why it stops only in the Randstad and not in regional stations like Hengelo, the government's involvement or subsidies, and the role of regional stations and capacity. The Staatssecretaris answered that the operator decides its stops, no subsidy goes to European Sleeper, other international trains do stop in regional stations, and capacity has been allocated without major problems.
Developing the timetable is in principle the responsibility of the operator itself, including the choice of a particular stopping pattern.
Het ontwikkelen van de dienstregeling is in beginsel de verantwoordelijkheid van de vervoerder zelf, inclusief de keuze voor een bepaald stoppatroon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over mogelijke impact van Europese ESG-standaarden op de defensie- en veiligheidssector

CDA MPs asked the government about the EU EcoLabel draft criteria for financial products, which would exclude firms earning over 5% of revenue from conventional weapons or military products used in combat, and how this affects Dutch defence firms' access to financial services. The state secretary said the criteria are voluntary for banks, that the government will raise the risk of blanket sector exclusion within the EU and talk with the defence sector and the banking association, but gave no commitment to change the criteria.
The current revenue share from trade or production of weapons and/or military products for combat of individual Dutch companies is not known.
Het huidige omzetaandeel van de handel of productie van wapens en/of militaire producten voor « combat » van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het vernietigen van interne correspondentie door de Europese commissie

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the European Commission destroys internal correspondence, contrary to EU rules, and how this affects access to documents and scrutiny. The government answered that it is not for the Dutch cabinet to judge Commission compliance, pointed to the EU Ombudsman, the General Court and the European Parliament, and said it generally pushes for transparency and will continue to do so in EU fora.
It is not for the cabinet to pronounce on whether the European Commission has acted in breach of its own EU rules.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te treden in de vraag of de Europese Commissie in strijd heeft gehandeld met eigen EU-regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Van Oord bestelt megaschip voor bouw windmolens'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Van Oord ordered a green mega-ship for wind farm construction from China rather than Dutch or EU yards, and whether public money, reshoring and strategic autonomy are affected. The minister answered that the company chose on its own commercial grounds, that the state provides no financing, and that industrial policy and innovation subsidies aim to keep knowledge and value in the Netherlands, while declining to go into company motives.
It is not for me to go into the specific reasons and motives behind the investment decisions of an individual company such as Van Oord.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op de specifieke beweegredenen en motieven bij investeringsbeslissingen van een individueel bedrijf als Van Oord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Klink, Amhaouch en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Kabinet maakt reuzendraai: stopt toch met financieren fossiele brandstofprojecten in het buitenland'

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the government about the impact of signing the COP26 pledge to end international public support for unabated fossil energy by end 2022, including effects on firms, jobs, existing export credit insurance, transition support and funding. The minister answered that roughly a quarter of the export credit portfolio is fossil-linked, that 39 countries and institutions have signed, that new policy will be implemented by end 2022, and that existing policies and contracts are unaffected.
In 2022 the cabinet will work on new policy to end international public support for the fossil energy sector, particularly regarding the export credit insurance (ekv).
Het kabinet zal in 2022 werken aan nieuw beleid voor het beëindigen van internationale overheidssteun aan de fossiele energie sector, in het bijzonder voor wat betreft de ekv.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over de berichten ‘Bedrijfsleven start eigen alarmsysteem tegen hackers: ‘overheid te traag’ & ‘Informatie over op handen zijnde hacks wordt grotendeels weggegooid’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked whether the government is aware of reports that business is setting up its own hack-alert system because government is too slow, and asked about the Digital Trust Center, the NCSC's legal limits, and evaluation of these bodies. The minister says the private initiative is positive, defends the DTC and NCSC, and points to a draft amendment to the Wbni and pilots while promising to report on DTC results in early 2022.
It is a positive development that private initiatives in the field of cybersecurity, such as the "alarm system", are emerging.
Het is een positieve ontwikkeling dat private initiatieven op het gebied van cybersecurity, zoals het «alarmsysteem», zich ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de voortgang afhandeling waterschade in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice and Security Minister about the progress of flood damage compensation in Limburg and Brabant, covering teeltplanschade interpretation, communication, helpdesks, processing times, turnover compensation, the Maas floodplains, EU solidarity funding, and climate resilience for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that productie loss is assessed per crop, outlined communication channels and a helpline, said turnover loss is not covered by the Wts and that a decision on compensation is still under exploration, and declined to set a timeline for some questions.
For determining crop plan damage, the production loss is assessed per company per production direction.
Voor de bepaling van de teeltplanschade wordt per bedrijf per productierichting gekeken naar het productieverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de opinie 'Kost het banen?'

An MP from the CDA asks the minister whether productivity and innovation should take priority over direct job creation in subsidies and whether process-innovation instruments suit the manufacturing sector. The minister answers that both job loss and creation are needed, that innovation policy is the focus, that process-innovation schemes are broadly used, and that further studies and advice are forthcoming.
Direct employment is not the primary criterion there.
Directe werkgelegenheid is daarbij niet het primaire criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Ierse privacywaakhond onderzoekt hoe TikTok gegevens van kinderen verwerkt'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked about TikTok's processing of children's data, the Irish DPC investigation, and related Dutch actions. The minister replied that the Dutch AP fined TikTok in 2021, transferred its 2020 investigation to the Irish DPC, has no evidence of data sharing with China, and will follow the DPC's second investigation while a cybersecurity study for apps is being commissioned.
The AP cannot make any statements about the content of that investigation.
Over de inhoud daarvan kan de AP geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Amhaouch over ontwikkelingen omtrent de Brexit met specifiek het Noord-Ierland protocol

MPs Kamminga and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about Brexit and the Northern Ireland Protocol, including the Commission's proposed simplifications, risks of fraud, and the possible use of Article 16. The minister answered that the Protocol is still being negotiated with the UK, that full implementation remains the goal, and that the consequences of Article 16 cannot yet be assessed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Landbouwgif in Maas gedumpt'

MPs Boswijk and Amhaouch asked the minister about reports that glyphosate was dumped into the Meuse for about 74 days, and why monitoring at Eijsden did not detect it earlier. The minister confirmed the drinking-water criterion was exceeded, explained that glyphosate is not in the continuous monitoring package and that monthly sampling and lab analysis caused a delay, and described coordination and cross-border warning measures, while the source of the discharge remains unidentified.

In consultation with, among others, the drinking water companies, it is now being discussed how the taking of water samples by different organisations can be better coordinated and timed to follow on from one another.

In overleg met o.a. de drinkwaterbedrijven wordt nu besproken hoe het nemen van watermonsters door verschillende organisaties beter gecoördineerd en aansluitend in de tijd op elkaar kunnen worden ingepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'High Tech Campus niet naar Amerikanen, maar in handen van Singaporese staat'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the sale of the High Tech Campus Eindhoven to a consortium led by Singapore's GIC, probing motives, legality, national security, and whether government can regain control. The minister answered that the sale was a lawful private market transaction cleared by the ACM, with no national security risks found, that it cannot be reversed, and that the proposed investment screening law would not apply.
It is not for the Dutch government to address the commercial motives underlying the investment.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid om in te gaan op welke commerciële motieven ten grondslag liggen aan de investering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters kijken nog steeds uit naar coronasteun’

MPs asked the government about religious institutions such as monasteries, churches and mosques that reportedly struggle with lost income and get little corona support. The government answered that religious organisations can use the TVL and NOW schemes on the same terms as others, reported 79 religious TVL applications (66 granted, EUR 1,001,482), and said it had held talks with religious umbrella bodies.
For the NOW, it was not separately registered whether religious institutions made use of the NOW.
Voor de NOW is niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd of religieuze instellingen gebruik hebben gemaakt van de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de wateroverlast

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Amhaouch asked ministers about flood damage and whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies to farmers outside Limburg, and about sand bags, food safety, manure bookkeeping and working-time rules. Minister Schouten answered that the compensation law applies only to disasters meeting the Wet veiligheidsregio's definition, that uiterwaard damage is excluded and still under study, and that a ministerial regulation and RVO quick scan are being prepared.
Currently the desirability and possibilities of compensating damage in floodplains along the Maas are being explored, about which your House has been informed.
Momenteel wordt de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden voor tegemoetkoming van schade in uiterwaarden langs de Maas verkend waarover uw Kamer is geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de stand van zaken rond de IPCEI’s Micro-elektronica 2 en Cloud Infrastructuur en Services

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and Climate about Dutch participation in the IPCEI Micro-electronics 2 and Cloud Infrastructure and Services, including the status of project proposals and the national financial contribution. The minister answered that the government has reserved 230 million euros for ME2 and 70 million for CIS, that selection of projects is still pending European Commission review, and that a decision on other IPCEIs will be made case by case by the new cabinet.
Only when the assessment by DG Competition has taken place later in the process will it be clear which projects can formally become part of the IPCEIs.
Pas als later in het proces de beoordeling door DG Mededinging heeft plaatsgevonden, zal duidelijk zijn welke projecten formeel onderdeel uit kunnen maken van de IPCEI's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Thijssen en Amhaouch over de maatregelen om de energietransitie bij de maakindustrie in het ‘zesde cluster’ te bevorderen

MPs Palland, Thijssen and Amhaouch asked how the government will promote energy transition, hydrogen infrastructure and financing for energy-intensive manufacturers in the 'sixth cluster' (ceramics, carpets) in eastern Netherlands, fearing they are overlooked. The minister and state secretary answer that the cluster has equal support via existing subsidies (VEKI, TSE, DEI+), a hydrogen transport network plan due spring 2022, regional energy strategies, and reject a dedicated transition fund for now.
The sixth cluster receives the same support as the rest of industry to achieve a reduction in energy consumption and CO2 emissions, including the switch to hydrogen.
Het zesde cluster krijgt dezelfde ondersteuning als de overige industrie om een vermindering van het energieverbruik en van CO 2 -emissies, waaronder de omschakeling naar waterstof, te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Palland en Amhaouch , over het bericht ‘Opnieuw problemen met Keolis-bussen die plotseling uitvallen'

MPs from the CDA asked the government about recurring failures of BYD-built Keolis buses in the Overijssel emergency concession, including whether provinces can exclude foreign manufacturers and how the EU International Procurement Instrument would affect bus procurement. The minister replied that the faults were limited and did not endanger safety, that provinces have limited ability to set origin requirements for privately purchased buses, and that the IPI would apply to public tenders but not private purchases, with information to provinces to follow once it takes effect.
In theory the province could purchase the buses itself, but in practice this almost never happens.
In theorie zou de provincie de bussen zelf kunnen inkopen, maar in de praktijk gebeurt dit vrijwel nooit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Weer schrik door storing bij fiscus'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary of Finance about erroneous tax penalty letters sent to businesses after an IT disruption at the Tax Authority, asking how many were affected, how the error occurred, whether COVID payment-deferral applicants were affected, and how to inform and compensate them. The State Secretary answered that 37,700 entrepreneurs wrongly received assessments and fines due to a human error during disruption repair, that affected businesses are being informed by letter and will not need to object, that costs for legal aid may be reimbursed under normal rules, and that a structural system replacement is being prepared.
In total, 37,700 entrepreneurs were wrongly issued a additional assessment and a late-filing fine.
In totaal hebben 37.700 ondernemers onterecht een naheffingsaanslag en een aangifteverzuimboete opgelegd gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen de vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de export van giftige benzine

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about the export of polluting, carcinogenic petrol from the Netherlands to poorer countries, including whether companies could be stopped and which countries received it. The State Secretary answered that the ILT has told companies the exports breach the Environmental Management Act, demanded measures by 1 September with a penalty order possible, named West African destination countries where traceable, and described diplomatic and UNEP efforts on fuel standards.
Companies were asked by the ILT to state by 1 September at the latest which measures they have taken and/or will take to fulfil their duty of care.
Bedrijven zijn door de ILT verzocht om uiterlijk per 1 september aan te geven welke maatregelen zij hebben genomen en/of zullen nemen om invulling te geven aan hun zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over herintroductie van de werktijdverkorting

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the minister about reintroducing short-time working (WTV), its eligibility rules, sector support, and a part-time unemployment scheme. The minister answered that WTV reopens from 1 October 2021 with pre-corona conditions, that supply shortages are generally normal business risk, and that a structural alternative will be sent to parliament before the budget debate.
Before the SZW 2022 budget debate, the House will receive a letter setting out several variants for a structural calamity/crisis scheme.
Voor de begrotingsbehandeling van SZW 2022 zal de Kamer een brief ontvangen met daarin uitgewerkt een aantal varianten voor een structurele calamiteiten/crisisregeling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Coronacrisis kost overheid tot dusver al 76,2 miljard euro' en het bericht 'Een vijfde van de coronasteun ging naar bedrijven met omze

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports that a fifth of corona support went to firms with year-on-year revenue growth, asking how much support was paid, how much was repaid, and whether firms would be asked to voluntarily repay. The government answered that support was not conditioned on annual revenue loss, estimated the share going to growing firms from partial data (TVL about 9%, NOW about 16% per ESB researchers), reported repayment figures, and committed to informing parliament and to a moral appeal to firms to repay.
Having an annual revenue decline was not a condition for using the generic support measures such as the TVL and NOW schemes.
Het hebben van een omzetdaling op jaarbasis is geen voorwaarde geweest om gebruik te maken van de generieke steunmaatregelen zoals de TVL en de NOW-regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Nederlandse' robotarm gaat na 35 jaar toch nog de ruimte in'

The MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the European robotic arm ERA, Dutch space-sector strategic importance, lessons for space policy, future projects, a long-term national space programme, and fragmentation of space policy. The government answers that space policy will be set by the next cabinet within budget limits, that a Nota Ruimtevaartbeleid 2019 already set priorities, and that some questions are for the next cabinet.
The budgetary framework for space policy will be set by a new cabinet.
Het budgettaire kader voor het ruimtevaartbeleid zal door een nieuw kabinet worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onzekerheid voor getroffen Limburgse ondernemers, 'meer omzetverlies dan waterschade''

CDA MPs asked for an update on flood damage in Limburg and Brabant, including economic losses from revenue loss, the state of compensation, the EU Solidarity Fund, local helplines and the coordinating minister. Minister Grapperhaus answered that economic loss is still poorly understood, that the Wts compensation scheme entered into force on 9 September 2021 with 1,135 reports so far, that a decision on the EU Solidarity Fund will follow by end of September, and that the Justice Minister coordinates the response while other ministers handle their own areas.
The cabinet is in discussion with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives to get a better picture of the economic damage.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers om een beter beeld van de economische schade te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over de schadevergoeding na de wateroverlast in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked why the compensation area for the July 2021 flood damage in Limburg and North Brabant does not match the area actually affected, and whether businesses outside it should be compensated. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that compensation is limited to the legally defined damage area under the Wts, that businesses outside it cannot be covered under current law, and that the government will discuss turnover losses with the region in the fourth quarter.
Outside this area there is no disaster as referred to here.
Buiten dit gebied is er geen sprake van een ramp als hiervoor bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Boswijk over de bijdrage van Nederlandse bedrijven aan de wereldwijde voedselvoorziening

MPs Amhaouch and Boswijk (CDA) asked whether US sanctions block food, seed and planting-material exports and cause hunger, and what Dutch banks and the EU are doing about it. The minister replies that no signals show US sanctions hindering such exports, that hunger is mainly driven by poverty, conflict, climate and Covid-19, and describes EU humanitarian carve-outs, the INSTEX vehicle and ongoing dialogue with the Dutch banking association.
No signals have been received that US sanctions affect the specific sectors and companies in the Netherlands referred to in the question.
Er zijn geen signalen ontvangen dat door de VS ingevoerde sancties de in de vraag bedoelde specifieke sectoren en bedrijven in Nederland raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het wereldwijde chiptekort en de noodzaak van een sterke, onafhankelijke Europese halfgeleiderindustrie

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the global chip shortage, its economic impact in the Netherlands, its causes, and the need for a strong, independent European semiconductor industry, including reshoring. The minister answered that the shortage's Dutch impact is mainly limited to automotive suppliers such as VDL Nedcar, that Europe must solve it jointly through IPCEI, industry alliance and R&D programmes, and that a reshoring action plan will be left to a successor cabinet.
Because of the confidential nature of these talks, we cannot go into their content in more detail.
Omwille van de vertrouwelijke aard van deze gesprekken kunnen wij niet nader ingaan op de inhoud hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Werner over dynamische evenementenvergunningen

MPs from the CDA asked about the status of more flexible, phased event permit procedures (dynamic permits), why fairgrounds are classed as events rather than throughflow locations, differentiation by event category, municipal hesitancy, timelines, and a handreiking for municipalities. The Minister answered that permitting is primarily a municipal responsibility, that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that the government has communicated conditions for events to ease planning, and that answers were timed with the 11 June communication.
Issuing permits is primarily a local responsibility of the municipality, which is advised by the safety region, emergency services and other parties.
Het verstrekken van vergunningen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente, zij worden hierbij geadviseerd door de veiligheidsregio, hulpdiensten en andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht dat Duitsland Nederlandstalige vaccinatiebewijzen niet accepteert

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the health minister whether Germany's refusal to accept Dutch-language vaccination certificates is undesirable and whether the government will seek a temporary recognition of Dutch certificates. The minister confirmed the facts, said the choice of languages is for Germany, reported bilateral talks showing the Dutch registration card does not meet German requirements, and said the government will keep pressing Germany and push the EU Digital COVID Certificate forward.
Yes, we will continue to press for this in our contacts with Germany.
Ja, we blijven ons hier in de contacten met Duitsland voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over de berichten ‘Dreigbrief bezorgd bij meerdere moskeeën in Nederland’ en ‘Brandstichting bij moskee in aanbouw in Gouda’

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Justice about reports of threatening letters and parcels sent to multiple mosques and an arson attack on a mosque under construction in Gouda. The minister condemned the actions, said at least 24 mosques received parcels, one suspect was arrested for the Gouda fire, and that the incidents are under investigation, while referring the national discrimination coordinator and mosque security guidance to other bodies.
Because this concerns an ongoing investigation, I cannot go into further details of the threats.
Omdat het hier een lopend onderzoek betreft, kan ik niet ingaan op de verdere details van de bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters vragen om compensatie, want ook broeders bijten in coronatijd op houtje'

MPs asked whether monasteries whose income from abbey shops and guesthouses fell due to COVID-19 can access compensation, and whether they should be treated like shops and hospitality businesses. The government answered that these organisations can use the generic COVID schemes (NOW, Tozo, TVL) if they meet the conditions, and it does not plan additional measures specifically for them.
The cabinet is not currently planning to introduce additional support measures specifically for this group, beyond the existing generic support measures.
Het kabinet is vooralsnog niet voornemens om, naast de bestaande diverse generieke steunmaatregelen, aanvullende ondersteuningsmaatregelen te treffen specifiek voor deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee en Amhaouch over het bericht 'EU efforts to observe the Palestinian election fall flat'

MPs Sjoerdsma, Piri, Van der Lee and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about reports that EU efforts to observe the Palestinian elections had stalled, including whether the EU could still observe and support the vote, Israel's reasons for not admitting EU staff, and alternative partners. The minister replied that President Abbas postponed the elections without a new date, that the EU has urged a new date and called on Israel to facilitate elections, and that the EU will renew its observation effort once a date is set.
Once a new date for the elections is set, the EU will again work towards organising an observation mission.
Wanneer een nieuwe datum voor de verkiezingen is vastgesteld, zal de EU opnieuw inzetten op de organisatie van een waarnemingsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhouach en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'TT te vroeg voor financiële compensatie, Mulder stelt Kamervragen'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the TT Assen motorcycle race and other events planned before 1 July 2021 can be compensated under the temporary COVID-19 event subsidy scheme, given that the Drenthe safety region bars large events until 1 June. The minister answered that events can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December or receive support if they meet the scheme's conditions, and that the scheme was developed in consultation with the sector and safety regions.
Events planned before 1 July can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December, provided it fits the local agenda and a permit is granted.
Evenementen die voor 1 juli staan gepland kunnen worden verplaatst naar een datum binnen de periode 1 juli–31 december, mits dat in de lokale agenda past en er een vergunning verleend wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over hoe baggeraars zich verweren tegen Chinese concurrentie

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Economic Affairs about unequal competition from Chinese dredging firms in EU tenders and the lack of reciprocal market access. The government acknowledged the problem and pointed to existing tools and EU instruments under development (IPI, foreign subsidies white paper) without committing to new sector-specific measures.
The cabinet is increasingly concerned about an unequal playing field between European and Chinese companies.
Het kabinet maakt zich in toenemende mate zorgen over een ongelijk speelveld tussen Europese en Chinese bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Aartsen over ''pensioenfondsen die hurende ondernemers het vel over de oren halen''

MPs Amhaouch and Aartsen asked whether pension funds that own shops and restaurant premises are pressing tenant entrepreneurs hit by the COVID crisis with rent increases and indexation, and what the government will do. The minister says pension funds generally do not own such property, that most tenants reached individual accommodation deals, that pain should be shared fairly, and that the government keeps talking with the parties but leaves negotiations to private actors.
It is not centrally recorded how many and which pension funds own shop and restaurant premises, or how many and which invest in shop and restaurant property.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen eigenaar zijn van winkel- en horecapanden en hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen beleggen in winkel- en horecavastgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'West-Zeeuws-Vlaamse horeca moet voor Pasen open: 'Als dit nog maanden duurt, gaan bedrijven kapot''

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about the West Zeeland-Flemish hospitality sector's demand to reopen before Easter, the lack of economic perspective in the COVID-19 roadmap, and whether sectors such as hospitality and hairdressing were consulted. The State Secretary answered that the epidemiological situation allows only small steps, that sectors are consulted through regular talks and advisory bodies such as the SER and CPB, and that plans for a phased reopening will be integrated into a periodic revision of the roadmap.
That is why the cabinet has started working with VNO-NCW and MKB-Nederland to formulate plans for a smart reopening of sectors.
Daarom is het kabinet met VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland aan de slag gegaan om plannen te formuleren voor een slimme heropening van sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Domper voor winkeliers: PostNL verlaagt vergoedingen'

CDA MPs asked the Minister whether PostNL may cut the compensated hours for shopkeepers hosting parcel service points from eight to six, given that the parcel boom boosts PostNL's turnover, and whether this was decided without consulting retailers. The Minister answered that the carriers voluntarily offered temporary extra compensation, that PostNL may freely end it, and that she sees no reason to intervene in company policy or the civil-law relationship with shopkeepers.
I do not consider it desirable to interfere in PostNL's business operations or in the civil-law relationship between the parcel carrier and the shopkeeper who manages a postal and parcel point.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk om mij te mengen in de bedrijfsvoering van PostNL of in de civielrechtelijke relatie tussen de pakketvervoerder en de winkelier die een post- en pakketpunt beheert.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de verloren brokstukken van een Boeing 747-400

An MP asked the minister about a Boeing 747-400 that lost debris and a burning engine after leaving Maastricht Aachen Airport, including damage, causes, investigation and prior vortex damage incidents. The minister said the Dutch Safety Board (OvV) and the police are investigating, the OvV will publish its report, and vortex damage incidents at the airport are being monitored via the regional consultation committee.
If the report gives cause for a response, I will share it with your House as soon as possible.
Wanneer het rapport aanleiding geeft voor een reactie zal ik deze zo spoedig als mogelijk met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Schuifdakenfabrikant Inalfa Venray zet zeker 190 mensen op straat'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Social Affairs about the planned loss of at least 190 jobs at Inalfa Venray, the regional impact, and industrial policy. The minister answered that no direct government contact with Inalfa occurred before the reorganisation, that the regional labour market can help affected workers, that the R&D subsidy scheme will open by 15 May 2021, and that a regional SWOT analysis is not considered necessary.
To date there has been no direct contact between the central government and Inalfa about the impending reorganisation at the company.
Er is tot op heden geen direct contact geweest tussen de rijksoverheid en Inalfa over de op handen zijnde reorganisatie bij het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over registratie geluidsoverlast

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how aircraft and rail noise complaints are registered, who handles them, and why a small group of repeat complainers accounts for very many complaints. The minister answered in detail on registration channels, roles of BAS, ProRail, ILT and the ministry, trends, and noise measures, and promised a Schiphol noise-reduction plan.
That is why I have asked Schiphol and LVNL to draw up a noise-reduction implementation plan to continuously limit the nuisance residents experience.
Daarom heb ik aan Schiphol en LVNL gevraagd om een uitvoeringsplan hinderreductie op te stellen voor de voortdurende beperking van hinder die bewoners ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Nauwelijks coronasteun voor startende ondernemers: 'Ik hou het nog drie maanden vol'’

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked why businesses founded in 2020 cannot access the NOW and TVL COVID support schemes, and what alternatives were considered. The State Secretary answered that a separate Tegemoetkoming Starters scheme will use Q3 2020 as reference revenue, with about 180 million euro budgeted, after alternatives such as constructed reference revenue and flat payments were rejected for fairness and feasibility reasons.
To be able to support businesses that started in the period from 1 October 2019 through 30 June 2020, the cabinet will develop a separate scheme for starters.
Om ondernemingen die zijn gestart in de periode vanaf 1 oktober 2019 tot en met 30 juni 2020 te kunnen ondersteunen, zal het kabinet een separate regeling voor starters ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over administratieve lastendruk exporterend mkb

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers how administrative burden on exporting SMEs has grown since the COVID crisis, including translation and customs paperwork, support channels, monitoring, fraud labelling, and EU and bilateral action. The government answered that it does not systematically track whether burden rises, points to existing helplines, life-events tools and the Exportwijzer, and says the EU is working on trade barriers and better regulation.
In general, the cabinet does not keep track of whether administrative burden rises or falls.
In het algemeen wordt door het kabinet niet bijgehouden of de administratieve lastendruk stijgt of daalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Amhaouch over de hypothecaire lening aan Winair

Two CDA MPs asked whether Winair's financial problems stem only from COVID-19, what conditions attach to the state-backed mortgage loan, whether competing routes and the state's 7.95% shareholding affect the decision, and what happened to recommendations on subsidising inter-island flights. The government answered that the loan followed a economic and political assessment, carries conditions such as no dividends and minimum daily flights, and was needed to keep Saba and Sint Eustatius connected, while stating that the wider connectivity question remains under review.
The results of Phase B contain commercially sensitive information; these will be shared confidentially with the House.
De uitkomsten van Fase B bevatten bedrijfsgevoelige informatie; deze worden vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Postma over boetes voor te zwaar beladen grensoverschrijdend vrachtverkeer

CDA MPs Postma and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fines for overweight cross-border trucks in Selfkant, Germany, and the resulting cost and emissions burden. The minister replied that EU rules cap trucks at 40 tonnes, that member states may allow higher weights domestically but Germany does not, and that the government sees no need to lobby Germany or act beyond EU law.
No, Germany abides by European legislation.
Nee, Duitsland houdt zich aan de Europese wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Slootweg en Amhaouch over het gedrag van Centric-topman Gerard Sanderink

CDA MPs asked ministers about Centric executive Gerard Sanderink's alleged threats to an inspector, destruction of evidence, ignored court rulings, and DNB's reliance on Centric software. The government answered that it would not publish his correspondence absent a request from investigators, that DNB as a contract partner monitors Centric, and that it cannot judge a private firm, while describing supervisory board powers in general terms.
At this moment I see no reason to make the correspondence in question public without a request from the bodies you mention.
Ik zie op dit moment geen redenen om bedoelde correspondentie openbaar te maken zonder dat daar een verzoek ligt van door u genoemde instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Amsterdam op achterstand in opmars kunstmatige intelligentie'

MPs Van der Molen and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers of Education and Economic Affairs about reports that Amsterdam lags in AI, the number of AI graduates, the need to retrain 800,000 workers, and progress on the AI action plan. The government answered that AI training is broad and hard to count, that Dutch AI leadership remains strong, and that it will keep informing parliament through the digitalisation strategy progress reports.
It is difficult to give a complete figure for the number of people being trained in artificial intelligence.
Het is lastig om een compleet cijfermatig beeld te geven van het aantal mensen dat wordt opgeleid op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Rabobank sluit helft filialen om winst op peil te houden'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the decline in bank branches, including Rabobank's closures, is desirable and what the role of the state and DNB is in keeping banking accessible to vulnerable groups. The minister answered that digital banking explains most closures, that banks are primarily responsible with DNB chairing the MOB to monitor accessibility, and promised a mid-2021 interim evaluation and a DNB study on cash infrastructure.
I do not have information on how many full-time equivalents are involved in this.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over hoeveel fte hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Amhaouch en Postma over het bericht 'Onbegrip bij provincie over weigering Rijk om informatie voor stikstofaanpak te delen'

CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister why the national government refuses to share nitrogen-related farm data with provinces on privacy grounds, and whether this delays regional nitrogen plans, and asked about a study focusing on peak-polluting farms. The minister answered that privacy-sensitive data is not essential, that provinces already hold much of the information, that work on an alternative data-access solution is ongoing, and that the study reflects only one part of the broader approach.
I am working with RVO and BIJ12 (on behalf of the provinces) on an alternative solution to make the last part of the relevant information accessible to the provinces.
Ik werk samen met RVO en BIJ12 (namens de provincies) aan een alternatieve oplossing om het laatste deel van de relevante informatie toegankelijk te maken voor de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over de mogelijke sluiting van de huisartsenpost in Venray

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the possible closure of the Venray GP out-of-hours post, consultation with stakeholders, travel times and patient numbers. The minister confirmed a proposed closure decision by Cohesie, said consultation steps under a draft AMvB would be followed, and cited a RIVM analysis showing 99.9% of residents could reach the Venlo post within 30 minutes, while declining to provide patient numbers and admission splits, referring to care providers.
I therefore have no insight into the wishes of each individual GP in the region.
Ik heb dan ook geen inzicht in de wensen van iedere individuele huisarts in de regio.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Is er nog leven voor VDL Nedcar na 2023 nu BMW afhaakt’

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked the government whether it had contacts with VDL Nedcar, BMW or the German government about BMW ending its contract, which ministries are involved in finding a solution, and whether an integral action plan for the region will be made. Minister Wiebes answered that contacts with VDL Nedcar and BMW took place at high level, no contact with the German government occurred on the contract, several ministries and NFIA help find new clients, and a regional development package with funding and road projects is being pursued.
The cabinet is generally reticent about publishing information on the content of specific contacts with businesses.
Het kabinet is over het algemeen terughoudend met het publiceren van informatie over de inhoud van specifieke contacten met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Provincie: geen reden om aan te nemen dat Friesenbrücke duurder en later klaar is'

MPs Amhaouch and Van der Graaf asked the minister whether the German Federal Audit Office report on the Friesenbrücke, which reportedly predicted higher costs and a delay to 2030, would affect the planned 2024 completion, and whether he would act. The minister answered that the report is confidential and unknown to him, that German partners confirm completion by end 2024 with no signals of cost overruns, and that he would inform parliament if developments warrant it.
No, the report is confidential and has not been shared with Dutch authorities.
Nee, het rapport is vertrouwelijk en niet gedeeld met Nederlandse overheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Slootweg over de berichten 'Mkb'ers maar matig op de hoogte van financieringsmogelijkheden' en 'Kredietverzekeraar: Nederland wacht volgend jaar grote faillissementsgo

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about SMEs' limited awareness of financing options and about a predicted bankruptcy wave, including whether insolvency law could intervene earlier and whether a temporary protection for healthy firms should be introduced. The state secretary answered that many support schemes exist, that bankruptcies remain low due to support packages and court delays, that the WHOA restructuring law is the chosen tool, and that a general protection measure is rejected as too broad, while committing to a Kamer report on the annual SME action plan and a bank-data analysis.

I have not made a commitment that, in addition to the existing CBS monitoring commissioned by EZK, periodic reporting will be provided on the use of the guarantee schemes in general and specifically on rejections.

Ik heb geen toezegging gedaan dat er aanvullend op de bestaande monitoring door het CBS in opdracht van EZK (periodiek) gerapporteerd wordt over het gebruik van de garantieregelingen in het algemeen en specifiek over afwijzingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over de uitzending van Zembla over Apotex

Two CDA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the sale of Apotex Leiden to Indian firm Aurobindo, the risks of dependence on foreign medicine production, and related investment screening. The minister answered that the state is willing to provide a loan to help a Dutch takeover by Innogenerics, that no talks with the top of Apotex took place, and that the government is working on EU-level mapping of medicine supply chains and a broader investment screening mechanism.
I am in consultation with sectors and experts to discuss what a good approach is to move further on this.
Ik ben in overleg met sectoren en deskundigen om te bespreken wat een goede aanpak is om hierin verder te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Eindhoven CS verdubbelen’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that ProRail sought more investment to double Eindhoven Central Station, the planned Eindhoven-Düsseldorf rail link, regional growth ties, and cross-border coordination. The State Secretary answered that needed measures are being assessed within existing programmes, that the Eindhoven-Düsseldorf tender started in June 2020 with service expected by end 2025, and that cross-border talks with Belgian and German counterparts are ongoing.
As I informed your House during the General Consultation on Rail Scheduling (9 September), the tender for the Eindhoven-Düsseldorf connection started in June 2020.
Zoals ik uw Kamer tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Spoorordening (9 september jl.) heb medegedeeld, is in juni 2020 de aanbesteding voor de verbinding Eindhoven-Düsseldorf gestart.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Hack bij Apollo Vredestein toont zwakke cyberbeveiliging Nederlandse bedrijven' en het bericht 'Overheid wist wie kwetsbaar was, maar liet bedrij

Two MPs (Van den Berg and Amhaouch, CDA) asked the ministers about reports of a hack at Apollo Vredestein and claims that government knew which firms were vulnerable but did not warn them, raising questions on SME cyber-security, incident reporting duties and NCSC mandate limits. The government answered that cyber-security is a priority, that voluntary measures and the Digital Trust Center cover non-vital firms, and that the NCSC could not lawfully share certain threat data at the time, with a planned DTC expansion and a review of government powers in digital crises.

In addition, the NCSC has a statutory task, insofar as necessary to prevent adverse societal consequences, to pass on information about threats and incidents concerning network and information systems of other organisations, including personal data obtained from analyses for its primary task.

Daarnaast heeft het NCSC, voor zover noodzakelijk ter voorkoming van nadelige maatschappelijke gevolgen, krachtens de wet als taak om informatie over dreigingen en incidenten met betrekking tot netwerk- en informatiesystemen van andere organisaties (waaronder ook persoonsgegevens), die is verkregen bij analyses ten behoeve van de primaire taak, door te verstrekken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Amhaouch en Palland over het met contant geld kunnen blijven betalen in winkels

Three CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether shops are increasingly refusing cash, whether COVID plays a role, what is done for groups dependent on cash, and how costs for small businesses will develop. The minister answered that no current data exist, a DNB/Panteia study is pending, cash acceptance is a commitment under MOB agreements, and further research on cash infrastructure is planned.
There is currently no up-to-date data available on the number of retail outlets concerned and the extent to which corona plays a role.
Er zijn op dit moment geen actuele gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal toonbankinstellingen dat dit betreft en in hoeverre corona hierbij een rol speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over dat kermisexploitanten boos zijn over het annuleren van Park Hilaria

CDA MPs asked the minister why municipalities are not granting fair permits after COVID rules allowed small fairs from 1 July 2020, and whether the government will talk with the VNG and fix delayed SBI business-code changes for fairground operators. The state secretary answered that municipalities cite short notice, location safety, financial feasibility and enforcement, that the SBI-code reassessment process for TOGS/TVL has been handled, and that the VNG was already urged to support the sector, without committing to a new meeting.
It falls under the statutory authority of municipalities to grant permits for events, including fairs.
Het valt onder de wettelijke bevoegdheid van de gemeenten om vergunningen voor evenementen, waaronder kermissen, te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Viecurie vreest voor zelfstandigheid'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about the cancelled merger between VieCuri and Laurentius hospitals and its consequences for regional acute care, emergency departments, obstetrics, and decision-making. The minister answered that the government leaves the matter to hospitals and insurers, that quality of care must be safeguarded, and described the regional data, stakeholder views and involvement in the decision.
It is for the health insurers to talk with the hospitals to secure continuity and quality of care.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars om met de ziekenhuizen in gesprek te gaan om de continuïteit en kwaliteit te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Van Weyenberg over het bericht "Nederland moet ondernemers in het buitenland mogelijk toch TOZO-uitkering geven"

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's view that the Tozo is a special non-contributory benefit requires exporting it to cross-border entrepreneurs, and whether Tozo 2's partner test should be treated differently. The State Secretary answered that the Tozo is a social assistance benefit outside the scope of the coordination regulation, so it cannot be exported, and that cross-border entrepreneurs can use other support measures instead.
The Tozo is a social assistance benefit and cannot be regarded as a special non-contributory benefit.
De Tozo is een bijstandsuitkering en kan niet gezien worden als een bijzondere non-contributieve uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Gedeputeerde kaart oneerlijke concurrentie busaanbesteding aan in Brussel’

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a report that a Overijssel deputy wants to stop unfair competition from non-EU bus tenderers in regional procurement. The State Secretary answered that the government favours reciprocity and a level playing field via the International Procurement Instrument and a forthcoming EU white paper on foreign subsidies, but that national and regional procurement rules cannot discriminate on origin, so the room for steering toward local firms is limited.
I therefore see only limited possibilities to steer toward awarding contracts to local and regional companies.
Ik zie daarom slechts beperkte mogelijkheden om te sturen op het gunnen aan lokale en regionale bedrijven.
