Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Eaton in Hengelo schrapt 300 arbeidsplaatsen’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Eaton's plan to cut 300 jobs in Hengelo by moving production to lower-cost countries, and about the government's response, industrial strategy and contacts with the company and regional bodies. The minister answered that the ministry was only informed on 1 July, that it and local authorities were not consulted beforehand, that talks are ongoing via Oost NL, and that the industrial vision for the manufacturing sector will follow in autumn.

The ministry and the local authorities were not involved in the considerations behind the relocation of production and outsourcing of company units and therefore had no opportunity to take action beforehand to influence this plan.

Het ministerie en de lokale overheden zijn niet meegenomen in de overwegingen van de productieverplaatsing en outsourcing van bedrijfsonderdelen en hebben daarom geen mogelijkheden gehad om vooraf acties te ondernemen dit voornemen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het bericht 'Gommers ziet geen verschil tussen Efteling en kermis: 'Virus niet verspreiden''

CDA MPs asked the health minister whether the NVIC chair's view that fairground visits should be possible under good plans is considered, whether fairground operators' continuity and field labs were addressed, and when clarity would be given. The minister replied that the relaxations announced on 24 June give perspective, that 1.5 metre distancing applies with no maximum headcount including fairs, that the sector will run a field lab and results will be reported to parliament, and that the June relaxations give clarity.
I will inform the House about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het sluiten van het consulaat in Nador

CDA MPs asked why the Netherlands is moving visa application services from Nador to Tanger, and whether the Nador honorary consulate is closing. The minister answered that the honorary consulate stays open and only the external visa service provider's office moves, to speed up and improve visa processing, a decision already final though paused by COVID-19.
The honorary consulate remains open and the current tasks of the consulate do not change.
Het honorair consulaat in Nador blijft geopend en de huidige taken van het consulaat veranderen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Slootweg over de berichten 'Banken zijn 180.000 ondernemers en consumenten tegemoetgekomen’ en ‘Bedrijven bij nieuwe bank krijgen geen krediet’

CDA MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that banks prioritise existing clients over new business customers, which may block new credit to firms during the coronavirus crisis, and about the lack of published rejection figures and the status of a Qredits loan. The government partly recognises the picture, says banks are now also serving new customers, promises to report on rejection data after the summer recess, and says the Qredits transaction should close at the end of July.
I am periodically in consultation with the banks regarding the corona monitoring they publish.
Ik ben periodiek in overleg met de banken ten aanzien van de coronamonitoring die zij uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Vervoersbedrijf Keolis nam initiatief tot ‘frauduleuze’ side letters'

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Keolis proposed side letters with Chinese bus suppliers BYD and Ginaf outside the official tender contracts, and whether the Keolis concession for the IJssel-Vecht region was fairly awarded. The State Secretary said the matter must first be investigated, that the ministry has no side letters, and that if reports prove true the provinces could revoke or retender the concession, while leaving further investigation to the provinces and the prosecution service and promising only to consider lessons learned after current investigations finish.
This matter must first be investigated.
Deze zaak moet nu eerst worden onderzocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht ‘Ondernemingsraad in Enschede zegt vertrouwen op in Vredestein-directie’ en het bericht ‘Bedenkelijke praktijken rond Hongaarse subsidie aan eigenaar V

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Apollo Vredestein plant closure in Enschede, the works council's loss of confidence in management, and questions about Hungarian subsidy practices and EU notification. The minister answered that the matter is for the parties themselves, that the Hungarian government and the Commission must decide on further investigation, and that the government is working with the province and municipality to limit job losses.
It is for the Hungarian government to assess whether investigation is needed.
Het is aan de Hongaarse overheid om te beoordelen of onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bruins over een mogelijke Europese ‘NASA’ waarin onderzoekinstituten op het gebied van luchtvaart nauwer samenwerken

MPs Amhaouch and Bruins asked the minister about a proposed European 'NASA' for aviation research institutes and related funding, decarbonisation and hydrogen engines. The minister answered that existing cooperation (ACARE, EREA, Horizon programmes) suffices, sees no need for a merged European institute, and outlined funding and innovation expectations without concrete new commitments.
I currently see no reason to pursue within Europe a merger of all those research institutes into one organisation.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om binnen Europa in te zetten op een samenvoeging van al die onderzoekinstituten in één organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Amhaouch inzake de voorspelling over toe- en afname van files en mogelijke verschuivingen naar individueel vervoer

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about forecasts of traffic congestion and a shift from public to individual transport after the COVID-19 lockdown, including foreign data, scenario modelling, working from home and parking. The Minister answered that forecasts are not comparable, that scenario modelling is ongoing with monthly-level updates and a promised report before summer, and that advice from the Denktank Coronacrisis and planning agencies is expected on 1 June.
I will inform your House before the summer about the main outcomes.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de belangrijkste uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over de Kamerbrief ‘Uitbreiding doelgroep Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers’

Two CDA MPs asked why cross-border self-employed people (living in NL with a business abroad, or living abroad with a business in NL) are treated differently under the Tozo and foreign benefits, and asked about monitoring, communication and numbers. The Secretary of State explained the territoriality principle, stated the reasoning behind eligibility, said no monitoring is planned because refusals cannot show who falls between the schemes, and gave rough estimates of affected entrepreneurs.
The answer to the first question is yes, with a caveat.
Het antwoord op de eerste vraag luidt ja, met een kanttekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht 'Ondernemers in krediet-ellende'

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that small business credit applications face long waits, heavy paperwork and high costs, and whether banks are committed to fast processing for small loans, whether 100% state guarantees or a role for Qredits would help. The state secretary replied that processing times are improving, points to the new small-loan guarantee scheme and optimisations to existing schemes, argues a 100% German-style guarantee is unsuitable for the Netherlands, and notes the reply came late.
The cabinet has also recently announced a separate guarantee scheme for small entrepreneurs with limited credit needs, where the credit assessment process can largely be carried out automatically.

Het kabinet heeft daarnaast recent een aparte garantieregeling aangekondigd voor kleine ondernemers met een beperkte kredietbehoefte, waarbij het kredietbeoordelingsproces grotendeels automatisch kan worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over de leefbaarheid rondom AWACS-basis Geilenkirchen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about noise nuisance from AWACS flights at Geilenkirchen, including the promised livability fund, flight timing, flight statistics and quieter engines. The State Secretary answered that noise is declining and flight counts have halved since 2004, that a livability fund is still under discussion with the region and will be revisited after COVID-19 measures are lifted, and that engine replacement is not pursued because the business case has weakened.
I will also send these to you.
Ik zal u deze ook doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'VDL Groep verliest busorder aan Chinees bedrijf'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked how VDL Groep lost a bus order to Chinese BYD Auto, whether the tender was fair, and what the government will do about foreign subsidies and reciprocity in procurement. The Secretary of State answered that the buses were a private purchase by concessionaire Keolis rather than a tender, found no evidence of unfair competition, acknowledged that current powers to investigate foreign subsidies are limited, and pointed to a proposed EU level playing field instrument and reciprocity measures.

At the same time, I must note that the current possibilities for investigating companies that may receive discriminatory financial support, and for taking action against them if this proves to be the case, are limited.

Tegelijkertijd moet ik constateren dat de mogelijkheden op dit moment beperkt zijn om onderzoek te doen naar bedrijven die mogelijk discriminatoire financiële steun ontvangen, en op te treden tegen bedrijven indien dat het geval blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Snellere betaling kan spanning bij infraprojecten nu al verminderen’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that invoice payment in construction takes an average of 62 days, and whether faster payment could ease liquidity problems and bankruptcies in the sector. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat pays 97% of invoices on time, that faster payment depends on the earlier invoicing stage, and that the government intends to cut the statutory payment term for large companies from 60 to 30 days.
With this I will carry out the Wörsdörfer/Amhaouch motion on a 30-day payment term as the statutory norm.
Hiermee zal ik de motie-Wörsdörfer/Amhaouch over een betaaltermijn van 30 dagen als wettelijke norm uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Slootweg over het bericht 'Consumentenbond: Producten van webwinkels buiten de EU vaak onveilig'

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Consumentenbond report finding many products from non-EU webshops unsafe, and about level-playing-field concerns, platform liability, the Amhaouch motion on EU liability officers, import controls and consumer awareness. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to EU platform pledges, a planned SER advice on platform liability, the market surveillance regulation requiring EU contact points from July 2021, and an awareness campaign, but declined generic import blocks as contrary to WTO rules.
I will discuss the latest state of affairs regarding the Product Safety Pledge with the European Commission.
Ik ga met de Europese Commissie in gesprek over de laatste stand van zaken met betrekking tot de Product Safety Pledge.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Chemelot zet vol in op energie- en chemiesnelweg’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Chemelot industrial site's need for pipelines and energy infrastructure linking Rotterdam, Germany and offshore energy, and about rail transport of hazardous substances. The minister answered that a taskforce on industrial infrastructure is examining the connections, that a cost-benefit study points to modal shift to pipelines, and that talks with the province and companies will follow.
I have made arrangements with the province to discuss this with them soon.
Ik heb afspraken gemaakt met de provincie om dit binnenkort met hen te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Deventer sluit 'monsterdeal' voor bouw XXL-distributiecentrum'

MPs Bruins and Amhaouch asked about the planned XXL distribution centre in Deventer, covering jobs, housing for migrant workers, infrastructure, landscape impact, vacancy risk and the status of a motion on logistics sprawl. The state secretary answered that the buyer is also the user, that 300-350 jobs are expected, and that the national spatial vision will address warehouse sprawl, with the motion response to follow in spring.
The cabinet will return to this in the Spring Letter regarding the further choices in the National Environment and Planning Vision.
Het kabinet komt hier op terug in de Voorjaarsbrief met betrekking tot de nadere keuzes in de Nationale Omgevingsvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Franse treinfabrikant Alstom neemt treinentak Bombardier over'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the planned takeover of Bombardier's rail unit by Alstom, its effect on European rail industry and competition, and European industrial and competition policy. The State Secretary answered that competition authorities must judge the merger case by case, that a strong independent competition regime is preferred over creating European champions, and that the government promotes a level playing field through trade instruments.
It is up to competition authorities to assess case by case whether a takeover leads to a significant restriction of competition.
Het is aan mededingingsautoriteiten om per casus te beoordelen of een overname leidt tot een significante beperking van de mededinging.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Palland en Amhaouch over het bericht dat banken het mkb leegmelken

MPs Palland and Amhaouch asked whether banks may unilaterally raise interest margins on SME loans, including for sector-wide risk, and what has improved since the banking sector's self-regulation. The minister answered that such changes are allowed under contract terms and the 2018 Gedragscode Kleinzakelijke Financiering, that information duties are now set, that complaints to Kifid about such changes are absent, and that the code will be evaluated in 2021.
I have no figures on the extent to which banks do this.
Ik heb geen cijfers over in hoeverre banken dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Postma over het mogelijk maken van het enkelvoudig in- en uitchecken in de treinketen

MPs Amhaouch and Postma asked why the government limits single check-in/check-out to a national app with location, despite a motion asking for broader solutions, and criticised privacy costs and the Ombudsman's concerns about the system. The minister answered that cost-benefit research found single check-in not worthwhile, that new payment methods and an app will be phased in, that privacy is legally protected, and promised a further update via the NOVB progress report.
I am pleased with the work of the public transport ombudsman because it helps individual travellers with incidental cases and increases travel and payment convenience for all travellers.
Ik ben blij met het werk van de OV ombudsman omdat het individuele reizigers helpt bij incidentele voorvallen en het reis- en betaalgemak van alle reizigers verhoogt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Ronnes en Amhaouch over de problemen bij Centric en Oranjewoud

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about governance problems at Centric, Oranjewoud and Strukton, including an unlicensed investigator, the departure of Centric's top management, and board supervision. The government answered that Centric's services to DNB and BNG are unaffected for now, that no investigator licence exists, that FIOD received and declined to treat a complaint due to criminal proceedings, and explained the legal duties of supervisory boards, while noting the answers were delayed.
Due to overlap with investigation and prosecution under article 9:8(1)(f) of the General Administrative Law Act, this complaint, in consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, was not handled.
Wegens samenloop met opsporing en vervolging conform art. 9:8 lid 1 onderdeel f Awb is deze klacht, in afstemming met het Openbaar Ministerie, niet in behandeling genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch en Bruins over ongewenste effecten van de werking van historische rechten op slots in relatie tot de disruptie veroorzaakt door het coronavirus (IATA r

MPs asked whether the minister would press the European Commission to suspend slot 'use-it-or-lose-it' rules for 2020 at the request of IATA, given coronavirus disruption to air travel and the risk of empty flights. The minister agreed in principle, said the Commission would be asked to extend the existing waiver for the summer season and widen it to all severely affected countries, but declined to provide load-factor data citing commercial confidentiality.

I have asked the European Commission to extend its current waiver of the slot rules for preserving historic rights for the IATA winter season 2019/2020 in connection with the coronavirus into the upcoming IATA summer season

Ik heb de Europese Commissie verzocht om haar huidige ontheffing van de slotregels ten behoeve van het behoud van historische rechten voor het IATA winterseizoen 2019/2020 in verband met het coronavirus te verlengen voor het aankomend IATA zomerseizoen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over tekortkomingen van Kustwachtwachthelikopters

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked about a safety report on the Dutch coast guard SAR helicopters, crew safety, the 2016 OVV findings, crew language skills, the contracting of the Belgian operator, airworthiness oversight and callout figures. The minister referred to the attached research report and response for most substantive points, said the contractor had been awarded the contract on lowest price, placed airworthiness oversight with the Belgian aviation authority, and gave callout numbers for 2017-2019.
I refer you to the research report that I have sent you today.
Ik verwijs u naar het onderzoeksrapport dat ik u heden heb toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Wouter Bos over Invest-NL: voor minder dan 5 miljoen hoef je hier niet aan te kloppen'

MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether Invest-NL's director saying SMEs need not apply for financing under five million euros, and the reported minimum-amount requirement, conflict with the minister's earlier assurances and the unanimously adopted motion on SME access. The minister replied that there is no minimum investment threshold, that most current pipeline applicants are SMEs, and that the conditions are set in law, while committing to review conditions in future progress reports and evaluations.
There is no minimum investment threshold for Invest-NL.
Er is geen minimale investeringsdrempel voor Invest-NL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Kamer van Koophandel vertrekt uit Drenthe’

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the closure of the Chamber of Commerce office in Emmen, Drenthe, and whether startups can register without visiting a branch. The state secretary answered that closure is part of a planned national reorganisation toward five physical offices and more digital services, and declined to reverse the decision or introduce an alternative registration route soon.
It is not desirable that a different option for starting entrepreneurs to register with the KVK comes available in the short term.
Het is niet wenselijk dat er op korte termijn een andere mogelijkheid voor startende ondernemers komt om zich te kunnen inschrijven bij de KVK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het feit dat Italië alle vluchten tussen Italië en China heeft opgeschort

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about Italy suspending China flights, Chinese tourists with coronavirus in Italy, KLM suspending China flights, travel advice, EU coordination, quarantine of returnees, and international support for vulnerable countries. The government answered that Dutch procedures match Italy's, that EU health measures remain with member states, that it follows WHO advice against disproportionate restrictions, and that no additional Dutch funding seems necessary now.
Measures regarding health are reserved to the member states.
Maatregelen ten aanzien van de gezondheid zijn voorbehouden aan de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de ontspoorde trein bij Voorburg

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a derailed train at Voorburg, including reports of earlier faults, injuries, passenger care, and whether the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid would investigate. The minister reported two minor injuries, explained the passenger care, and said NS and ProRail are investigating the cause, with the Chamber to be informed on completion, but declined to pre-empt the findings on the reported faults.
This investigation is still ongoing and I do not want to anticipate its outcomes.
Dit onderzoek loopt momenteel nog en ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten ervan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen tot 8 januari over Irak en Iran bleven vliegen en over de opvolging van aanbe

MPs asked why Dutch airlines kept flying over Iran and Iraq until 8 January 2020, what information was shared, and how the OVV's MH17 conflict-zone recommendations have been implemented. The minister answered that KLM stopped flying there about 1.5 hours after the US FAA ban, that EASA and ICAO advisories were issued and the status of each OVV recommendation was described, while stating that airspace sovereignty and closure duties lie with states and promising further international and national follow-up.
Following the attack on the Iranian general on 2 January, the situation was actively monitored by the Netherlands (Expert Group of the Convenant on sharing threat information for civil aviation).
Naar aanleiding van de aanslag op de Iraanse generaal op 2 jan jl. is de situatie door Nederland (Expertgroep van het Convenant deling dreigingsinformatie burgerluchtvaart) actief gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat de ondergrond van treinen niet berekend is op snellere, langere en zwaardere treinen

CDA MP Amhaouch asked the minister whether ProRail's warning that rail subsoil cannot bear faster, longer and heavier trains is correct, and about investigations, maintenance, costs and urgency. The minister confirmed that some areas have weak subsoil, that safety is not currently at stake, and that a national track-stability study is expected by 2022, with a corridor-specific study due by summer 2020 and costs to be clarified mid-2020; many specifics were deferred.
I will inform your House about the outcomes and follow-up of both studies.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten en opvolging van beide onderzoeken informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Bosman, Kerstens, Bruins, Voordewind en Stoffer over de berichtgeving ‘Nieuwe onderzeeboten: Nederlandse marine-industrie dreigt alleen kruimels te krijgen’

MPs from several parties asked the Defence, Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about press reports that the Dutch naval shipbuilding industry risks getting only scraps from the new submarine order, and about risks to knowledge retention, intellectual property, competition and the Defence Industry Strategy. The government answered at length, largely restating its procurement approach: competitive selection under Article 346 TFEU, IP and maintenance guarantees to be negotiated in the next phase, and no decision yet on a single preferred bidder.
As I stated in the B-letter, I will implement the Bruins Slot et al. motion.
Zoals ik in de B-brief heb vermeld zal ik uitvoering geven aan de motie Bruins Slot c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over cargovluchten tussen Maastricht en Luik van 9 minuten

An MP asked the minister about Qatar Airways cargo flights between Maastricht and Liège lasting only 9 minutes and whether this is undesirable. The minister said such very short flights are undesirable from an environmental view, there is no legal instrument to ban them, the airline has confirmed it will stop them.
From an environmental point of view, I do not consider very short cargo flights desirable when good alternatives are available.
Vanuit het oogpunt van milieu vind ik zeer korte cargovluchten niet wenselijk wanneer er goede alternatieven voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Subsidie nachttrein verstoort de markt’

MPs Ziengs and Amhaouch asked why a 6.7 million euro subsidy for ÖBB NightJet via NS would not distort the market, whether it is non-discriminatory, a bridging subsidy, and why no lower-cost alternatives were sought. The minister defends a two-track approach: a temporary subsidy to NS/ÖBB for a trial from 2021 while open-access operators are engaged, with compensation capped at net financial effect and limited to the PSO framework.

To reintroduce the night train quickly, a two-track approach was chosen with temporary subsidy to NS alone, while at the same time work proceeds with other interested parties on a non-discriminatory arrangement.

Om de nachttrein op korte termijn al te herintroduceren is gekozen voor een tweeledige aanpak met een tijdelijke subsidiering van alleen NS, terwijl tegelijkertijd met andere geïnteresseerde partijen gewerkt wordt aan een non-discriminatoire regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Amhaouch over het bericht over misstanden in projecten van FMO

CDA MPs Kuik and Amhaouch asked the minister, following a Trouw report, about alleged abuses (including land grabbing) in FMO-financed projects, FMO's risk management, the ministry's role, and whether local authorities prosecute. The minister confirmed the projects are known and under policy dialogue, explained the ministry's oversight role and risk monitoring, but declined to share FMO's problem list citing ongoing investigations and commercial confidentiality.
It is generally not in the interest of the ongoing investigation to share information about this with external parties.
Het is doorgaans niet in het belang van het lopende onderzoek om informatie hierover te delen met externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en De Pater-Postma over de beruchte spoorwegovergang in Castricum

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the dangerous Castricum level crossing, including how often trains passed while people or vehicles were on it, the causes and outcomes, progress on safer crossings, and how many unprotected crossings remain. The secretary said there were six such incidents since 1975 with one collision in 1997, listed programme progress and a joint study with the municipality, and said the target is zero fatalities at level crossings with about 180 priority NABO crossings to be tackled by 2023, 36 done so far.
Level crossing safety is a priority for me.
Overwegveiligheid is voor mij een prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Amhaouch en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Schiphol is niet de enige: ook 5 andere Nederlandse vliegvelden missen natuurvergunning’

MPs Bruins, Amhaouch and Paternotte asked whether five regional Dutch airports lack the nature permit (natuurvergunning) for their activities, and what that means for their operation. The minister answered that four of the airports have no Wnb permit while Groningen Eelde has a 2009 permit, that enforcement requests are pending at the Ministry of LNV, and that she will not anticipate those outcomes, referring to the environmental impact assessments and prior decisions for each airport.
These enforcement requests have been taken up by the Minister of LNV, the competent authority under the Wnb, and are being handled under the usual procedure.
Deze handhavingsverzoeken zijn door de Minister van LNV, het bevoegd gezag voor de Wnb, in behandeling genomen en worden volgens de gebruikelijke procedure afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte, Amhaouch en Remco Dijkstra over het gestaakte overleg tussen het ministerie en Noord-Veluwse gemeenten over vliegroutevarianten

MPs asked why the Noord-Veluwe municipalities stopped consultation on Lelystad Airport flight-route variants, and whether any variant avoids overflying the largest towns. The minister rejects the claim of a stopped consultation, says the variants do reduce overflown residents, and states a preference for route variant N for runway 23, though the document is cut off before its final answers are complete.
There is therefore no question of a halt to the consultation.
Van het staken van overleg is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het in zicht zijn van het spoorplafond

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether NS's forecast that the rail capacity ceiling would be reached as early as 2027 (or 2025 if the trend continues) is credible, given that the government's NMCA model projects 2030, and asked about rolling-stock investment, double-decker trains and peak-hour spreading. The State Secretary answered that NS's higher-growth model is a company planning tool, that the NMCA remains the government's basis, that NS sees no shortfall in rolling stock for ten years, and that she is working with partners on peak-spreading and minor infrastructure adjustments, with a promised NS letter on double-deckers.

I committed during the VAO of 18 April 2019 to send the Chamber, with the HSL-Zuid progress report (before 1 October), a letter from NS on applying the 'apply-or-explain' principle to double-decker investments.

Ik heb tijdens het Verslag Algemeen Overleg (VAO) van 18 april 2019 aan de Kamer toegezegd om bij de aanbieding van de Voortgangsrapportage HSL-Zuid (vóór 1 oktober) een brief van NS te sturen over toepassing van het «pas- toe-of-leg-uit-principe» bij investeringen in dubbeldekstreinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het Belgisch spoorbedrijf Nationale Maatschappij der Belgische Spoorwegen (NMBS) dat de concurrentie aangaat met de Drielandentrein

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that Belgian rail operator NMBS is exploring a half-hourly service between Liège and Maastricht that could compete with the Dutch-operated Drielandentrein, and whether this undermines the 2016 intention agreement. The government answered that NMBS is only conducting an exploratory study, that it has pledged cooperation under the agreement, and that operators are working on ETCS installation and operating arrangements, with ministerial consultation with Belgium deferred until a new Belgian cabinet is in place.
Once a new Belgian cabinet has taken office, I will discuss the progress of the Drielandentrein with my Belgian colleague.
Zodra een nieuw Belgisch kabinet is aangetreden, zal ik met mijn Belgische collega de voortgang van de Drielandentrein bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Wörsdörfer over de policy brief van het CPB over MKB-bankfinanciering

MPs Amhaouch and Wörsdörfer asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a CPB report finding that Dutch SMEs receive fewer bank loans and face higher rates than in other eurozone countries, and what the government will do. The State Secretary acknowledges the report, stresses that the causes are diverse and not firmly established, notes that many rejections are justified, points to existing guarantee and risk-capital instruments, and promises a policy letter in autumn 2019 rather than before the summer recess.
In autumn 2019 I will elaborate on my policy vision in a letter to the House.
In het najaar 2019 zal ik in een Kamerbrief mijn beleidsvisie nader toelichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het economische deel van het Israëlisch-Palestijnse vredesplan

Two CDA MPs asked the government about a US-organised economic conference in Bahrain on the economic part of the Israeli-Palestinian peace plan, its participants, Dutch and EU contributions, and barriers to Palestinian economic growth. The government answered that it attended at senior civil-servant level, outlined EU and Dutch aid and World Bank growth estimates, and called for a two-state solution and donor involvement, while noting the US plan lacked attention to occupation's effects.
The Netherlands will continue to press for this and keep seeking dialogue in other forums such as the Ad Hoc Liaison Committee.
Nederland zal daar op aan blijven dringen en de dialoog blijven zoeken in andere fora zoals de Ad Hoc Liaison Committee
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de problemen bij Boeing

Two MPs (Amhaouch, CDA, and Paternotte, D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Boeing knew of problems with the 737 MAX long before the crashes, whether regulators were informed, EASA versus FAA certification rules, and possible pressure on engineers and oversight of Boeing's 787 production. The minister answered that the reports could not be confirmed and that the US matters are for investigation there, pointed to existing ICAO and EU rules, EASA's stop of the 737 MAX, the ILT's and OVV's oversight powers, and that the ILT received no formal or informal signals.
This is a matter for further investigation in the United States.
Dit is een onderwerp voor nader onderzoek in de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de vernietiging van Hollandse uien in Hongarije

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about Hungarian authorities destroying a Dutch onion consignment that lacked origin labelling, and whether this was lawful and avoidable. The minister answered that the missing label breached rules, that the consignment was sent to biogas digestion after a spot check, that Hungarian law permits such measures, and that talks with Hungary will be held to prevent recurrence.
I will discuss with the relevant Hungarian authorities whether agreements are possible to prevent this in the future.
Ik zal met de betreffende Hongaarse autoriteiten bespreken of afspraken mogelijk zijn om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bruins Slot over het vervoer tijdens de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Amhaouch and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about transport capacity to Zandvoort for the Formula 1 Grand Prix, including visitor numbers, the mobility plan, and rail upgrades. The State Secretary answered that the organiser and municipality are responsible for the mobility plan, that the line can run about six trains per hour with extra measures, and that ProRail is studying the cost and timeline for further upgrades.
Ensuring a mobility plan and good accessibility for the event is the responsibility of the organiser in cooperation with the municipality of Zandvoort.
Het zorgdragen voor een mobiliteitsplan en een goede bereikbaarheid van het evenement is de verantwoordelijkheid van de organisatie in samenwerking met de gemeente Zandvoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese spionnen stelen kostbare bedrijfsgeheimen van ASML'

CDA MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked the ministers about reports that Chinese spies stole trade secrets from ASML, and whether this threatens national security and calls for new measures. The minister answered that the theft by ex-employees of ASML's US subsidiary was serious but showed no direct foreign government involvement, outlined existing legal and advisory protections, and promised an investment screening law in 2019 and a new China strategy.
The aim is to bring such a bill into procedure in 2019 as part of a broader package of measures.
Inzet is om een dergelijk wetsvoorstel in 2019 in procedure te kunnen brengen als onderdeel van een breder palet aan maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Verkopers van Eneco toch niet zo braaf’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about reports of aggressive door-to-door energy sales, whether a licensing requirement for sellers is warranted, and whether the ACM is adequately active. The State Secretary condemned the conduct, said existing municipal licensing and ACM enforcement powers are sufficient, and announced planned telemarketing opt-in rules and talks on business contracts sold to sole traders.
I am of the view that this system offers sufficient possibilities to impose requirements on selling parties and to enforce action when the rules are not complied with.
Ik ben van mening dat dit stelsel voldoende mogelijkheden biedt om eisen op te leggen aan verkopende partijen en om handhavend op te treden als de regels niet worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het voornemen van Italië om zich aan te sluiten bij het Chinese Belt and Road investeringsprogramma

CDA MPs asked the government about Italy's planned accession to China's Belt and Road Initiative, its effect on EU unity, Dutch firms and EU screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that Italy's MoU is a non-binding intention, that EU rules remain fully applicable, that the EU investment screening regulation was being finalised, and that the government would address China in a forthcoming note.
At this moment it is not possible to make an estimate of this.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk hiervan een inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over duurzame luchtvaart

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about KLM's emissions-trading costs, airport and government charges, the Dutch aviation tax, and biokerosene policy. The minister gave substantive answers on the costs, referred to a benchmark sent to parliament, and referred to a separate policy letter for biokerosene incentives.
Furthermore, I have no information on possible passing-on of costs in those countries.
Verder heb ik geen informatie over mogelijke terugsluizing van kosten in die landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked the minister about the two Boeing 737 MAX crashes, the FAA's and EASA's grounding decisions, the Dutch airspace closure, certification and software-fix timelines, and passenger compensation. The minister answered that the Dutch closure followed EASA's binding order, that EASA and the Dutch decision do not differ substantively, and that the crash cause and software fix were still under review, with no firm timeline given.
Together with EASA it is being considered whether and when my decision to close Dutch airspace can be withdrawn.
Met EASA wordt afgestemd of en wanneer mijn besluit om het Nederlandse luchtruim te sluiten kan worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked the minister about the Boeing 737 MAX crashes, including flawed FAA certification, the MCAS system, Boeing's role in certification, and the EASA ferry-flight exemption that let TUI aircraft return to the Netherlands. The minister answered that certification is primarily the FAA's and EASA's responsibility, that the Netherlands has no role or insight in it, that ferry flights were allowed under EASA rules, and that investigations are still ongoing.
Certification of Boeing aircraft is primarily the responsibility of the FAA.
Certificatie van Boeing-vliegtuigen is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de FAA.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over de bescherming van ondernemers uit het midden- kleinbedrijf (mkb) tegen onredelijke energiecontracten en de oproep van de Consumentenbond voor e

MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about protections for small and medium-sized businesses against onerous energy contracts and the Consumentenbond's call for a total ban on telephone sales. The State Secretary answered that small business customers with small connections get consumer protections under energy law, that exit fees are being investigated by the ACM, and that an opt-in regime for telemarketing and an incasso register are being prepared.

Therefore the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, together with the ACM, will consider after this investigation concludes whether further measures are necessary to better protect small business customers.
Daarom beziet de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat samen met de ACM na afronding van dit onderzoek of verdere maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om kleinzakelijke afnemers beter te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over de ongelukken op de A67

CDA MPs asked the minister about accidents on the A67 motorway, including recent accident figures for 2018 compared with 2017 and whether other sources than BRON are used, and which safety measures are being studied under the MIRT exploration. The minister says 2018 figures are not yet available in BRON pending quality checks, will only communicate validated BRON data, and lists short-term measures such as emergency lanes, better merging, and tyre-related incident prevention plus a capacity expansion in the Leenderheide-Zaarderheiken section.
Once the definitive figures are available, I will inform the House further about the accident situation on the A67.
Ik zal zodra de definitieve cijfers beschikbaar zijn de Kamer nader informeren over de ongevalssituatie op de A67.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Schonis over het bericht dat de risicoplafonds voor vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen per spoor wordt verruimd

MPs Amhaouch and Schonis asked the State Secretary about reports that risk ceilings for rail transport of hazardous substances would be loosened, how this fits with legal norms, and the effects on residents along the Twente line. The State Secretary largely referred to a separate letter on the ceiling exceedances and gave substantive answers on Dutch-EU alignment, the legal basis for adjusting ceilings, quick-scan follow-up, noise and pilot timelines.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter 'Explanation of exceedances of risk ceilings on the railways and my approach', which is being sent to your House parallel to these answers.

Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief «Toelichting op overschrijdingen risicoplafonds op het spoor en mijn aanpak» die parallel aan de beantwoording van deze vragen aan uw Kamer is aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over problemen op de Maaslijn

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the state secretary about financial and operational problems on the Maaslijn rail line, including provincial disputes, responsibilities for funding and rolling stock, and the impact on students. The state secretary said responsibility for the project and concession lies mainly with the three provinces, that the Rijk's contributions are fixed, and that she is monitoring the situation and in talks with the provinces, without committing to a formal mediating role.
Responsibility for implementing the project and the agreed measures lies with the three provinces, with the province of Limburg as the first point of contact.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het project en de afgesproken maatregelen ligt bij de drie provincies, waarbij de provincie Limburg het eerste aanspreekpunt is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over mogelijke sancties van de VS op Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Amhaouch and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether it was informed about possible US sanctions on Dutch firms involved in Nord Stream 2 and what it would do to protect them. The minister answered that the government is in regular contact with the US and EU, raises concerns about disproportionate impact, rules out a Special Purpose Vehicle for now, but gives no concrete commitments beyond continued advocacy.
The Netherlands will nevertheless continue to actively raise its concerns bilaterally and within the EU, including about the consequences for Dutch business.
Nederland blijft in bilateraal en EU-verband evenwel actief zijn zorgen onder de aandacht brengen, inclusief over de gevolgen voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Meer NS-treinen stranden op hsl’

MPs Ziengs and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary about reports that more NS trains were stranding on the high-speed line due to a software fault introduced in a mid-2018 update. The State Secretary confirmed the increase, attributed it to a software synchronisation fault, described a corrective update completed in January 2019, and said effects on performance indicators and the 2021 outlook would be reported later.
I will inform your House more about this in the spring.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over problemen op de Maaslijn

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring disruptions and overcrowded trains on the Maaslijn railway line. The government answered that improvements depend on provincial concession measures and electrification planned for later, attributing the problems to infrastructure repair delays, a lack of rolling stock, and hard-to-detect signalling faults, while assigning responsibility to the concession holder, ProRail and the provinces.
It is the responsibility of the concession holder and concession grantors to take action on this together with ProRail.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de concessiehouder en concessieverleners om daar samen met ProRail actie op te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over kansen voor Nederlandse batterij-industrie

MPs from the CDA asked the government whether a German one-billion-euro battery investment, possible Dutch battery opportunities, EU state aid rules and related Dutch initiatives could be supported. The State Secretary answered that Germany's plan is national but aligned with the EU initiative, that the Netherlands is exploring battery opportunities via RVO.nl, and that talks with the Commission and a Twente R&D initiative are ongoing, without firm commitments yet.
The German initiative is not yet sufficiently developed to establish whether, and if so how, it will use European funds, and whether it will conflict with European competition rules.

Het Duitse initiatief is nog onvoldoende uitgewerkt om te kunnen vaststellen of, en zo ja, hoe het gebruik zal maken van Europese middelen, en of het ook tegen Europese mededingingsregels zal aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over de onbewaakte spoorwegovergangen in Santpoort-Zuid

MPs Von Martels and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management for an update on the unguarded level crossings at Santpoort-Zuid, why the planned parallel road is delayed, its completion timeline, and how the project will be concluded quickly. The State Secretary answered that the parallel road is delayed by a landowner refusing cooperation and pending objections against permits, with a building-road target of summer 2019 and final road summer 2020, and that ProRail is pursuing legal options and a possible temporary route while hoping for an amicable settlement.
I share the conclusion that it is dangerous to cross these level crossings.
Ik deel de conclusie dat het gevaarlijk is om deze overwegen te kruisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het onderzoek naar de Lion Air-crash

An MP asked the minister about problems with Boeing 737 MAX software after the Lion Air crash, including which airlines fly the type to the Netherlands, whether Dutch aviation authorities know of technical problems, and whether procedures are adequate. The minister answered that no prior problems were known, that international and EU certification rules apply, that the ILT sees no reason for further action, and that procedures are in order without guaranteeing no future incidents.
The cause of the accident is still under investigation by the Indonesian authorities, in accordance with international treaties.
De oorzaak van het ongeval is nog in onderzoek bij de Indonesische autoriteiten, conform de internationale verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Amhaouch over toename import in de EU van legbatterijeieren

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers how much egg and egg-product imports into the EU have risen, whether imported eggs meet EU animal welfare standards, and what is being done about Ukraine's laying-hen housing and chicken fillet imports. The minister replied that imports must meet EU health and labelling rules but not EU production standards, that trade agreements contain limited welfare provisions, and that Ukraine has a phased implementation plan through 2021 which the Netherlands will keep pressing.
Products imported into the EU generally do not have to meet EU production requirements, such as housing systems and animal welfare standards, unless agreements have been made with third countries.

Door de EU geïmporteerde producten hoeven in het algemeen niet te voldoen aan productie-eisen van de EU, als houderijsystemen en dierenwelzijnsstandaarden, tenzij er met derde landen afspraken over zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over financiële problemen NS op het Britse spoor

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked about NS's financial problems on its British rail activities, including a £80 million PCS guarantee draw for East Anglia, the CLE risk-sharing mechanism, and whether Dutch fares could rise. Minister Hoekstra answered that Abellio UK has been profitable overall, that the PCS guarantees are capped by a €500 million ministerial ceiling and that the CLE index is no longer applied to new concessions, while declining to comment on ongoing negotiations with DfT.
We do not wish to anticipate the outcomes of those discussions and their consequences for the remainder of the concession term.
Wij willen niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van die gesprekken en de gevolgen daarvan voor de rest van de looptijd van de concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Von Martels over het feit dat ASML in België medische isotopen gaat ontwikkelen

MPs from the CDA asked why the Lighthouse medical isotope project, named a Dutch National Icon, is being developed in Belgium instead of the Netherlands, and what financing was tried. The government answered that Lighthouse keeps its icon status, that Dutch private investors judged the risk too high, and that the Belgian IRE is now the partner, with the state-aid compliance left to Belgium.
It is up to the Belgian government to ensure that the agreements comply with the European state aid rules.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om te zorgen dat de afspraken voldoen aan de Europese staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over maatregelen van Duitsland, Frankrijk en het Verenigd Koninkrijk om Amerikaanse secundaire sancties te omzeilen

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the minister about the German, French and British plan for a special purpose vehicle to circumvent US secondary sanctions on Iran, including Dutch participation and effectiveness for Dutch firms. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports and will join the technical work and possibly the SPV later, but that it is not a solution for firms active in the US market, leaving business decisions to companies.
If well elaborated, the Netherlands will in due course participate in the SPV to be set up.
Indien goed uitgewerkt zal Nederland t.z.t. participeren in de op te zetten SPV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de vestiging van een fabriek voor bio kerosine

An MP asked the minister whether a decision on a biokerosene factory is imminent, when the House will be informed, what the CE Delft study implies, and about timing, jobs and location. The minister said the investment is a private decision, promised a letter on aviation sustainability including biokerosene availability at Schiphol by 2022, and referred the remaining questions to that answer.
I therefore cannot make statements about whether and when a final decision will be taken regarding the biokerosene factory.
Ik kan dus geen uitspraken doen over of en wanneer er een definitieve beslissing zal vallen inzake de fabriek voor biokerosine.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de halfjaarcijfers van NS

MPs Ronnes and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about NS half-year results, including the 1% net return, the normrendement band and its history, the gap with the 7% target, and a 400 million euro working-capital swing linked to student transport payments. The government answered that the normrendement is 4%-6% since 2017, that the working-capital swing is mainly timing of the OV-studentenkaart payment, and that the state keeps a watchful eye on NS's return on equity.
The timing of payment by the state is therefore partly determinative of NS's working capital.
Het moment van uitbetaling door het Rijk is dus medebepalend voor de hoogte van het werkkapitaal van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat het spoor volgens ProRail vol begint te raken

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether ProRail's warning that the Dutch rail network is filling up, with a capacity problem possible within ten years, is accepted, and about capacity figures, the allocation process and whether extra track is useful. The state secretary answered that capacity cannot be stated as a single figure, pointed to planned measures (PHS, ERTMS, a future public transport outlook, and a review of the capacity allocation decree), and described the allocation procedure and complaint routes.
Capacity on the railway cannot be unambiguously expressed in a single figure.
De capaciteit op het spoor is niet eenduidig met een cijfer weer te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de veiligheid op rangeerterrein Kijfhoek in Zwijndrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about safety at the Kijfhoek shunting yard, including reports of ignored safety procedures and a claim that safety had been at risk for years. The state secretary acknowledged the seriousness of the incidents, said ILT has imposed intensified supervision and an independent external safety-culture investigation is being prepared, and rejected the claim of years-long unsafety.
In addition, the ILT has imposed intensified supervision regarding maintenance work on the rail infrastructure, for example in connection with fault repair.
Daarnaast heeft de ILT verscherpt toezicht ingesteld met betrekking tot de onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan de spoorweginfrastructuur in verband met bijvoorbeeld storingsherstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het beëindigen van vluchten naar Teheran door KLM en de gevolgen van Amerikaanse secundaire sancties

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked whether KLM's halt of Tehran flights and the US secondary sanctions on Iran are related, and what the sanctions mean for Dutch firms. The ministers answered that KLM's decision was commercial, that Dutch firms face reputational, financial and legal risks from extraterritorial US sanctions, and that the Netherlands opposes such extraterritoriality while the EU has adopted countermeasures.
The Dutch government is not involved in internal considerations and motives regarding the business operations of Dutch companies.
De Nederlandse overheid is niet betrokken bij interne overwegingen en beweegredenen t.a.v. bedrijfsvoering van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over zware ongevallen A67

MPs Von Martels and Amhaouch asked the minister about serious accidents on the A67 motorway in 2018, their causes and casualties, truck involvement, and short- and long-term safety measures. The minister said 2018 accident data is not yet available, gave 2017 figures and traffic data, and pointed to a broadened MIRT study with possible safety measures to be decided this autumn.
I cannot say anything about this at the moment.
Hierover kan ik op dit moment nog geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over Jumbojet op waterstof

An MP asked the minister about a press report on a hydrogen-powered jumbo jet and whether the government would pursue hydrogen aviation at EU level and with KLM. The minister answered that alternatives should be studied, that hydrogen is not an EU innovation priority, that NLR runs hydrogen aviation programmes, and that it would discuss support at European level without a specific KLM consultation.
I am willing to discuss at European level how this development can be supported and whether it could be given a place on the European innovation agenda.
Ik ben bereid om Europees te bespreken op welke wijze deze ontwikkeling kan worden ondersteund en een plaats zou kunnen krijgen op de Europese innovatie-agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over Smart Maintenance

MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the minister about signal faults and delays on the Amsterdam-Utrecht rail line, the number of signal faults in 2017 and 2018, diagnosis and repair times, and the role of Smart Maintenance. The state secretary answered that the May 2018 fault was caused by a defective ES-las, gave fault statistics and repair timings, and said ProRail is expected to pursue smart technologies and that a conditional fine was imposed on ProRail.
I note – based on the report on high-impact disruptions 2017 from NS and ProRail that I recently sent to the House – that
Ik constateer – op basis van de rapportage impactvolle verstoringen 2017 van NS en ProRail die ik onlangs naar de Kamer heb gestuurd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het kunnen bijhouden van de innovatierace door mkb’ers

Mr Amhaouch (CDA) asked whether SMEs in the metal sector can keep up with rapid digitalisation and robotisation, and whether innovation subsidy criteria should be broadened to cover process innovation. State Secretary Keijzer answered that government supports innovation broadly, that process innovation is already supported via MIT, WBSO and Invest-NL, and that the WBSO evaluation this year will examine process innovation.
This will be taken into account in the evaluation of the WBSO, which takes place this year.
Dit wordt in de evaluatie van de WBSO, die dit jaar plaatsvindt, meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over de berichten dat er snel hulp nodig is bij KLM en dat de Franse overheid niet van plan is Air France te redden

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that KLM needs quick help and that the French government will not rescue Air France, probing leadership risks, French influence, possible transfer of KLM assets to Paris, and the possibility of splitting the group. The minister answered that the leadership crisis is being addressed, that the Dutch public interest is safeguarded through informal contacts and board representation, that transfer to Paris is unlikely, and that he does not share the French minister's stance on a bailout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Von Martels over het omgaan met de mogelijkheden om deelplatforms te kunnen onderwerpen aan nationale regels

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether a 2018 EU Court ruling allowing member states to regulate taxi platforms changes Dutch policy on regulating sharing-economy platforms and their enforcement. The government replied that the ruling does not extend member-state freedom beyond existing taxi rules, that platform regulation requires case-by-case assessment, and that it pursues dialogue with platforms, a regulatory review by the ATR due in Q3 2018, and improved fiscal enforcement.
There is no reason to impose new rules on taxi platforms in the Netherlands.
Voor het opleggen van nieuwe regels aan taxiplatforms in Nederland is geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht “Schiphol teruggefloten door rechter”

MP Amhaouch asked the minister about a court ruling against Schiphol and the airport's capacity to handle passenger flows, and what changes had been made since summer 2017. The minister confirmed awareness, listed extra staffing, e-gate improvements and additional border police capacity, and said the 500,000 flight-movement agreement through 2020 is not up for discussion.
Various measures at the airport are being continued, but with a view to possible congestion in the coming summer, additional measures are also being implemented.
Verschillende maatregelen op de luchthaven worden gecontinueerd, maar met het oog op de mogelijke drukte in de komende zomer worden ook aanvullende maatregelen doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over de adviesaanvraag over de sluiting van Siemens Hengelo

MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about Siemens' works council request to close the profitable Hengelo plant, including whether the government would seek to influence the supervisory board. The minister said he is in contact with Siemens Nederland's management and Siemens AG, which committed to preserving jobs, but that the supervisory board makes its own judgement and he will not intervene in a strategic corporate decision beyond offering help.
The management boards of Siemens Nederland and Siemens AG are responsible for taking a strategic decision such as the proposed closure of Hengelo.
De directies van Siemens Nederland en Siemens AG zijn verantwoordelijk voor het nemen van een strategisch besluit als de voorgenomen sluiting van Hengelo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over trillingsoverlast door het spoor bij Rosmalen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about vibration nuisance from the raised railway line at Rosmalen, which residents say was caused by the 2010-2012 Zuid-Willemsvaart realignment works. The government answered that a postdiction study found it unlikely that vibrations rose by more than 30% overall, but that three homes may be affected, so mitigation options are being examined, and that the ministry remains in talks with residents.

Based on the postdiction study, I want to examine for three homes whether effective measures can be taken, because it cannot be ruled out that a noticeable increase in vibrations occurred due to the adjustment of the railway.

Op basis van het postdictie-onderzoek wil ik bij drie woningen onderzoeken of er doelmatige maatregelen te treffen zijn omdat niet is uit te sluiten dat hier een voelbare toename van trillingen is opgetreden door de aanpassing van het spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over het weigeren van de VVV-cadeaukaart, de positie van het lokale mkb en de geldigheidsdatum bij cadeaukaarten

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about shops refusing the new VVV gift card, the position of local SMEs, and unclear expiry dates on gift cards. The State Secretary answered that retailers and issuers set acceptance and validity terms themselves, that the consumer law framework applies with ACM oversight, and that no further rules are planned.
I am aware of reports like the above about the refusal of the VVV gift card in its new form, but I do not have precise data on its extent.
Mij is berichtgeving zoals bovenstaande over de weigering van de VVV-cadeaukaart in zijn nieuwe vorm bekend, maar precieze gegevens over de omvang hiervan heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de dreigende handelsoorlog tussen de Verenigde Staten en Europa

The MP asks the minister about the threatened US-EU trade war after US steel and aluminium tariffs, the size of Dutch trade exposure, and possible Dutch and EU responses. The minister answers that the EU is temporarily exempt, that trade policy is an exclusive EU competence, and that the government pursues dialogue and a permanent exemption while providing limited sector-level and legal detail.
This depends on the form and scope of the barriers.
Dit hangt af van de vorm en reikwijdte van de barrières.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat ProRail supersnelle treinen tussen Maastricht en Leeuwarden en de Randstad, zonder stops, wil realiseren

MP Amhaouch asked the State Secretary about press reports that ProRail wants non-stop superfast trains between Maastricht or Leeuwarden and the Randstad, asking about the basis, funding, business case and timeline. The State Secretary answered that the ideas were floated by ProRail in a press interview, that no concrete business case exists, that they will be assessed within the Toekomstbeeld OV 2040 process, and that no concrete plan or timetable is known.
A concrete business case for a non-stop train between the Randstad and Maastricht or Leeuwarden has not been developed by ProRail.
Een concrete businesscase voor een non-stop trein tussen de Randstad en Maastricht of Leeuwarden is niet bij ProRail ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de verhuizing van het Galileo Security Monitoring Centre naar Spanje

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked why the Galileo Security Monitoring Centre back-up was moved to Spain, whether the Netherlands bid, and the consequences for Dutch and British space sectors and future EU-UK cooperation. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands considered but declined to bid, Spain's bid scored best on objective criteria, and future EU-UK space cooperation is part of the ongoing Brexit negotiations.
The European Commission assessed the bids of the various member states on the basis of objective criteria.
De Europese Commissie heeft op basis van objectieve criteria de biedingen van de verschillende lidstaten beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts, Omtzigt, Von Martels en Slootweg over transparantie regionaal BO van 18 december 2017 en Alderstafel Lelystad Airport

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about transparency of the regional administrative consultation of 18 December 2017, whether minutes and agenda would be public, the remaining steps before the environmental impact report, and the evaluation of the Schiphol advisory council. The Minister confirmed the importance of transparency but declined to publish the minutes of the 18 December consultation for now, citing confidential input from provincial officials, and promised further consultation and a letter to parliament in early February.
Therefore I will not yet make the minutes of the administrative consultation of 18 December 2017 public at this time.
Derhalve zal ik het verslag van het bestuurlijk overleg van 18 december 2017 op dit moment nog niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over winterweer op het spoor

An MP asked the minister about around 60 switch failures caused by winter weather on the Dutch rail network, the winter measures ProRail can take, the effectiveness of measures taken, the rollout of heated switches, the Gouda and Amersfoort disruptions, and why reduced timetables and trains were not extended. The state secretary answered that ProRail was not ready in time for the winter season, that about 50 to 70 heated switch failures occurred, that the omission will be addressed in the annual evaluation which will be shared with parliament, and that reduced timetables and train lengthening were applied as explained.
I will also share this evaluation with your House.
Deze evaluatie zal ik ook met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Jetten over wisselstoringen op het spoor door het winterweer in december

MPs Amhaouch and Jetten asked the state secretary about rail switch failures during the December 2017 winter weather, including preparation, back-up plans, evaluation, information provision and oversight of ProRail and NS. The state secretary said the cause cannot yet be determined pending the evaluation by ProRail and NS, committed to sending evaluations to parliament, and argued that internalised winter practices make ministerial steering a premature conclusion to draw.
I think it is premature to draw this conclusion. I will first await the evaluation by NS and ProRail, the lessons they draw from it and the changes they will make to their approach.

Ik vind het te voorbarig om deze conclusie te trekken. Ik wacht eerst de evaluatie van NS en ProRail af, de lessen die ze op basis daarvan trekken en de wijzigingen die ze in hun aanpak gaan doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of a hard Brexit for the Netherlands, including the KPMG report on non-tariff trade barriers, planned actions, customs and inspection capacity, and information provision to businesses. The government answered that it is intensifying business information, hiring extra customs and NVWA staff, and that the cost of a hard Brexit is estimated at about 1.2% of GDP, while stressing that the EU-UK arrangements are still under negotiation.
The precise effect on employment is difficult to estimate, because trade can also shift to other countries and new jobs can therefore also arise.
Het precieze effect op de werkgelegenheid is moeilijk in te schatten, omdat handel zich ook kan verplaatsten naar andere landen en er dus ook weer nieuwe banen kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de brandbrief aan de directie van de Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL)

MP Amhaouch asked the minister about a letter from air traffic controllers to the LVNL management raising concerns, and whether safety and implementation of OVV recommendations are at stake. The minister answered that it is primarily an internal LVNL matter, that safety is not currently in question according to LVNL, the Gilde and ILT supervision, and that the minister monitors the situation and will keep parliament informed.
I regard this primarily as an internal matter at Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL).
Ik beschouw dit primair als een interne aangelegenheid bij Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over de toekomst van de vestiging Siemens in Hengelo (Overijssel)

Two CDA MPs asked the economy minister whether Siemens' Hengelo site will stay open under the Siemens name, whether Siemens Germany has been persuaded to keep jobs, and what the government is doing to save the business. The minister confirmed ongoing talks with Siemens, said serious buyers are interested, but withheld details of the scenarios and buyers, citing the sensitivity of the process.
In the interest of this process, it is not possible to make further statements about this.
In het belang van dit proces is het niet mogelijk daar verdere mededelingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het sluiten van Siemens Hengelo

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Siemens' announced closure of its Hengelo plant with 600 jobs at stake, including whether the ministry knew earlier and what action it would take to keep the plant. The minister answered that the ministry was surprised by the announcement, is in close contact with Siemens and has asked it to keep the site, and will take an active role with the province and municipality if a useful role for government emerges.
I am in close contact with Siemens and have asked for the site to be retained.
Ik sta in nauw contact met Siemens en heb gevraagd om behoud van de vestiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Bruins en Kröger over Lelystad

Five MPs asked the minister about press reports that former state secretary Dijksma criticised the ministry's capacity to handle the complex Lelystad Airport dossier, including the environmental impact assessment (MER). The minister acknowledged the reports, said the ministry has capable staff but needs extra expertise, and said the remarks do not affect the planned new MER assessment.
The ministry has competent and committed staff.
Het ministerie beschikt over kundige en betrokken medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de consequentie van Basel IV regels voor het financieringsmechanisme ten behoeve van ontwikkelingssamenwerking

CDA MPs asked whether Basel IV capital rules would deter bank financing of development countries and sought measures to protect such lending. The government answered that the Basel framework is risk-based without geographic distinction, that negotiations are ongoing, and that it would consider the EU implementation and impact assessment before setting its position.
It is not yet certain that higher capital requirements for investments in developing countries will be a result of the new Basel Committee regulation.
Het staat echter nog niet vast dat een verhoging van kapitaaleisen voor investeringen in ontwikkelingslanden een resultante van de nieuwe regelgeving van het Bazelse comité zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Von Martels over CETA en het succes van de op de Canadese markt aanwezige genetisch gemodificeerde zalm

Two CDA MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade whether genetically modified salmon sold in Canada could reach the Dutch market under CETA, and how origin labelling and EU rules apply. The minister answered that GM animals and derived products are not authorised in the EU, that export to the EU is not allowed, that CETA contains no provisions on GM fish and changes nothing to EU GMO rules, and that EU labelling rules make fish origin traceable.
CETA contains no agreements on EU imports of genetically modified fish.
In CETA zijn geen afspraken gemaakt over de EU-import van genetisch gemodificeerde vis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Keijzer over het bericht dat medicijnenproductie verdwijnt uit Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Health ministers about reports that medicine production is leaving the Netherlands, its consequences for innovation and jobs, and how supply shortages would be prevented. The minister answered that production has been largely abroad for years, that Nederland specialises in R&D, that topsector policy and acquisition efforts continue, and that the medicines register and shortage reporting body would monitor any relocation.
The largest part of medicine production has been taking place outside the Netherlands for a very long time.
Het grootste deel van de geneesmiddelenproductie vindt al heel lang buiten Nederland plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht Nederland moet ook Duitse diploma’s erkennen
