Three CDA MPs asked the education minister about calls for mutual recognition of Dutch and German (NRW) diplomas, cross-border vocational programmes and Euregio schools. The minister said recognition in higher education is largely settled, that trust in vocational (mbo) diplomas is still lacking, that bilateral and Benelux talks continue, and that new cross-border mbo programmes would require legislative change only once internationalisation policy matures.
Our policy starting point is that mutual acceptance of diplomas in higher education is well arranged, through earlier EU and Benelux actions.
Ons beleidsuitgangspunt daarbij is dat de wederzijdse acceptatie van diploma's in het hoger onderwijs goed geregeld is, door eerdere acties van de EU en de Benelux.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Amhaouch over de afbraak en inbeslagname van door Nederland gefinancierd zonne-energie project door Israël

MPs Knops and Amhaouch asked whether Israeli authorities demolished and largely confiscated a Dutch-funded solar project in Jubbet adh Dhib without notice, and about its harm, legal obligations, and Dutch and EU responses. The ministers confirmed the demolition, reported about 40,000 euro in damage, said Israel has promised to return the panels after Dutch protests, and noted ongoing talks and EU coordination.
Prime Minister Netanyahu has informed the Netherlands by letter that the panels will be returned to the Netherlands.
Premier Netanyahu heeft per brief laten weten dat de panelen teruggegeven zullen worden aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de berichten “Vakkracht blijft schaars” en “Schreeuw om vakkracht”

The MP Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the shortage of skilled workers, cross-border labour mobility, reshoring, vmbo-mbo cooperation, technical education trends, student choice and a national labour market monitor. The ministers answered by describing the Techniekpact, the Actieteam GEA, reshoring policy, regional investment and cooperation programmes, and existing information tools, without addressing executive oversight.
The Techniekpact is intended to improve the alignment of science and technology education with the labour market and thereby reduce the shortage of science and technology personnel.
Het Techniekpact is bedoeld om de aansluiting van het bètatechnische onderwijs op de arbeidsmarkt verbeteren en daarmee het tekort aan bètatechnisch personeel terugdringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over kleinschalige experimenten op het gebied van innovatief ondernemerschap

An MP (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about whether innovation policy is effective, the scope for small-scale experiments and legal room to exempt innovators from regulation. The minister answered that evaluation methods are adequate, that experiments are welcome with methodological caveats, and that existing legal frameworks are being reviewed without committing to new powers.
I cannot agree with the finding that good experiments hardly get off the ground.
Ik kan mij niet vinden in de constatering dat goede experimenten amper van de grond komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de onhoudbare situatie aangaande de cholera-epidemie in Jemen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the cholera epidemic in Yemen, including the scale of infections, funding levels, obstacles to aid and whether the UN Security Council and the UK should act more. The minister answered that the Netherlands contributes humanitarian aid and water programmes, has no specific cholera budget, and that the Netherlands will press partners and the Security Council, with no new binding commitments.
No specific budget has been allocated to combating the cholera epidemic.
Er is geen specifiek budget toegekend aan de bestrijding van de cholera-epidemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de ‘Vrienden van de Industrie’

An MP asked why the Netherlands did not join the Friends of Industry coalition and whether it would do so, and how it intends to influence the upcoming EU industrial strategy. The minister explained that the Netherlands was present but did not co-sign due to opposition to the 20% industrial share target, and outlined its general EU industrial policy approach without committing to joining.
The Netherlands does not support this target because the services sector is not included and, through servitisation, the distinction between manufacturing and services is increasingly blurring.

Nederland steunt deze inzet niet omdat de dienstensector hier niet in mee wordt genomen en door «servitisation» het onderscheid tussen maakindustrie en dienstverlening steeds verder aan het vervagen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over voedsel- en landbouwbeleid voor Caraïbisch Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked about food and agriculture policy for the Caribbean Netherlands, given trade deficits and high food prices, and whether UPG status could help. The government answered that agriculture is primarily the islands' own responsibility, supported by a modest EUR 150,000 per year fund, and that UPG status would bring limited benefits and substantial burdens.
It is therefore primarily up to the islands themselves to give substance to this.
Het is daarmee primair aan de eilanden zelf om hier invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van der Molen over toegepast onderzoek in Nederland

MPs Amhaouch and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the cuts to applied research institutes (TO2) were compensated by innovation subsidies and private contracts, and what the ministry does to help these institutes win market work and keep room for societal research. The minister answered that public-private partnership via the topsector agendas and the PPS-toeslag is the policy, that the cuts were absorbed in topsector support and thematic research while statutory tasks were protected, and that a substantive reply on the TO2 evaluation will follow later.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Amhaouch over het opleiden van asbestsaneerders en het plan van aanpak asbestsanering

MPs Geurts and Amhaouch (CDA) asked whether there are enough certified asbestos removers to clear all asbestos roofs by 2024, how many roofs remain, how many certified workers exist and how many were trained, and whether asbestos awareness should be built into basic construction training. The State Secretary answers that the 2024 deadline is feasible if work is spread over years, that about 100 million m2 of asbestos roof remains, that certified worker numbers rose sharply since 2013, and that asbestos is not a standard part of vocational construction curricula but schools can choose to address it, with no additional funding planned.
It is unknown in what percentage of all rental homes and public buildings asbestos-containing applications are still present.
Het is onbekend in hoeveel procent van alle huurwoningen en openbare gebouwen nog asbesthoudende toepassingen aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het artikel “Vergeefse zoektocht naar stemmen per bureau”

MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked the Interior Minister about reported counting errors in the 2017 election, the restricted inspection and non-copying of polling-station records, retention and publication of those records, and handmade counting. The minister answered that the procedures follow the Kieswet, that the credentials committee found no grounds for a recount, that an evaluation will be completed before summer recess, and that the records are retained for three months, though he could not publish or collect them himself.
The Kieswet does not allow the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to collect or publish the polling-station records.
De Kieswet staat niet toe dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties de processen-verbaal verzamelt of publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nieuwe generatie IT-bedrijven klaagt over gebrek aan opdrachten van overheid’

MPs Amhaouch and Mulder asked whether government awards few contracts to Dutch web and digital agencies, and whether consultants should be encouraged to partner with them. The minister replied that 65 DDA member firms received about 112 million euro in Rijk contracts over 2010-2015, that no European ICT tender in 2016 was awarded to DDA members, and that a meeting with DDA would be organised to discuss possible barriers.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will, together with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, organise a conversation with DDA to discuss any possible barriers.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal in samenwerking met het Ministerie van Economische Zaken een gesprek met DDA organiseren om eventuele blokkades te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat de installatiebranche een tekort van 15.000 vakmensen in de komende vier jaar verwacht

MPs Amhaouch and Heerma (CDA) asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports of a 15,000-worker shortage in the installation sector, including whether this threatens the Energy Agreement, whether training should be made more widely available, and whether training funds should be opened up across sectors. The minister answered that the 3,000 annual vacancies are UNETO-VNI's own projection consistent with UWV expectations, that the Energy Agreement targets remain within reach, and that existing Techniekpact cooperation makes a separate taskforce or cao consultation unnecessary.
The figure of 3,000 annual vacancies cited by the chairman of UNETO-VNI is based by UNETO-VNI on an expected 3% annual growth in employment in the installation sector.

Het door de voorzitter van UNETO-VNI genoemde aantal van 3.000 vacatures op jaarbasis is door UNETO-VNI gebaseerd op een verwachte groei van de werkgelegenheid in de installatiebranche van 3% per jaar
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over intolerantie jegens religieuze instellingen

CDA MPs asked the Justice Minister whether arson at a planned mosque in Culemborg and vandalism at a church in Utrecht reflect intolerance toward religious institutions, how many such incidents occurred in 2016, and whether online racist reactions are pursued. The minister declined to judge the open cases, said incidents are not registered by religion, noted no reports were filed about online discrimination, and committed to pursuing perpetrators.
I have received the report that an investigation has been started in both cases.
Ik heb het bericht ontvangen dat er in beide gevallen een onderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch inzake het bericht 'Kiezen voor Technologie'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about the reported drop in funding for the 'Kiezen voor Technologie' science and technology programme in primary schools, and the consequences for provision and the national budget. The government answers that the programme was a temporary stimulus, that about 2.2 million euro is available for regional networks in 2017 falling to 1.4 million by 2020, and that schools receive regular funding and a 65 million euro increase in the prestatiebox for science and technology.
Is it correct that the financial support for WTE falls from 6 million euro to 1.5 million euro in 2017?
Klopt het dat de financiële ondersteuning voor WTE in 2017 daalt van 6 miljoen euro naar 1,5 miljoen euro?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het artikel 'Veel overheidssites hebben geen beveiligde verbinding'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a news report that many government websites lack secure connections. The minister said security depends on whether sensitive data is exchanged, outlined TLS adoption targets and monitoring, and noted that the Data Protection Authority supervises compliance.
The picture painted in the media that connections to many government websites are not well secured deserves some nuance.
Het in de media geschetste beeld dat de verbindingen naar veel overheidswebsites niet goed beveiligd zijn, verdient enige nuance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Bruins Slot en Amhaouch over het bericht dat een verwarde man in de boeien is geslagen

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a report of a confused man being hit while handcuffed, whether the police apology was appropriate, and the state of municipal care for confused persons. The minister answered that the matter is covered in a separate letter, that the Aanjaagteam found in September 2016 that no municipality had a well-implemented integrated approach, and that the Schakelteam will monitor progress and share results with parliament.
The Schakelteam has been tasked with promoting and monitoring progress towards an integrated approach.
Het Schakelteam heeft als opdracht meegekregen de voortgang van de sluitende aanpak te bevorderen en te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Amhaouch en Knops over ziekenhuizen in Limburg die operaties moeten uitstellen omdat ze door de jaarvergoeding heen zijn

MPs asked whether Limburg hospitals such as VieCuri, AZM, Laurentius and Sint Jans Gasthuis had exhausted annual budgets and postponed operations, and how insurers and the NZa ensure patient information and waiting-time norms. The minister said she lacks insight into individual hospitals' finances, placed responsibility on hospitals and insurers, and pointed to NZa supervision of insurer information duties.
I have no insight into the financial situation of individual hospitals.
Ik heb geen zicht op de financiële situatie van individuele ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Andere zorgen over kerncentrale Tihange’

MPs from the CDA asked whether it is alarming that safety plans of the Tihange nuclear plant were publicly accessible online, whether the minister will raise this with Belgium, and what cyber-security rules apply. The minister agreed it is alarming, said the ANVS has discussed it with Belgium's FANC and will raise it with his Belgian counterpart, and described existing nuclear cyber-security rules and reporting obligations.
I will also do so when I am in contact with my Belgian colleague Jambon.
Ik zal dit ook doen als ik contact heb met mijn Belgische collega Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Amhaouch over het bericht dat TU Eindhoven zich nu ook genoodzaakt voelt om voor vier studies een numerus fixus in te stellen

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about TU Eindhoven's plan to introduce numerus fixus for four programmes, and whether this, together with other technical programmes' caps, reflects funding problems and a shortage of technical graduates. The Minister said TU Eindhoven will only examine numerus fixus for 2018-2019, denied a tripling of caps, explained the funding model, rejected claims about per-student costs and falling budgets, and placed part of the responsibility for graduates' career choices on employers while agreeing to talks with universities and industry.
Question 11: Are you willing to hold talks with universities and representatives from the top sectors to seek a solution? Answer 11: Yes.
Vraag 11 Bent u bereid om gesprekken aan te gaan met universiteiten en afgevaardigden vanuit de topsectoren om een oplossing te zoeken?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Botsing Aruba en Nederland over gouverneur’

An MP asked whether the Rijksministerraad appointed a governor of Aruba without a nomination from Aruba, and whether the nomination followed the legal and administrative framework. The minister answered that the appointment followed the Statute and procedures, that no Aruban recommendation with support had emerged after the term expired, and that Aruba's government accepts the appointment for the sake of Kingdom relations.
The appointment decision was therefore lawfully made.
Het benoemingsbesluit is aldus rechtmatig tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘FME: numerus fixus is omgekeerde wereld’

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister why technical universities are introducing a numerus fixus despite past extra funding and the Techniekpact goal of more technical students. The minister answered that quality comes first, that a temporary numerus fixus can be justified, that institutions are autonomous, and that she will keep talking with the technical universities.
This first of all fits with the autonomy of the institutions themselves to shape their own (financial) policy well.
Het past in de eerste plaats bij de autonomie van de instellingen zelf om hun eigen (financiële) beleid goed vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over financiering van de referendum campagne in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked the government about foreign and undisclosed funding of the 2016 Dutch referendum campaign, including donor disclosure rules, GRECO recommendations on foreign donations, and contacts with George Soros's organisations. Minister Plasterk answered that party donations above EUR 4,500 are disclosed, no rules exist on foreign donations or referendum-period disclosure, the government had no direct contact with Soros, and the referendum subsidy audit is still ongoing.
I do not have overviews of organisations or persons who spent more than EUR 4,500 on campaign activities for the referendum of 6 April.
Ik beschik niet over overzichten van instanties of personen die meer dan € 4.500 hebben uitgegeven aan campagneactiviteiten voor het referendum van 6 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht "Binnenlandse zaken paait grote gemeenten"

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes (CDA) asked the Minister of the Interior why he adopted a 33% redistribution step in the municipal fund subcluster VHROSV despite advice from the Rfv and VNG favouring full implementation, and whether he would reconsider or monitor actual costs. The Minister defended the decision as consistent with the VNG's May advice, citing open ends in the research, and said the fundamental review of the municipal fund is underway with cost monitoring feeding into it.

With this decision, which follows the VNG advice from May of this year, I have weighed the research results differently than the Rfv and the motion adopted by a narrow majority at the VNG general members meeting.

Ik ben met dit besluit, dat aansluit bij het VNG advies uit mei van dit jaar, tot een andere weging gekomen van de resultaten van het onderzoek dan de Rfv en de met een nipte meerderheid aangenomen motie op de Algemene ledenvergadering van de VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht in De Telegraaf van 6 april 2016 ‘Platteland eist groter deel rijksuitkering’

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked about a Telegraaf report that rural municipalities demand a larger share of the state fund, and about AEF's recommendation to redistribute EUR 88 million toward smaller municipalities. Minister Plasterk answered that the fund managers adopted only one third of the new formula for 2016, that full implementation would shift funds toward rural municipalities, and that a decision will follow after consulting the Rfv and VNG without giving a firm date.
In deciding how the fund managers handle the study's results, the advice received from the Rfv and VNG will be taken into account.
Bij de besluitvorming over hoe de fondsbeheerders met de resultaten van het onderzoek omgaan worden de ontvangen adviezen van de Rfv en VNG betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Afschaffen gebruikersdeel OZB blijkt sterk nadelig voor 270 eigenaren van niet-woningen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether abolishing the user component of the municipal property tax (OZB) for non-residential properties, as done in Lelystad, unfairly burdens owners of business premises with a residential part, and whether this conflicts with a 2006 parliamentary amendment. The minister confirmed the abolition is a local choice, that the burden shift is a consequence of how municipalities finance it, and that municipalities are autonomous and may mitigate the effect, but did not commit to new measures.
They are autonomous in this and can best decide what suits local needs.
Zij zijn daarin autonoom en kunnen het best besluiten wat aansluit bij de lokale behoeften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch en Geurts over ontheffing lengte samenstel van landbouwtrekkers en aanhangwagen(s)

MPs from the CDA asked why the RDW cannot grant exemptions for tractor-trailer combinations longer than 18.75 metres, whether enforcement is underway, and whether the RDW's mandate should be widened. The minister confirmed the 18.75 m limit (aligned with EU Directive 96/53/EG), said there is no national enforcement campaign though regional checks occurred, and declined to widen the RDW's mandate because exemptions fall to provincial or municipal road authorities.
The authority to grant an incidental exemption, for example for an indivisible load, lies with the provincial or municipal road authority.
De bevoegdheid om een incidentele ontheffing verlenen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om een ondeelbare lading, ligt bij de provinciale of gemeentelijke wegbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Kosten opruimen drugsafval Brabant in kaart gebracht’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about rising drug waste dumping in Brabant and Limburg, the costs for municipalities, and how national funds are allocated. The Minister confirmed rising dumpings, said municipalities' costs are several million euros per province, committed €1 million a year for cofinancing cleanup in 2015–2017, and explained the provincial allocation convenant.
To ease the cost problem, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment makes available €1 million annually in 2015–2017 for cofinancing the cleanup of drug waste dumpings (maximum 50% of costs).

Om het probleem van de kosten te verzachten stelt het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu in de periode 2015–2017 jaarlijks € 1 miljoen beschikbaar voor cofinanciering van de opruiming van drugsafvaldumpingen (maximaal 50% van de kosten).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Amhaouch over onterechte reputatieschade van bestuurders van het Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire

MPs Agnes Mulder and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers whether the SEO report on governance at Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire unjustly damaged the reputations of its board members, and questioned the handling of the tender and the decision to build the wind-diesel plant. Minister Kamp answers that the SEO conclusions on governance shortcomings were confirmed by the Landsadvocaat and Mazars, that the tender produced one bid, that no criminal referral is warranted, and that no apology is due.
As appears from the answer to question 9, the investigations were not carried out unjustly.
Zoals uit het antwoord op vraag 9 blijkt, zijn de onderzoeken niet onterecht uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over de voorlopige toepassing van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked how long the EU-Ukraine association agreement could stay provisionally applied if it never enters into force, which parts fall under exclusive EU competence, and whether a narrower EU-only agreement is being considered. Minister Koenders answered that non-ratification is uncharted territory, outlined the EU competence rules in general terms without a definitive list of articles, and said no such overlegs on an EU-only alternative had taken place while the agreement remains the best basis for cooperation.
The association agreement does not specify which provisions fall under the exclusive competences of the EU.
Het associatieakkoord specificeert niet welke bepalingen vallen onder de exclusieve bevoegdheden van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over “de puinhoop bij het toekennen van subsidies voor het referendum op 6 april 2016”

CDA MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked why only three subsidy applications for the 6 April 2016 advisory referendum had been granted despite a three-week decision deadline, and sought data on delays, form errors, costs and fairness. Minister Plasterk answered that 73 applications had been granted, that the independent Referendum Commission is responsible for the subsidy scheme and will evaluate it after the summer recess, and that he has full confidence in its decision-making.
The Referendum Act chose to entrust this task to an independent Referendum Commission.
In de Wet raadgevend referendum is er voor gekozen deze taak in handen te geven aan een onafhankelijke Referendumcommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Amhaouch over privacybelemmeringen bij de uitwisseling van bijzondere persoonsgegevens van prostituees ten behoeve van een intakegesprek
