verzoekt de regering de internationale en regionale interseksebeweging in Europa, Afrika en Azië te ondersteunen
Motie van de leden Hammelburg en Van der Lee over alle handels- en exportinstrumentaria voor eind 2022 in lijn brengen met Parijs en Glasgow
Motion asking the cabinet to align all trade and export instruments with the Paris and Glasgow climate agreements by end-2022 and to report progress to the Chamber.
requests the cabinet to fully align all trade and export instruments with Paris and Glasgow by the end of 2022
verzoekt het kabinet om alle handels- en exportinstrumentaria voor het einde van 2022 geheel in lijn te brengen met Parijs en Glasgow
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over het in beeld brengen van de behoefte, kansen en bedreigingen omtrent praktisch en technisch geschoold personeel in Europa
Asks the minister to map the need for and opportunities regarding practically and technically trained staff in Europe.
requests the Minister to map the needs, opportunities and threats regarding practically and technically trained personnel in Europe
verzoekt de Minister de behoefte, kansen en bedreigingen omtrent praktisch en technisch geschoold personeel in Europa in beeld te brengen
Motie van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over onderzoeken hoe klimaatinvesteringen maximaal ten goede komen aan de armste landen
Asks the cabinet to examine how existing climate finance instruments can be adjusted so that climate investments benefit the poorest countries most.
requests the cabinet to examine how existing instruments can be adjusted so that climate investments benefit the poorest countries maximally
verzoekt het kabinet te onderzoeken hoe het bestaande instrumentarium kan worden bijgestuurd zodat klimaatinvesteringen maximaal ten goede komen aan de armste landen
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over aanvullende middelen voor het Civic Space Fund

Amendment moves 7.5 million euros from the peace, security and sustainable development article to the social progress article, earmarked for the Civic Space Fund supporting civil society organisations.
The funds released by this amendment are earmarked for the Civic Space Fund.
De met dit amendement vrijgemaakte middelen zijn bestemd voor het Civic Space Fund .
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over de ROM's blijvend extra ondersteunen in de facilitering van de internationalisering van het mkb
Asks the Minister to continue extra support for regional development companies in helping SMEs internationalise.
requests the Minister to continue to extra support the ROMs in facilitating SME internationalisation
verzoekt de Minister de ROM's blijvend extra te ondersteunen in de facilitering van de internationalisering van het mkb
Motie van het lid Piri c.s. over een implementatieplan gendermainstreaming
Asks the government to draft an implementation plan for gender mainstreaming aligned with the EU Gender Action Plan.
requests the government to draw up an implementation plan for gender mainstreaming in line with the EU Gender Action Plan criteria
verzoekt de regering een implementatieplan gendermainstreaming op te stellen conform de criteria van het EU Gender Action Plan
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over in het Integraal Afwegingskader de SDG-toets meenemen bij wetsvoorstellen van de vijf belangrijkste coherentieministeries
Asks that the SDG test be applied by default to bills from the five main policy coherence ministries within the Integral Assessment Framework.
requests the government to include the SDG test by default in the Integral Assessment Framework for bills where side effects are desired
verzoekt de regering om in het Integraal Afwegingskader (IAK) bij gewenste neveneffecten de SDG-toets standaard mee te nemen bij wetsvoorstellen
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over aanvullende middelen voor het Civic Space Fund
Shifts 7.5 million euros within the budget from the defence-related foreign policy article to the civil society article to fund the Civic Space Fund.
Submitters wish with this amendment to allocate 7.5 million euros to the funds for article 3.3 Civil Society.
Indieners wensen met dit amendement € 7,5 miljoen toe te kennen aan de middelen voor artikel 3.3 Maatschappelijk Middenveld.
Motie van het lid Klink c.s. over internationaal actieve mkb'ers ook gebruik laten maken van fondsen
Asks the government to let internationally active SMEs also use funds such as Invest International, not only bank-linked financing.
requests the government to also let internationally active SMEs make use of funds such as Invest International
verzoekt de regering om internationaal actieve mkb'ers ook gebruik te laten maken van fondsen als Invest International
Motie van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over het versterken van lokaal eigenaarschap en contextspecifieke programmering
Asks the government to strengthen local ownership and context-specific programming in development aid, for example via embassies and NGO partners.
requests the government to strengthen local ownership and context-specific programming, for example via our embassies and NGO partners
verzoekt de regering om lokaal eigenaarschap en contextspecifieke programmering, bijvoorbeeld via onze ambassades en ngo-partners, te versterken
Motie van het lid Koekkoek c.s. over een voortrekkersrol spelen bij de inzet voor jongerenparticipatie, -onderwijs en -werkgelegenheid
Asks the government to take a leading role in promoting youth participation, education and employment in the EU-Africa partnership.
requests the government to take a leading role in efforts on youth participation, education and employment
verzoekt de regering om een voortrekkersrol te spelen bij de inzet voor jongerenparticipatie, -onderwijs en -werkgelegenheid
Motie van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over het mobiliseren van steun voor COVAX vanuit het bedrijfsleven
Asks the government to mobilise financial and technical support for COVAX from Dutch businesses.
requests the government to mobilise financial and technical support for COVAX from the Dutch business sector
verzoekt de regering financiële en technische steun aan COVAX te mobiliseren vanuit het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over de ondersteuning van de huidige IMVO-convenanten continueren
Asks the government to continue its support for and involvement in existing IMVO covenants for the agreed term and to finish a new sectoral cooperation instrument.
requests the government to continue its support for and involvement in the current IMVO covenants for the agreed term
verzoekt de regering de ondersteuning van en betrokkenheid bij de huidige IMVO-convenanten voor de afgesproken looptijd te continueren
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over aanvullende middelen voor het Civic Space Fund
Shifts €7.5 million from the foreign aid article on international affairs to the civil society budget line for the Civic Space Fund to support civil society organisations hit by COVID-19.
The submitters wish to allocate €7.5 million to the funds for article 3.3 Civil Society via this amendment.
Indieners wensen met dit amendement € 7,5 miljoen toe te kennen aan de middelen voor artikel 3.3 Maatschappelijk Middenveld.
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over aanvullende middelen voor het Civic Space Fund
Shifts 7.5 million euro in the aid budget from article 4 to article 3 to fund civil society organisations via the Civic Space Fund.
The submitters wish with this amendment to allocate 7.5 million euros to the funds for article 3.3 Civil Society.
Indieners wensen met dit amendement € 7,5 miljoen toe te kennen aan de middelen voor artikel 3.3 Maatschappelijk Middenveld.
Motie van de leden Hammelburg en Grinwis over het monitoren van oneigenlijk gebruik van het lage winstbelastingtarief
Asks the government to monitor how companies structure themselves to misuse the low profit tax rate and to propose measures if monitoring warrants it.
requests the government to monitor the scale and manner in which structures are created that improperly use the low profit tax rate
verzoekt de regering te monitoren op welke schaal en wijze wordt gestructureerd waardoor op oneigenlijke wijze gebruik wordt gemaakt van het lage winstbelastingtarief
Motie van het lid Hammelburg over een jaarlijkse rapportage over de belastingdruk op verschillende vermogenssamenstellingen
Motion asking the government to report annually on tax burden across different wealth compositions and household types.
requests the government to report annually on the tax burden on different types of wealth compositions
verzoekt de regering jaarlijks te rapporteren over de belastingdruk op verschillende typen vermogenssamenstellingen
Motie van het lid Nijboer c.s. over onderzoeken hoe een Penparade over vermogen er voor Nederland uitziet
Asks the cabinet to investigate what a wealth Penparade would show for the Netherlands.
requests the cabinet to (have) investigate what the Penparade on wealth looks like for the Netherlands
verzoekt het kabinet te (laten) onderzoeken hoe de Penparade over vermogen er voor Nederland uitziet
Motie van de leden Inge van Dijk en Hammelburg over een appreciatie van de gevolgen van moties en amendementen voor de complexiteit van wetgeving
Asks the government to state, when appreciating tax motions and amendments, their effects on legislative complexity, implementation and implementation timing.
requests the government, when appreciating motions and amendments on taxes, to indicate where relevant what consequences they have for the complexity of legislation
verzoekt de regering bij de appreciatie van moties en amendementen in verband met belastingen, waar relevant, aan te geven welke gevolgen deze hebben voor de complexiteit van wetgeving
Motie van het lid Hammelburg over de Kamer informeren over noodzakelijke wetsaanpassingen naar aanleiding van een internationaal winstbelastingakkoord
Motion asking the government to inform the House promptly about Dutch law changes needed after an international minimum profit tax agreement.
requests the government, directly after concluding an international agreement on a minimum profit tax rate, to inform the House which national legislation needs amending
verzoekt de regering direct na het afsluiten van een internationaal akkoord over een minimumwinstbelastingtarief de Kamer te informeren welke nationale wetgeving aanpassing vergt
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over jaarlijks een paragraaf over de status van ICT bij de Belastingdienst aan het Belastingplanpakket toevoegen

Asks the government to add an annual section on the status of the Tax Authority's ICT systems and capacity to each tax bill package, including the ICT impact of proposals, so parliament has better information.
requests the government to add annually to the tax bill package a section on the status of ICT at the Tax Authority
verzoekt de regering jaarlijks bij het pakket belastingplan een paragraaf toe te voegen over de status van de ICT bij de Belastingdienst
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Hammelburg ter vervanging van nr. 6 over een evaluatie binnen drie jaar
Adds an evaluation clause requiring the Minister of Finance to report to Parliament within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the delegation act.
The Minister of Finance sends to the States General within three years after entry into force a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.
Onze Minister van Financiën zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hammelburg, Piri, Van der Lee en Dassen  over ‘De Russische oorlog tegen Oekraïne is eenpraktijkexamen voor Europa – en de tijd begint te dringen’

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and Volt asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government sees risks to US military aid to Ukraine from congressional gridlock and a possible 2024 US administration cutting support, and whether Europe can cover any shortfall. The government answered that US, European and international support remains essential, that a new House speaker has been appointed, that Europe must take more responsibility, and that it will continue support in consultation with allies while F-16 transfer and munitions decisions depend on training, infrastructure, US export approval and EU criteria.
The cabinet will continue to support Ukraine for as long as necessary.
Het kabinet blijft Oekraïne steunen zolang als dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sneller, Wassenberg en Bromet over het bericht dat prins Bernhard lid was van de NSDAP

Four MPs asked the Prime Minister how he views reports that Prince Bernhard had an NSDAP membership card, and whether he would support a CIDI call for research into the prince's Nazi-era past. The Prime Minister acknowledged the reports and said the information was already publicly known from accessible archives, and that further research will become possible at the Royal House Archive from early 2024 by extending access to 1948.
From the beginning of 2024, further research can be carried out in the Royal House Archive by extending access to the year 1948.
Met ingang van begin 2024 kan verder onderzoek worden verricht in het Koninklijk Huisarchief door verruiming van de toegang tot in het jaar 1948.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de aardbevingen in Afghanistan

MPs asked about the humanitarian needs after the October 2023 Herat earthquakes in Afghanistan, and whether Dutch aid could be provided without supporting the Taliban. The minister listed needs and aid channels (Dutch Relief Alliance, CERF, OCHA fund, EU funding) and stated that aid runs under strict conditions barring direct Taliban involvement.
They work in line with humanitarian principles, without interference from the de facto authorities or direct support to the Taliban regime.
Zij werken conform de humanitaire principes, zonder inmenging van de de facto autoriteiten of directe steun aan het Taliban-regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Hammelburg en Van der Lee  over het bericht dat het moederbedrijf van Douwe Egberts en Pickwick, JDE Peet's, weigert om zich terug te trekken uit Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Hammelburg and Van der Lee asked whether JDE Peet's, parent of Douwe Egberts and Pickwick, should exit Russia, whether government contracts with such firms are acceptable, and whether the Russia sanctions package should ban non-essential goods. The minister answered that firms may trade in Russia if they comply with EU sanctions, that existing government contracts will not be ended while compliance holds, that a list of firms with government contracts will be sent confidentially, and that the luxury goods list may be broadened without disclosing future measures.
This overview will be sent to the House for confidential inspection.
Dit overzicht wordt ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan de Kamer nagezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Piri en Van der Lee over de levering van F-16’s aan Oekraïne

Three MPs asked the government about the timeline, conditions, pilot training and number of F-16 aircraft to be delivered to Ukraine. The Minister of Defence answered that delivery depends on completed training, infrastructure, coalition coordination and US approval, that the Netherlands expects to make 12 to 18 aircraft available for a training centre in Romania, and that the exact numbers are not yet fixed.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged delivery timeline.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de aanstaande verkiezing van een nieuw onafhankelijk VN-expert op het gebied van seksuele oriëntatie en genderidentiteit

An MP asked the government whether it would back a successor to the UN independent expert on sexual orientation and gender identity, and what criteria should apply to the selection. The minister agreed the mandate is important, described the transparent selection process run by OHCHR and the Human Rights Council, and noted the three shortlisted candidates and the proposed appointment of Graeme Reid, without committing to specific Dutch support beyond the existing mandate.
The process for appointing Victor Madrigal-Borloz's successor is organised independently and transparently.
Het proces rondom de benoeming van de opvolger van Victor Madrigal-Borloz is onafhankelijk en transparant georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het definitief invoeren van de anti-LHBTIQ+ wet in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government would impose targeted sanctions and visa bans on Ugandan politicians responsible for the anti-LGBTIQ+ law, halt trade-promotion instruments with Uganda, and ensure do-no-harm and backlash risks are weighed, plus the status of Equal Rights Coalition action. The minister answered that national sanctions are not possible without an EU or UN basis and the matter is under discussion in Brussels, that trade instruments will not be stopped, that backlash risks are weighed, and that the coalition sent a letter and joint statement.
The Netherlands cannot impose national sanctions in this matter.
Nederland kan geen nationale sancties instellen in dezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het niet juist vaststellen van partnerschap door de Dienst Toeslagen, naar aanleiding van WOO-verzoek 2022.14

The MP asks how often invalids in the TVS system occurred, why they are rising, how they lead to reclaims, what the government did to warn citizens and inform parliament, and how it works to reduce them. The State Secretary explains invalids stem from technical processing errors due to system volume and complexity, that reclaims can follow, that detailed figures on affected citizens are not available, and that a team works on reducing them.
Specifically about the technical details of invalids, your House has not been informed.
Specifiek over de technische details van invalids is uw Kamer niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Hagen en Van der Graaf over het mislukken van het textielconvenant

MPs asked whether the government should reconsider its role as a party to voluntary sector agreements on responsible supply chains after the textile agreement collapsed, and what the failure means for garment workers and for the need for IMVO legislation. The minister answered that sectoral cooperation remains important, that the government's role will be evaluated in September 2023 with stakeholder consultation, and that the government is pursuing EU and national due-diligence legislation while keeping its existing policy mix.
In doing so I will of course evaluate the role of the government, also in relation to the future entry into force of legislation.
Daarbij zal ik uiteraard de rol van de overheid evalueren, ook in relatie tot inwerking treden van wetgeving in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Van Weyenberg over het verbod op FATCA-doorgiftes op basis van de General Data Protection Legislation (GDPR) in België

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belgian data protection authority's ban on passing tax data of Belgian accidental Americans to the US under the GDPR, and whether the Dutch FATCA arrangement complies with the GDPR and what the Dutch privacy authority has assessed. The State Secretary answered that the Belgian ruling does not affect the bilateral and EU efforts, that the Dutch privacy authority's earlier advice found no GDPR-conflict and that pending individual procedures will be awaited rather than reopening the advice, and that the Belgian ruling has no direct consequences for Dutch data exchange.
I think it is important that the AP is given time to form its judgment and I do not want to interfere with ongoing procedures.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de AP de tijd krijgt voor oordeelsvorming en ik wil lopende procedures niet doorkruisen.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de petitie van Yezidi-vrouwen

MPs Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg (D66) asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about justice and support for the Yezidi community, including aid in camps, missing Yezidis, evidence gathering with UNITAD, a Joint Investigation Team and the petition by Yezidi women. The government answered that it funds psychosocial aid, the Yezidi Survivors Law implementation and UNITAD, that it cannot verify figures or conditions in Al Hol, and that cooperation agreements and expertise contributions are still being explored.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine how many Yezidis are staying in the Al Hol camp.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk om vast te stellen hoeveel Yezidi’s verblijven in kamp Al Hol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het opstappen van Speciaal Oekraïne-gezant

An MP asked the minister why a former ambassador appointed as Special Envoy for Ukraine, who had made pro-Russian and derogatory remarks about Ukraine before the appointment, was chosen, whether screening was skipped, and how recurrence would be prevented. The minister answered that the remarks predated the role and reflected no government view, that the envoy was selected for regional and business expertise with a clean record, that a security screening was not standard for this function, and that candidates will be asked about sensitivities in future.
For functions identified as positions of trust, a security screening is moreover a standard part of the procedure.
Bij functies die als vertrouwensfuncties worden geïdentificeerd is een veiligheidsscreening bovendien standaard onderdeel van de procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de aangenomen anti-LHBTI-wet in Oeganda

MP Hammelburg asked ministers how the Netherlands would respond to Uganda's anti-LGBTI law adding the death penalty, including pressure on the president, sanctions, aid to civil society and joint action. The ministers answered that they have voiced strong concern, are working with the Equal Rights Coalition and partners, are reviewing some aid such as the JLOS programme, and would not publicly disclose specific measures.

Given that the situation is still developing, it is not in the interest of the matter to make public statements about which specific measures are under consideration if the legislation is definitively adopted.

Mede gezien de situatie nog in ontwikkeling is, is het niet in het belang van de zaak om publieke mededelingen te doen over welke maatregelen concreet in beeld zijn als de wetgeving definitief wordt aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Van der Graaf, Van der Lee, Klink, Jasper van Dijk en Thijssen over de situatie in Turkije en Syrië na de aardbevingen van 5/6 februari jl.

Members of parliament asked about access for international aid to Syria after the February 2023 earthquakes, the role of civil society in opposition areas, EU reconstruction funding, psychosocial and care needs, and aid worker safety. The minister answered that aid access to northwest Syria remains dependent on Turkey-based UN deliveries, that the EU is coordinating mid- to long-term support through existing channels, and that psychosocial support is integrated into programmes.

As promised during the committee debate on humanitarian aid after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria of 22 February, I asked the European Commission on behalf of the cabinet, ahead of the EU donor conference, to prepare a proposal for medium- and long-term aid and to coordinate its implementation.

Zoals toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat Humanitaire Hulp na de aardbeving in Turkije en Syrië van 22 februari jl. heb ik voorafgaand aan de EU-donorconferentie namens het kabinet de Europese Commissie verzocht een voorstel te maken voor het leveren van middellange- en lange-termijnhulp en de implementatie hiervan te coördineren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de voortgang richting een verbod op volledige autonome wapensystemen en de daar aan gelieerde, door de regering georganiseerde, conferentie 'Responsible AI in the Military D

An MP asked the ministers about progress toward a ban on fully autonomous weapons and the government-organised REAIM summit on responsible AI in the military domain. The government reaffirmed its commitment to a ban on weapons that cannot be used lawfully and to regulation of other autonomous systems within the CCW/GGE LAWS framework, while defending the broader REAIM approach as a way to build wider support.

The cabinet remains committed to pursuing an international ban on autonomous weapons systems that cannot be deployed in line with international law, and to regulating other systems with autonomous features within the UN framework (CCW/GGE LAWS).

Het kabinet blijft zich inzetten voor een internationaal verbod op autonome wapensystemen die niet in lijn met het internationaal recht kunnen worden ingezet en regulering van overige wapensystemen met autonome kenmerken in VN-verband (CCW/GGE LAWS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de situatie in Myanmar

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked about the crisis in Myanmar: the lack of political attention, EU-UN efforts toward a ceasefire, ASEAN's role, sanctions coordination, aviation fuel sanctions, a Myanmar funding overview, a Human Rights Council resolution and an emergency summit. The minister answers that the Netherlands is active through EU, UN and ASEAN channels, supports humanitarian aid and inclusive dialogue, will lead on a strong Council resolution, and gives a funding table, while declining to publish 2021-2022 Human Rights Fund project details for security reasons.

The projects supported from the Human Rights Fund in 2021 and 2022 cannot be publicly shared, given the high security risk to the persons and organisations involved since the military coup of 1 February 2021.

De projecten die in 2021 en 2022 zijn ondersteund vanuit het MRF, kunnen gezien het hoge veiligheidsrisico dat betrokken personen en instanties lopen sinds de militaire staatsgreep op 1 februari 2021, niet publiekelijk worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Miljoenen chips Nederlandse fabrikanten belanden in Rusland ondanks sancties’

MPs Hammelburg and Sjoerdsma asked when the cabinet learned that Dutch chips were found in Russian military equipment, why the media were answered but not Parliament, what was done about Iranian drones, how sanctioned intermediaries could still supply Russia, and what measures could curb resale. The ministers answered that the government was first informed in March 2022, that the goods were added to EU sanctions after a Dutch proposal, that sanctions are being pursued via EU listings and a non-paper, and that full control over trade in these components is not feasible.
The ministry sent the relevant news editors a written response to a specific request for clarification.
Het ministerie heeft de betreffende nieuwsredacties een schriftelijke reactie gestuurd op een specifiek verzoek om verduidelijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht ‘Zware aardbeving treft Turkije en Syrië, honderden doden en gewonden’

An MP asked the minister about the scale of casualties and damage from the 2023 earthquake in Turkey and Syria, whether humanitarian aid would be provided quickly, and whether the Chamber would be informed. The minister answered briefly that the Chamber had been informed of the humanitarian impact and aid efforts by letter.
Yes. The Chamber was informed about the humanitarian consequences of the earthquakes and the (international) aid efforts via a letter to the Chamber.
Ja. De Kamer werd geïnformeerd over de humanitaire gevolgen van de aardbevingen en de (internationale) hulpinspanningen via Kamerbrief
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Akkoord over beperken export chiptech naar China'

D66 MPs asked whether the cabinet agreed to export restrictions on chip-making machinery and technology to China, why parliament was not informed, and about security effects, consultation with Brussels and Dutch firms, and China's WTO complaint against the US. The ministers refused to share the content of talks with partners citing confidentiality, pointed to the 1 December letter and a confidential briefing, said no policy change is currently at stake, and declined to speculate on Chinese reactions or possible complaints against the Netherlands.
I cannot go into the content of discussions the Netherlands holds with partner countries because of confidentiality.
Op de inhoud van gesprekken die Nederland voert met partnerlanden kan ik vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Hammelburg inzake het verspreiden van antisemitische complottheorieën in Ahoy

MPs Belhaj and Hammelburg asked whether antisemitic conspiracy theories were voiced at a spiritual event in Rotterdam Ahoy and what the government will do about the spread of such theories and rising antisemitism. The minister says criminal enforcement applies if complaints are filed, that NCTV monitoring of open sources is currently suspended pending legislation, and points to the antisemitism action plan and a planned extremism strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de berichtgeving dat Oeganda kampt met een nieuwe ebola-uitbraak

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked the government about reports of a new Ebola outbreak in Uganda, including flight links, airport screening, WHO response capacity and Dutch assistance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that screening protocols are being strengthened, that the WHO has an emergency programme and funding gap, and that Dutch contributions go via WHO funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the Ebola outbreak in Uganda.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de Ebola uitbraak in Oeganda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat oudgedienden van de Britse luchtmacht training geven en kennis overdragen aan de Chinese krijgsmacht

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that former British RAF pilots were being recruited to train Chinese army pilots, and what the Netherlands does about Chinese recruitment of military veterans and whether current law prevents personnel from working for foreign powers. The minister called the reports worrying, pointed to MIVD investigations without giving details, explained the existing rules (desertion rules, confidentiality duties, security screening that can lead to withdrawal of clearance) and said the cabinet is considering further action with the UK and partners.
Due to the classified nature of this investigation, no public statements can be made about it.
Vanwege het gerubriceerde karakter van dit onderzoek kunnen hierover in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sjoerdsma, Boulakjar en Boucke over het bericht dat beide Nord Stream pijpleidingen vlak na elkaar zijn stuk gegaan en dat seismologische bureaus van Denemarken en Zweden hevig

MPs from D66 asked whether the Nord Stream pipeline explosions were sabotage, whether Russia could invoke force majeure, whether the Netherlands would push the EU to phase out Russian gas, and how Dutch offshore pipelines and infrastructure would be protected. The government answered that sabotage is almost certain but attribution is not yet possible, outlined EU gas-reduction measures and infrastructure protection plans, and promised a separate letter on North Sea protection.
It is almost certain that this was a sabotage action.
Het staat vrijwel zeker vast dat het hier een sabotageactie betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hammelburg over Nederlandse kennis over Australische oorlogsmisdaden in Uruzgan, Afghanistan

MPs Van Dijk and Hammelburg asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch personnel knew of possible Australian war crimes in Uruzgan as early as 2010, whether a special report exists, and what the status of earlier inventories and investigations is. The minister confirms awareness of the press report, says the alleged report cannot yet be confirmed, restates that the earlier inventory found no Dutch involvement, and states that a new Australian-linked investigation has been started.
Defence is still searching for a report that the reporter says was drawn up. The search has not yet been completed.
Defensie zoekt nog naar een rapport dat volgens de melder zou zijn opgemaakt. De zoekslag is nog niet voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over misstanden binnen de United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS)

An MP asked the Foreign Trade and Development minister about mismanagement at UNOPS, including Dutch funds linked to the WSSCC, the S3i initiative, a whistleblower not being heard, and suspension of payments. The minister answered that Dutch payments were paused and resumed under conditions, that whistleblowers are always heard, and that a temporary payment freeze and stricter commitment procedure were introduced while external investigations proceed.
Whistleblowers who report to Foreign Affairs are always heard.
Klokkenluiders die zich melden bij Buitenlandse Zaken worden altijd gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het voorgestelde plan van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger van de Unie Borrell over een EU-trainingsmissie voor Oekraïense militairen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the High Representative's proposed EU military training mission for Ukrainian soldiers, what the Netherlands thinks of it, its role, Ukraine's needs and the Dutch contribution. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports the EUMAM proposal, will actively back it, and will assess its contribution once the EEAS drafts the concept, while answering each question on substance.
The Netherlands supports the proposal of High Representative Borrell for an EU Military Assistance Mission (EUMAM) for Ukraine.
Nederland steunt het voorstel van Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Borrell voor een EU Military Assistance Mission (EUMAM) voor Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de zorgwekkende situatie rondom de FSO Safer olietanker in Jemen

An MP asked the minister about the deteriorating situation around the FSO Safer oil tanker off Yemen, the funding gap for salvage, timing, private oil company contributions and contingency planning. The minister answered that funding remains insufficient despite about USD 65 million raised, that Netherlands contributes EUR 7.5 million and lobbies donors, and that the VN coordinates the operation with the timeline dependent on funding.
The Netherlands will continue to actively raise this issue in bilateral contacts with (potential) donors, in multilateral fora and with the private sector.
Nederland zal deze kwestie actief blijven opbrengen in bilaterale contacten met (potentiële) donoren, in multilaterale fora en bij de private sector
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de internationale onderhandelingen in Ierland over de gevolgen van explosieve wapens in bevolkte gebieden

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Irish-led international negotiations on explosive weapons in populated areas, including whether the Netherlands would support an ICRC-backed avoidance principle. The minister answered that the Netherlands largely agrees with the ICRC, would support such a principle if it does not reinterpret existing law, and reported on the April consultations, which reached no consensus yet.
Due to the short time between the submission of the parliamentary questions and the negotiations, it was not possible to inform your House before the negotiations began.
Vanwege de korte tijdspanne tussen het indienen van de Kamervragen en de onderhandelingen is het niet gelukt om uw Kamer voor aanvang van de onderhandelingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de wederopbouw van Oekraïense steden en dorpen

An MP asked the government whether it would commit to Ukraine's reconstruction, to a reconstruction plan showing Dutch involvement, and to exploring partnerships between Dutch municipalities and Ukrainian towns. The minister answered yes to each point and promised letters to parliament on a European recovery programme and on the Kuzu motion.
Yes, your House will be informed by letter in the short term about the Dutch contribution in line with the Amhaouch et al. motion on a European recovery programme for Ukraine.
Ja, uw Kamer zal op korte termijn per brief geïnformeerd worden over de Nederlandse inzet conform motie Amhaouch c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de donorconferentie voor Moldavië en de acute crisis die zich daar voltrekt ten gevolge van de oorlog in Oekraïne

An MP from D66 asked the minister about the Moldova donor conference and the refugee crisis caused by the war in Ukraine, including Dutch contributions and Moldova's needs. The minister answered that the Netherlands pledged 10 million euros for refugee reception, supports Moldova's access to World Bank concessional funding, and has provided aid in kind and a plan to take in 500 refugees.
The Netherlands supported Moldova in its efforts to gain access to this instrument, and if this bid is successful, we will channel this contribution through this facility.
Nederland heeft Moldavië gesteund bij zijn inspanningen om toegang te krijgen tot dit instrument, en indien dit bod succesvol is, zullen wij deze bijdrage via deze faciliteit laten lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het leveren van zware wapens aan Oekraïne voor de volgende fase in de oorlog

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Ukraine can withstand the Russian offensive with current equipment, whether it should be supported with heavier weapons, and how long delivery and training take. The minister said the cabinet is coordinating further support with allies, has committed to pantserhouwitsers and armoured vehicles with training outside Ukraine, and that training timelines vary by system.
The cabinet is considering, together with allies and partners, how it can continue to support Ukraine in its legitimate right to self-defence.
Het kabinet beziet, samen met bondgenoten en partners, op welke wijze het Oekraïne blijvend kan ondersteunen bij zijn legitieme recht op zelfverdediging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over het bericht dat China door middel van samenwerkingen met Europese bedrijven en universiteiten haar krijgsmacht moderniseert

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked whether China's use of technology from European firms and universities to modernise its military is undesirable, and whether reporting duties, legal blocking powers, or US-style policy should be introduced for risky cooperation. The government acknowledges the risks of unwanted technology transfer, points to existing screening, export control and knowledge-security instruments, and declines to introduce a reporting obligation for now, while noting universities' academic freedom and that no legal basis currently exists to force termination of such cooperation.
Against this background, the cabinet currently considers introducing a reporting obligation not opportune.
Tegen deze achtergrond acht het kabinet invoering van een meldingsplicht op dit moment niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Honger dreigt in Hoorn van Afrika, te weinig hulpgeld door 'concurrerende rampen''

MPs Hammelburg and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the minister about a warning that hunger threatens the Horn of Africa and that aid is insufficient, covering food security, WFP funding, the aid budget, UN coordination, food import dependence and geopolitical risks. The minister replied that the Netherlands is engaging partners and the UN, cites existing funding (EUR 44 million to WFP), says no room exists in the emergency aid budget for increases but that the Chamber will be informed in the spring memorandum, and promises further UN talks.
If additional funds become available, a decision on additional contributions will be taken based on an analysis of needs worldwide.
Indien additionele middelen beschikbaar komen, wordt op basis van een analyse van de noden wereldwijd een besluit genomen over aanvullende bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Belhaj over de compensatieprojecten in Hawija

MPs Hammelburg and Belhaj asked the Defence Minister about criticism from Hawija's mayor of the Dutch compensation projects, their progress, timelines, funding, local consultation and alleged consular discouragement of compensation claims. The minister rejected the mayor's claims, described ongoing contact with local authorities and project status, and said the timelines are expected to hold while extension remains possible.
The cabinet is however aware that completing work in this region brings challenges and that developments may occur that affect the planning.
Het kabinet is zich er echter van bewust dat het voltooien van werkzaamheden in deze regio uitdagingen met zich meebrengt en er ontwikkelingen kunnen optreden die de planning beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over transvrouwen Oekraïne

An MP asked whether the government knows that transgender women in Ukraine cannot leave the country because their documents say male, and what it will do to protect them. The ministers confirmed the situation is distressing, said they raise the issue with UN agencies and the Equal Rights Coalition, and agreed to raise it with European and Ukrainian counterparts.
Yes, I am willing to bring this issue further to the attention of European and Ukrainian counterparts.
Ja, ik ben bereid om dit onderwerp verder onder de aandacht te brengen bij Europese en Oekraïense counterparts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over een luchtbrug voor zieke kinderen in Oekraïne

An MP asked the ministers whether they would prioritise evacuating sick Ukrainian children, including children with cancer, by airlift to hospitals with capacity, and whether Dutch hospitals would be made available. The minister answered that evacuation is coordinated by the European Commission, that the Netherlands is willing to help, that a national inventory of hospital capacity is underway, and that a decision on Dutch coordination will follow.
On that basis I will make a decision on coordination and organisation on the Dutch side.
Op basis daarvan zal ik een besluit nemen over de coördinatie en organisatie aan Nederlandse zijde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Boucke over het bericht dat de roestende olietanker FSO Safer voor de kust van Jemen kan leiden tot één van de grootste olierampen in de geschiedenis

MPs Hammelburg and Boucke asked about the deteriorating FSO Safer oil tanker off Yemen, including the Dutch funding for an inspection mission, UN negotiations with the Houthis, available Dutch expertise, liability, and further contributions. The minister answered that the Netherlands is working with the UN and partners, that the earlier USD 1.686 million project was halted due to lack of Houthi cooperation with only 161,000 USD spent, and that further support depends on a new UN project plan.
At the end of 2020 the Netherlands made USD 1.686 million available for an earlier UN-led project aimed at an inspection and light maintenance mission.
Nederland heeft eind 2020 een bedrag van USD 1,686 miljoen beschikbaar gesteld ten behoeve van een eerder door de VN geleid project met als doel een inspectie- en lichte onderhoudsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat de meest recente cyberaanval in Oekraïne verliep via Nederland

An MP asked the government about reports that a cyberattack on Ukraine was routed via Dutch servers, including whether it was a DDoS combined with disinformation, the risks for the Netherlands, and what is being done to stop such attacks. The government answered that attribution and counting of attacks routed via Dutch servers is not feasible, that the NCSC sees no impact on Dutch interests, and that legislation to tackle the cyber-domain bottlenecks is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat Janssen tijdelijk gestopt is met productie coronavaccins in Leiden

An MP asked the health and foreign trade ministers about reports that Johnson & Johnson temporarily paused COVID-19 vaccine production in Leiden, and about the effect on global vaccination and COVAX/African Union supply commitments. The minister answered that J&J pledged to honour its supply contracts, production has since resumed, and the government is investing in country readiness in developing countries.
Johnson & Johnson stated in a response to the press report that it will honour its contractual obligations to COVAX and the African Union.
Johnson & Johnson heeft in een reactie op het genoemde persbericht laten weten hun contractuele verplichtingen aan COVAX en de Afrikaanse Unie na te zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Boulakjar over het Strategisch Vastgoedplan

MPs Hammelburg and Boulakjar asked the State Secretary for Defence how many of Defence's buildings are urban or rural, which are suitable for housing or greening, which lie in large cities, and which 35-40% of the property portfolio will be divested. The State Secretary answered that Defence does not define urban or rural, that suitability for housing is for regional authorities to judge, that no decision on divestment has been taken, and that the contours of the internal review will be shared in April.
No decision has yet been taken on which buildings or sites Defence wants to leave.
Er is nog geen besluit genomen over welke gebouwen of terreinen Defensie wil verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over humanitaire actie in Oekraïne

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about preparations for humanitarian crisis scenarios and emergency aid for Ukraine, including reserved funds and the response strategy. The minister answered that the Netherlands is coordinating closely with OCHA, ECHO and the Red Cross, committed 20 million euros immediately plus in-kind aid, and will keep parliament informed.
The House will be kept informed of all relevant developments and further humanitarian aid for the victims of the war in Ukraine.
De Kamer zal op de hoogte worden gehouden van alle relevante ontwikkelingen en verdere humanitaire hulp voor de slachtoffers van de oorlog in Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Bikker over voortgang en problemen rondom vaccindonatie

MPs Hammelburg and Bikker asked the government about rejected COVID-19 vaccine donations, unused stock, the status of Dutch donations to COVAX, and financing. The minister answered that rejections stem from storage, shelf-life, supply and hesitancy problems, that COVAX reallocates refused doses, that about 14 million of 17.8 million donated doses had arrived, and that further calls for funding will be made in the coming months.

The implementation of the Hammelburg motion on mobilising business support for COVAX will be explained in the letter 'Global COVID-19 efforts', which will be sent to the House before the debate of 10 March 2022.

De uitvoering van de motie Hammelburg betreffende de inzet op het mobiliseren van steun van bedrijven voor COVAX zal worden toegelicht in de kamerbrief «Wereldwijde inzet COVID-19», die voor het debat op 10 maart 2022 naar de kamer wordt gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad met betrekking tot box 3

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Supreme Court's box 3 ruling, the handling of individual objections within the mass-objection procedure, and whether the uncertainty over who validly objected will be resolved, plus a legislative fix. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling creates urgency to amend the law, said the full scope of those eligible for redress is not yet determined, and promised to inform parliament and hold a debate.

The full scope of the group of citizens eligible for redress has not yet been determined, but we will very seriously consider whether the group that did not file an objection will also fall under the redress.

De volledige reikwijdte van de groep burgers die in aanmerking komen voor rechtsherstel is op dit moment nog niet bepaald, maar wij zullen zeer serieus meewegen of de groep die geen bezwaar heeft gemaakt ook onder het rechtsherstel zal vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) een handhavingstraject is gestart tegen de Rabobank

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that DNB had started an enforcement track against Rabobank over weak anti-money-laundering controls, and about steps taken since the ABN AMRO settlement. The minister said the enforcement was initiated by DNB rather than the OM, described the broader anti-money-laundering plan and DNB's findings on the sector, and said the government would keep working on it and inform parliament.
The article referred to in question 1 describes an enforcement track initiated by De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) against Rabobank, not an enforcement track by the OM.
Het artikel waar in vraag 1 naar wordt verwezen beschrijft een handhavingstraject geïnitieerd door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) bij Rabobank, geen handhavingstraject van het OM.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het advies van de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) dat ten grondslag ligt aan zijn brief over actieve provisietransparantie en het Besluit financiële markten 2021

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Finance whether the AFM advice behind the active commission-transparency proposal (Wijzigingsbesluit Financiële Markten 2021) really supports the claim that it is feasible, and whether it is legally sound and avoids information overload and reduced competition. The Minister answers that the AFM, after talks with industry, judged the proposal feasible with its three recommendations adopted, that the proposal is consistent with the IDD and proportionate, and that an evaluation report will follow within three years.
I have adopted the AFM's conclusion on feasibility.
Ik heb de conclusie van de AFM over uitvoerbaarheid overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de oproep van de WHO om geen boostervaccins aan te bieden en de conclusie van de Gezondheidsraad om dit slechts voor een kleine groep te doen

An MP asked the ministers about the WHO call to withhold booster vaccines and the Health Council advice limiting boosters to a small group, and how this affects donation and procurement policy and motion Bikker-Hammelburg. The government answered that the advice concerns only a small group of severely immunocompromised patients, has no implications for donation or procurement, and that Nederland still aims to donate as many vaccines as it uses, with 22 million doses committed to COVAX.
The Health Council's advice on severely immunocompromised patients concerns a small group and therefore has no implications for the Dutch donation policy.
Het advies van de Gezondheidsraad aangaande ernstig immuun gecompromitteerde patiënten betreft een geringe groep, en heeft dus geen implicaties voor het Nederlandse donatiebeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de COP26-verklaring over het in lijn brengen van internationale overheidssteun met de groene energietransitie

An MP asked whether the government knows of and what its position is on the COP26 statement on aligning international public support with the green energy transition, and asked for a strategy by early 2022 on phasing out fossil fuel use, including in export credit insurance. The government confirms it signed the statement, says the E3F coalition will serve as a forum for implementing it on export credit, and commits to new policy by end-2022 with a report to parliament early 2022 as requested by motion.
As indicated in the parliamentary letter, the cabinet will work in 2022 on new policy to end international public support for the fossil energy sector, particularly regarding export credit insurance.

Zoals in de Kamerbrief aangegeven zal het kabinet in 2022 werken aan nieuw beleid voor het beëindigen van internationale overheidssteun aan de fossiele energiesector, in het bijzonder voor wat betreft de exportkredietverzekering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling

MP Hammelburg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the business succession exemption (BOR) mainly benefits a small group of entrepreneurs, its annual budgetary cost, the effect of an adviser proposal to widen and reshape it, and feasible efficiency improvements. The State Secretary largely agreed the benefits concentrate among few entrepreneurs, provided budget figures for 2012-2017, said the combined proposal's budget effect cannot be given, and pointed to an ongoing evaluation due in Q1 2022.
Based on this outline of the proposal, it cannot be stated what the budgetary effect would be of the combination of all these proposals.
Op basis van dit voorstel op hoofdlijnen is niet aan te geven wat het budgettaire effect zou zijn van de combinatie van al deze voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Bikker over vaccindonatie

Two MPs (Hammelburg, D66, and Bikker, ChristenUnie) asked the health minister about donating COVID-19 vaccines via GAVI, legal obstacles, the EU Team Europe approach, and comparisons with Germany, the US, Sweden and Norway. The minister answered that the Netherlands has signed donation mandates for AstraZeneca, BioNTech/Pfizer and Janssen doses and aims to donate roughly 25-27 million doses, but the answers largely restate policy and give limited detail on legal barriers and comparative figures.

The Netherlands has now signed the donation mandates under which all remaining AstraZeneca doses (about 7.9 million) and all remaining BioNTech/Pfizer doses for 2021 (about 2.8 million) will be donated to Covax.

Nederland heeft inmiddels de donatiemandaten ondertekend waarmee alle nog te ontvangen doses van het AstraZeneca vaccin (circa 7,9 miljoen doses) en alle nog te ontvangen doses uit de contracten met BioNTech/Pfizer voor 2021 (circa 2,8 miljoen doses) aan Covax zullen worden gedoneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de TRIPS-raad van de WTO

An MP asked the government about the WTO TRIPS Council meeting in October 2021, Dutch representation there, and whether the COVID-19 vaccine IP waiver would be discussed and supported. The minister replied that the European Commission speaks for the EU, that the Netherlands will not take a position in the Council but pressed for constructive EU negotiations, and that patent waivers alone would not necessarily increase vaccine capacity.
The Netherlands will not take any position in this Council, as the European Commission speaks on behalf of the European Union.
Nederland zal zich in deze Raad niet uitspreken voor enige positie, gezien de Europese Commissie het woord voert namens de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de uitgaande handelsmissie naar Hongarije op 15–17 september 2021

An MP asked the minister about a trade mission to Budapest on 15-17 September 2021, the anti-LGBTI laws in Hungary, how the mission addresses them, and whether participating firms are screened against OECD guidelines on non-discrimination. The minister answered that no minister attends, that the mission is run by RVO and the embassy, that LGBTI concerns are raised in preparation and during the mission, and that firms must sign a self-scan on OECD guidelines but company impact on LGBTI rights is not specifically assessed.
Trade missions do not specifically examine the impact that participating companies have on the social position and rights of LGBTIQ persons.
Er wordt bij handelsmissies niet specifiek gekeken naar de impact die deelnemende bedrijven hebben op de maatschappelijke positie en rechten van LHBTIQ-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hammelburg over het bericht 'Partnerverlof nadeliger voor laagste inkomens'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether partner leave (aanvullend geboorteverlof) financially disadvantages the lowest incomes, and how net income effects arise. The minister confirmed the net loss pattern stems mainly from the tax structure (arbeidskorting and the benefit cap), said the NRC figures are factually correct but incomplete as they ignore annual tax and allowances, provided household tables, and said the only options are raising the benefit, which the cabinet considers adequate, or a structural tax change beyond scope, with an evaluation of the WIEG to follow.
The evaluation will be sent to your House at the end of this year or the beginning of next year, and may prompt a next cabinet to look again at the level of the benefit.
De evaluatie zal eind dit jaar of begin volgend jaar naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd, en kan mogelijk voor een volgend kabinet aanleiding zijn om opnieuw naar de hoogte van de uitkering te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Belhaj over Noodsteun Haïti

MPs Hammelburg and Belhaj asked the ministers for Foreign Trade and Development and for Defence about Dutch emergency aid for the Haiti earthquake, including EU coordination, UN and Red Cross support, funding from the crisis reserve, technical expertise such as USAR and water experts, and military deployment. The minister answered that Nederland was asked for experts and a naval ship (Zr.Ms. Holland) was deployed, the Red Cross would release EUR 400,000, and the Dutch USAR and water-expert teams were not requested.
Yes, in that context it is good to see that aid operations are being set up from various quarters.
Ja, in dat verband is het goed te zien dat er vanuit verschillende hoeken hulpoperaties worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over de oproep uit Suriname om hulp te bieden met vaccineren

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about Suriname's request for vaccination help amid a COVID-19 surge and the Indian export ban. The minister answered that Nederland has responded with oxygen containers, medical supplies, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses and a planned 500,000 to 750,000 doses, sent a special envoy, and donated EUR 70 million to COVAX.
The Netherlands has also committed that from week 25, provided supplies allow, vaccines will be delivered to Suriname.
Nederland heeft tevens toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de miljoenenboete voor ABN AMRO vanwege ernstige langdurige tekortkomingen bij het bestrijden van witwassen

An MP (D66) asks the Minister of Finance about the 480 million euro fine on ABN AMRO for serious, long-running anti-money-laundering failures, including what the minister meant by the OM's findings and whether DNB's Wwft supervision will be explained, and how often the state shareholder NLFI, the ministry and the bank's boards discussed compliance. The minister answers that the findings are painful, that DNB will be asked for an explanation and a letter will follow, and that exact meeting counts cannot be reconstructed, while describing NLFI's and the ministry's contacts with the bank and the bank's remediation steps.
It is up to NLFI to determine what contact (and what intensity) is appropriate and necessary for carrying out its role as shareholder in ABN AMRO.
Het is aan NLFI om te bepalen welk contact (en welke intensiteit) passend en noodzakelijk is voor de uitvoering van haar rol als aandeelhouder in ABN AMRO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Snels, Inge van Dijk en Grinwis over de noodzaak om zo snel als mogelijk financiële instellingen verplichten over klimaatrisico’s te rapporteren

MPs asked the Finance Minister about speeding up mandatory climate-risk reporting by financial institutions, including the TCFD framework, its alignment with the EU's proposed revision of the non-financial reporting directive, and the timing of EU and IFRS standards. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU-level harmonisation over a national patchwork, and that it will assess the Commission proposal via a BNC-fiche and pursue international convergence rather than launch national legislation now.
The cabinet wants to work towards a swift and prompt completion of the European process and its implementation in our national laws and regulations.
Het kabinet wil zich inzetten voor een voortvarende en spoedige afronding van het Europese traject en implementatie daarvan in onze nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de miljoenenboete voor ABN AMRO en de wijze waarop deze is vastgesteld

An MP asks the Justice Minister why ABN AMRO's 480 million euro settlement was set as it was, how it compares to ING's, how the 300 million fine and disgorgement were determined, and whether the Hoge Transacties review regime and judicial review will be made more transparent. The minister explains the calculation methods, the 5% turnover-based fine, the lack of uniform guidelines, and that a draft bill giving courts a role in reviewing high transactions is in consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hammelburg over Europese hulp aan het zwaar door het coronavirus getroffen India

MPs Paternotte and Hammelburg asked whether the government would help India during its severe COVID-19 wave with medical supplies, vaccine production support, genome sequencing and lifting US export restrictions. The minister answered that Nederland is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilators and antivirals, funding Red Cross and Global Fund support, and that US export restrictions were lifted on 25 April.
In response, the Netherlands is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilation equipment and antiviral medicines.
In reactie daarop stuurt Nederland zuurstof-concentratoren, beademingsapparatuur en anti-virale middelen.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Hoogland ter vervanging van nr. 11 over een verzwaarde regeling voor rijontzeggingen wegens rijden onder invloed
Adds a tiered recidivism regime for driving bans for drink or drug driving (up to life), with a 25-year review application to a court, and applies only to offences after entry into force.
The convicted person whose driving licence was withdrawn may after 25 years submit a written request for reassessment of the driving ban to the court.

De veroordeelde aan wie de bevoegdheid tot het besturen van motorrijtuigen is ontzegd wegens een misdrijf omschreven in artikel 179, vijfde lid, onderdeel c of d, van de Wegenverkeerswet 1994 kan na verloop van 25 jaren na de onherroepelijke veroordeling een schriftelijk verzoek tot herbeoordeling van de rijontzegging indienen
Motie van de leden Visser en Hoogland over een structurele aanpak van de A58 Breda-Tilburg
Asks the government, in consultation with the region, to investigate whether and how traffic flow problems on the A58 between Breda and Tilburg can be structurally solved.
requests the government, in consultation with the region, to investigate whether and how the traffic flow problems on the A58 between Breda and Tilburg can be structurally addressed
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de regio te onderzoeken of en hoe de doorstromingsproblemen op de A58 tussen Breda en Tilburg structureel kunnen worden aangepakt
Motie van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over investeringen in het spoor om Venlo uit te bouwen als internationaal vervoersknooppunt
Asks the government to investigate which rail capacity investments are needed to expand Venlo as an international freight hub, a transport investment matter without bearing on executive checks.
requests the government to investigate whether and which capacity-increasing rail investments are needed
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken of en welke capaciteitsvergrotende investeringen in spoor nodig zijn
Motie van het lid Hoogland c.s. over een rijksbijdrage voor de sluis bij Kornwerderzand
Asks the region to submit a new financing proposal for the Kornwerderzand lock without state risk, and asks the government to reserve up to 30 million euro as a state contribution until 2017.
requests the government to reserve up to 30 million euro as state contribution until 1 October 2017
verzoekt de regering, tot 1 oktober 2017 een bedrag van maximaal 30 miljoen euro te reserveren als rijksbijdrage
Motie van de leden Hoogland en Visser over prioriteit geven aan de opgave voor de A15 Ridderkerk-Gorinchem

The State Secretary denied threatening withdrawal, said she had called the province of Limburg to account for missed agreed deadlines on the BDU grant, and agreed to consult with the province on a solution.
I called the province of Limburg to account in my letter of 26 January 2017 for failing to meet agreements on the BDU grant
Ik heb de provincie Limburg met mijn brief van 26 januari 2017 aangesproken op het niet nakomen van afspraken over de BDU-uitkering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het aantal alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers why the number of recorded alcohol checks in traffic fell 17.5 percent in 2016, whether registration is mandatory, and whether individual checks are more effective. The Justice minister answered that the decline reflects a shift away from large checkpoints toward individual checks, that recording individual checks is not mandatory, and that alcohol limit violations are always recorded as offences but not separately per check.
Recording individual checks, which also test for alcohol use, is not mandatory, so the number of recorded alcohol checks does not give a complete picture of police deployment.

Het registreren van individuele controles, waarbij ook getest wordt op het gebruik van alcohol, is niet verplicht, waardoor uit het aantal geregistreerde alcoholcontroles geen volledig beeld van de inzet van politie kan worden afgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over vorderingen rondom mobiel bereik in tunnels

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked about progress on mobile coverage in tunnels, including how new tunnel standards, tender specifications, provider cooperation and the Ketheltunnel and Blankenburg projects are handled. The minister answers that coverage is being facilitated through updated standards and provider agreements, with providers responsible for funding and installation, and that no Building Decree change is planned.
I will inform your House in the second half of the year about the results of this inventory of mobile accessibility in existing tunnels.
Ik zal uw kamer in de tweede helft van het jaar over de resultaten van deze inventarisatie van mobiele bereikbaarheid in bestaande tunnels informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Hoogland over de toegankelijkheid van treinen en treinstations

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretaries about worsened train accessibility for wheelchair users at Zevenbergen and Lage Zwaluwe stations and related planning. The government acknowledged the problem, explained that new SLT-to-other-rolling-stock deployment and platform-height timelines cause it, and committed to further accessibility measures and travel information.
ProRail's programme to bring all platforms to the correct height runs until 2030.
Het programma van Prorail om alle perrons op de goede hoogte te brengen loopt tot 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Hoogland over hoge parkeerkosten bij ziekenhuizen

Two MPs asked the health minister why nothing is done about high hospital parking charges that burden patients and visitors, and whether she will convene VNG, NVZ and insurers or require transparency. The minister repeatedly answered that she has no role or competence over parking tariffs, which lie with municipalities and hospitals, and said she would merely point these parties to the questions.
I have no role or competence regarding parking tariffs, which is why I cannot set a maximum for parking costs.
Ik heb geen rol en bevoegdheid ten aanzien van parkeertarieven, vandaar dat ik geen maximum kan bepalen voor parkeerkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het terugdraaien van kilometertellers door hackers

MP Hoogland asked the minister about odTellerfraud (odometer hacking) and what has been done to implement his motion against mileage fraud in imported cars, including RDW practice and EU-wide mileage exchange. The minister answers that the RDW now gives 'onlogisch' ratings for imports where the recorded mileage is lower than at export, that a Belgian mileage exchange pilot has started, and that mandatory EU exchange by 2018 is unlikely to be met due to slow negotiations.

In line with the Hoogland motion, the RDW now gives the rating 'illogical' for imported vehicles previously registered in the Netherlands when the odometer reading is lower than at the time of export from the Netherlands.

Conform de motie Hoogland geeft de RDW inmiddels het oordeel «onlogisch» bij import van voertuigen die eerder al in Nederland waren geregistreerd als de tellerstand bij deze voertuigen lager is dan de tellerstand op het moment dat deze voertuigen werden geëxporteerd uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de taxironselaars op Schiphol die de zangeres van Skunk Anansie belaagden

An MP asked the state secretary about aggressive taxi touting at Schiphol that harassed the singer of Skunk Anansie, whether the situation is untenable, why it cannot be solved quickly, and whether the government will intervene. The state secretary agreed the situation is unacceptable, explained that the municipality of Haarlemmermeer is responsible for amending its bylaw and is preparing that change with ministry help, and said the government will do what is needed while referring to earlier answers.
It is and remains the responsibility and competence of the municipality of Haarlemmermeer to amend the APV.
Het is en blijft uiteraard de bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Haarlemmermeer om de APV te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Hoogland over het bericht ‘België geeft het op met spoor Maastricht-Lanaken

MPs Fokke and Hoogland asked about reports that Belgium was abandoning the Maastricht-Lanaken freight rail line, its unused state, the public money spent and the lessons learned. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the Rijk paid about 5.6 million euro for revitalisation, that the line lacked freight after Sappi switched to road transport, and that future reactivations must be funded by the initiator.
In future, when reactivating disused railways, the costs of planning, reactivation, and management and maintenance will fall entirely on the initiator.
In het vervolg zullen bij reactivering van in onbruik geraakte spoorwegen de kosten voor planvorming, reactivering en beheer en onderhoud geheel bij de initiatiefnemer komen te liggen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Vermue en Albert de Vries over berichten dat er steun van Europa te verwachten is voor twee goederenspoorverbindingen die de Zeeuwse havens kunnen aansluiten op het spoorwegnet v

Opposition PvdA MPs asked whether EU co-funding for two Zeeland rail links to the Antwerp and Ghent ports was realistic, and whether the government would join talks with the EU coordinator. The state secretary replied that cost-benefit analyses found the links socially unprofitable, that no EU co-funding has been signalled, and that a capacity analysis with Zeeland Seaports and ProRail is under way with results expected in early 2017.
Cost-benefit analyses were carried out for the additional rail link Axel–Zelzate (canal zone Ghent–Terneuzen) and the rail link between Antwerp and Vlissingen (VEZA arc).
Er zijn kosten baten analyses uitgevoerd voor de (extra) spoorverbinding Axel – Zelzate (kanaal zone Gent Terneuzen) en de spoorverbinding tussen Antwerpen en Vlissingen (VEZA boog).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Samsom, Jan Vos en Hoogland over de komst van een Tesla-fabriek naar Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister and Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would do everything possible to attract a Tesla Gigafactory to the Netherlands for green jobs and manufacturing. Minister Kamp answered that the Netherlands is a suitable location and the cabinet will make efforts, but that Tesla alone decides on location and he cannot yet estimate investments or jobs.
The cabinet will certainly make efforts to bring the production plant to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zal zich zeker inspannen om de productiefabriek naar Nederland te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de ondoorzichtige tarieven van publieke laadpalen

An MP asked ministers whether they would make public charging-point tariffs transparent and engage market parties on this after a Radar broadcast. The minister replied that price transparency is the responsibility of market parties and ACM, pointing to open protocols like OCPI and the NKL platform without committing to a concrete new step.
Making tariffs visible at the charging point is a responsibility of market parties.
Het inzichtelijk maken van tarieven aan de laadpaal is een verantwoordelijkheid van marktpartijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over de taxironselaars op Schiphol

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked the state secretary about aggressive taxi touts at Schiphol, whether the Haarlemmermeer municipal bylaw (APV) leaves too much room for them, and what steps have been taken. The state secretary replied that the bylaw already prohibits intrusive solicitation, that enforcement is being intensified through targeted action against the worst offenders and ILT capacity, and that talks with the municipality and Schiphol are ongoing, with a possible bylaw amendment under consideration.
At present I am examining together with the municipality of Haarlemmermeer whether a further amendment of the APV can make enforcement more effective.
Op dit moment bekijk ik samen met de gemeente Haarlemmermeer of een verdere wijziging van de APV de handhaving effectiever kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘1 op de 5 gecontroleerde vrachtwagens mag eigenlijk de weg niet op, volgens Belgisch onderzoek’

An MP asked the Minister whether Belgian findings that one in five checked trucks should not be on the road are known, whether technical defects pose a danger, and why the Netherlands does not register such results. The Minister confirmed knowledge of the figures and agreed defective trucks are dangerous, noted that Dutch results are reported to the European Commission every two years, and said harmonised defect classification will follow under EU directive 2014/47/EU by May 2018.
In accordance with Directive 2000/30/EC, the Netherlands records the results of technical inspections of commercial vehicles by the police, with assistance from the RDW.
Conform richtlijn 2000/30/EG registreert Nederland de resultaten van technische controles van bedrijfsvoertuigen door de politie, met assistentie van de RDW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het bericht “Machinisten Arriva: Veiligheid reiziger staat op het spel”

MPs Hoogland and Van Dekken asked about reported safety incidents (STS passages) involving temporary Arriva train drivers on the northern rail network, their training, and whether the ILT report should lead to talks with Arriva and VVMC. The State Secretary answered that only one incident is known to Arriva, that the driver was suspended and an ILT licence suspension started, that the training practice was not in breach of rules, and that ILT is investigating and further measures depend on the outcome.
Depending on the outcome of this investigation, I will inform your House whether it is desirable to take additional measures.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren of het wenselijk is extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Leenders over het bericht ‘Merwedebrug op A27 nog weken dicht voor vrachtverkeer wegens slijtage’

MPs Hoogland and Leenders asked the minister about the closure of the Merwedebrug for heavy traffic, its effects on buses, schoolchildren and hospital visitors, inspection findings, and compensation. The minister answered that detours, emergency bus timetables, repair works and a compensation procedure are in place, and that an evaluation with provinces will follow, but declined to exempt buses from the closure for safety reasons.
I have also committed to evaluating the closure process with them.
Ook heb ik toegezegd het proces van de afsluiting met hen te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland over het beginnersrijbewijs

Two MPs from VVD and PvdA asked the Ministers of Justice and of Infrastructure about weak enforcement undermining the beginners' driving licence, including stops, points, and police capacity. The government reported few suspensions since 2011, admitted unrecorded cases and capacity gaps, and promised an improvement trajectory and an evaluation of the scheme.
As indicated in the covering letter, there is an improvement trajectory regarding the beginners' scheme and the scheme will be evaluated.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief is er een verbetertraject met betrekking tot de beginnersregeling en zal de regeling geëvalueerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over ongelukken met fietsers bij de Heinenoordtunnel

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about cyclists falling on escalators and lifts at the Heinenoordtunnel, including whether toezichthouders may not help people and whether the lift was repeatedly out of order. The minister acknowledged the accidents, said supervisors are not there to help cyclists but may do so if asked, and listed measures such as using the ramp, curbing vandalism and possibly letting supervisors restart equipment.
Rijkswaterstaat is further examining whether supervisors can restart the lifts and/or escalators themselves after a fault report, without intervention by the contractor.
