Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt verder de mogelijkheid of de toezichthouders na storingsmelding de liften en/of de roltrappen zelf kunnen herstarten zonder tussenkomst van de aannemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Hoogland over tunnels voor dassen en otters

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about badger and otter tunnels, noting that 12 of 13 otter crossing problems ordered by a 2014 court ruling for 2015-2016 remain unresolved, and who is responsible for maintenance. The government answered that the problems are complex, responsibility for most tunnels lies with provinces and municipalities, one problem is solved and others are being investigated, with some targeted for 2017-2018.
The Court set phased deadlines within which measures, such as construction or repair of ledges, fences or culverts, must be implemented.
Het Hof stelde gefaseerde termijnen vast waarbinnen voorzieningen, zoals aanleg of herstel van looprichels, rasters of duikers, getroffen dienen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hoogland over problemen inzake autohuur in het buitenland

An MP asked ministers about problems Dutch consumers face when renting cars abroad, what actions were taken and the status of the EU-level Joint Action with car rental firms. The minister acknowledged the problems, described the EU-led self-cleaning process and stated that new rules are not opportune for now, while awaiting the effects of measures taken.
At this moment I do not consider it opportune to come with proposals for new rules, as we are still awaiting the effects of the measures taken.
Op dit moment acht ik het niet opportuun om te komen met voorstellen voor nieuwe regels, nu we nog in afwachting zijn van de effecten van de genomen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over het bericht ‘Miljoenenstrop door kosten aan Botlekbrug’

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister for a full account of the costs from the recurring Botlek bridge faults, borne by Rijkswaterstaat, other authorities and the contractor, and why the state pays some of them. The minister itemised costs (about 1.3 million euro for tug escorts, 1.37 million for monteurs, 37,500 for the SMS service, 24,500 for the review), said the state pays costs it chose to incur as network manager, and said repair costs fall to the contractor and that fault repairs are being finetuned.
Rijkswaterstaat has no knowledge of costs incurred by other authorities or other parties.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft geen kennis van kosten die gemaakt zijn door andere overheden of andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over mobiele dekking in spoor- en autotunnels

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of mobile coverage in rail and road tunnels, including the Delft rail tunnel, and why it was delayed. The State Secretary answered that coverage in the Delft tunnel became available on 12 May 2016, admitted it came later than wished, and promised to report to parliament in autumn 2016 on talks with providers and to inform on responsibilities and tunnel standards.
It would have been better for travellers if they had been able to use a well-functioning mobile network directly when the rail tunnel opened.
Het was voor de reizigers beter geweest wanneer zij direct bij open telling van de spoortunnel over een goed werkend mobiel netwerk hadden kunnen beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht «RDW gaat mogelijk Opel Zafira’s in heel Europa terugroepen»

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that the RDW might recall Opel Zafira cars across Europe, and about possible emissions-software irregularities at Fiat and the handling of such cases. The minister replied that no recall is yet underway, that the German KBA is investigating possible prohibited defeat devices, that no reason for further action has been found so far, and that Italian authorities are responsible for the Fiat investigation.
There is currently no recall planned. Should a recall come, the appropriate procedures will be followed.
Er is op dit moment geen terugroepactie voorzien. Mocht er een terugroepactie komen, dan zullen daarvoor de geëigende procedures worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht doorstroming A4 bij Leiden bijna net zo slecht als voor verbreding

An MP asked the minister about reports that traffic flow on the A4 near Leiden is nearly as poor as before widening, and whether a design error was made. The minister acknowledged rising congestion since 2013, defended the design, announced limited measures and a traffic study that will consider an extra lane, but refused to reopen the 2013 temporary layout or the Tracébesluit.
In addition, I will commission a traffic study into the problems on the A4, which will at least consider the solving capacity of an extra lane on the main carriageway.
Aanvullend zal ik een verkeerskundig onderzoek laten doen naar de problemen op de A4 en daarbij zal in elk geval gekeken worden naar het oplossend vermogen van een extra rijstrook op de hoofdrijbaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht 'RDW onderzoekt bijna 300 voertuigen op verkeersveiligheid'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the RDW's investigation of nearly 300 vehicles from a former car dealer in Swalmen, including the safety problems, whether the dealer's name should be disclosed, cost recovery, and the delay between the police raid and the RDW investigation. The minister answered that the vehicles have poorly repaired damage and stolen parts, that the dealer's name cannot yet be given due to a criminal investigation, that the EU ruling limits technical inspection at import so the RDW will consider further measures once facts are known, that owners must pursue legal steps themselves while RDW costs are still being assessed, and that the delay reflected multi-party preparation.
Because of the criminal investigation, the name of the company cannot be mentioned at this time.
Vanwege het strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan de naam van het bedrijf op dit moment niet genoemd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over aanhoudende problemen met de Botlekbrug en de Spijkenisserbrug

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked about repeated breakdowns of the Botlek bridge and the Spijkenisser bridge, including whether design faults exist and why Rijkswaterstaat cannot recover detour costs from contractor A-Lanes. The minister answered that the bridge was built as contracted, contractual penalties apply but detour damage cannot be recovered, Rijkswaterstaat has spent about 2.7 million euros on mitigation, and the integral analysis and design decision are due in autumn 2016.
Detour damage, however, cannot be recovered from the contractor on the basis of the contract.
Omrijschade kan op basis van het contract echter niet op de opdrachtnemer worden verhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het gebruik van chroom-6 verf bij de NS-Werkplaats in Tilburg

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked the ministers about chromium-6 paint exposure among re-integration participants at the NS workshop in Tilburg, including health symptoms, protection, liability and an independent medical examination. The minister answered that the employer is primarily responsible, that liability is for civil courts, that a medical consultation is available via CAOP, and that NedTrain's internal review found chromium-6 risks at several current sites with additional measures taken.
Who is civilly liable for any damage suffered in this case is a matter that can be assessed by the civil judge.
Wie er in dit geval civielrechtelijk aansprakelijk is voor eventueel geleden schade is een kwestie die door de civiele rechter kan worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het sjoemelen met spitsmijden

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports of widespread cheating in rush-hour avoidance (spitsmijden) projects, including whether improperly paid rewards must be repaid and whether a central exclusion database exists. The minister answered that no improper payments were made because checks run before payouts, that 3,600 participants were excluded, that repayment and sanctions are not warranted in the cases reported, and that a central database is undesirable on privacy grounds.
I am not aware that improper payments were made to the excluded participants.
Het is mij niet bekend dat onterechte uitbetalingen zijn gedaan aan de uitgesloten deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het onderzoek ‘Als de bliksem’ van de PvdA over het opvoeren van snorscooters

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, following a party study, why moped dealers affiliated with BOVAG so readily tune mopeds, and whether self-regulation and BOVAG remain suitable partners. The minister expressed disappointment, said BOVAG must do more and has been asked to tighten membership rules, but rejected banning tuning, lure-scooter checks, and ending the BOVAG cooperation for now.
I am therefore disappointed in the conduct of these dealers and expect Bovag to keep its promises and act even harder against members who tune mopeds.
Ik ben dan ook teleurgesteld in het gedrag van deze dealers en verwacht dat Bovag haar beloften waarmaakt en nog harder optreedt tegen leden die opvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Hoogland over het bericht dat milieuzones in steden worden tegengewerkt

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister whether the central government is undermining municipal discretion to set up environmental zones (milieuzones) for cleaner air, and how drivers can more easily know which zones apply. The minister denied any obstruction, said the government will drop the proposal to extend zone signage to passenger cars following the Visser motion, and said municipalities remain responsible and that communication on access rules is a local task.
The municipality is and remains responsible for taking local measures to improve air quality and can thereby proceed to establish an environmental zone.
De gemeente is en blijft verantwoordelijk voor het treffen van lokale maatregelen om de luchtkwaliteit te verbeteren en kan daarbij overgaan tot het instellen van een milieuzone.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Hoogland en Vermue over de gevolgen van het voornemen tot kilometerheffing in België voor de regio Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

MPs Hoogland and Vermue asked the minister about the effects on Zeeuws-Vlaanderen of Belgium's plans for a per-kilometre charge on passenger cars, and whether concrete steps had been taken. The minister replied that no concrete plans or timeline exist yet, that the decision lies with the Belgian regions, and that she will discuss cross-border effects with the Flemish minister once concrete plans emerge.
When there are concrete intentions, I am willing to talk with the Flemish Minister about possible cross-border effects.
Wanneer er sprake is van concrete voornemens ben ik bereid om met de Vlaamse Minister te gaan praten over mogelijke grenseffecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over veiligheidsnormen voor gemeentelijke bruggen en viaducten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about how municipalities assess safety, weight limits and measurement of their bridges and viaducts, and about enforcement and costs. The minister said municipalities, not the national government, are responsible, deferred most questions to a pending exploratory study by the Minister for Housing, and pointed to ongoing TNO research and NEN working groups, promising follow-up only after the study.
I have no insight into this.
Ik heb hier geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over mogelijke maatregelen naar aanleiding van de gepleegde fraude met dieselauto’s

MPs Hoogland asked the government about possible measures following the diesel emissions fraud at Volkswagen, covering prosecution, regulation, testing (WLTP and RDE), type approval and fiscal options. The government answered that no facts currently justify a criminal investigation, that Dutch national bans on type-approved diesel cars are legally excluded, and that it is pursuing stricter EU-level testing and market surveillance rules.
There are currently no facts or circumstances known on the basis of which the Public Prosecution Service can start a criminal investigation.
Er zijn thans geen feiten of omstandigheden bekend geworden op grond waarvan het Openbaar Ministerie een strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over strengere eisen aan elektrische auto’s

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the total costs of individually approving self-built or converted electric cars, the EMC certificate requirement, and whether earlier cost figures misled individuals. The Minister answered that costs are about EUR 1,700 for an average vehicle, that EMC tests must be done at accredited test houses, that earlier figures excluded some costs, and that compensation for small builders is not warranted.
I see no reason for my Ministry to compensate these costs, if only for state aid considerations.
Ik zie geen reden om vanuit mijn Ministerie deze kosten te compenseren, alleen al vanuit staatssteunoverwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Hoogland en Jan Vos over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’.

MPs Cegerek, Hoogland and Jan Vos asked the minister whether RIVM and TNO criticism of raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h, and of the air-quality modelling, was taken into account and whether the forecasts were sound. The minister replied that the methodology follows the legal framework and Raad van State practice, that monitoring will track NO2 and PM10 annually, and that some route boundaries were adjusted after objections.
In the annual NSL monitor it is checked whether the air quality limit values are exceeded.
In de jaarlijkse NSL-monitor wordt getoetst of de grenswaarden voor luchtkwaliteit worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de berichtgeving omtrent louche rijscholen die frauderen met theorie-examens

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about reports that driving schools use tricks and turbo courses so candidates pass the CBR theory exam, and whether the CBR and government will act. The minister acknowledges the reports, says the CBR has removed non-substantive mnemonics, commissioned an external review of exam questions, and that the CBR can terminate contracts with schools, while the government is in ongoing consultation with the sector and rejects the claim that exam validity is compromised.
Such figures cannot be provided, because 'turbo driving schools' are not registered as such.
Dergelijke cijfers zijn niet te geven, immers » turbo-rijscholen» zijn niet als zodanig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de fileproblematiek bij de Haringvlietbrug

An MP asked the minister about traffic congestion at the Haringvliet bridge after the new A4 near Steenbergen shifted freight routes toward Antwerp, and how bridge opening frequency relates to the jams. The minister said the traffic shift was anticipated, the current opening regime is proportionate, the norms for noise and air quality are not exceeded, and he is willing to consult transport sector, boating and local authorities and share the outcome with the House.
I am willing to consult with the transport sector, recreational boating and provincial and local authorities. I would like to share the outcome of the consultation with the House.
Ik ben bereid om in overleg te treden met de transportsector, recreatievaart en provinciale en lokale overheden. De uitkomsten van het overleg wil ik graag met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Hoogland over alcoholcontroles in het verkeer

MPs Volp and Hoogland asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about alcohol checks in traffic, including how many occur at night, whether the night-time share cited by EenVandaag is correct, and whether night-time enforcement chances are lower. Minister Van der Steur answered with tables showing most checks occur in the evening and night, that the cited 10 percent figure is incorrect, that police target checks by information, and that the data cannot separate offences by check type.
The police registration does not separately record how many offences are found per check.
In de politieregistratie wordt niet apart bijgehouden hoeveel overtredingen per controle worden geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal, Hoogland en Kerstens over het verloren gaan van 45 duizend gezonde levensjaren als gevolg van het VW-schandaal

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Volkswagen emissions scandal really caused 45,000 lost healthy life-years, and what it means for public health and mechanics' occupational risk. The State Secretary disputes that conclusion, says the extra NOx emissions are not quantified, notes that air quality limits are largely met, and points to the Air Quality Action Plan and EU efforts on real-driving emissions testing.
It is not known how much the emission of nitrogen oxides increases as a result of the software fraud as found at Volkswagen.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel de emissie van stikstofoxiden toeneemt als gevolg van de softwarefraude zoals die bij Volkswagen is geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Hoogland, Smaling en Van Helvert over het sluiten van overwegen door ProRail

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about ProRail's closure of level crossings, including the Laantje van Alverna private crossing, the status of a QuickScan on 100 unsupervised crossings, and how recreational interests are weighed. The State Secretary answered that ProRail follows the agreed procedure with the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking, that recreational interests are weighed in the Omgevingswet process, and that clarification on definitions will follow in spring 2016.
Nevertheless, I note that there is uncertainty between ProRail and the other members of the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking about some definitions in the procedure.
Niettemin constateer ik dat er tussen ProRail en de overige leden van de Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking over sommige definities uit de procedure onduidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over de inhuur van een interimmer door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about the hiring of an interim director by Rijkswaterstaat at a rate above the Balkenende norm, covering reimbursed living costs, non-publication in annual reports and the absence of a tender. The minister acknowledges the rate exceeded the norm for five months in 2013 and that it was not reported in the 2013 annual report, but defends the arrangement as a justified exception and promises stricter reporting of deviations.
I will monitor more strictly that such deviations are consistently reported to the House of Representatives.
Ik zal strakker toezien op het consequent melden van dergelijke afwijkingen aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hoogland over eenvoudige compensatie voor treinreizigers die achterblijven op het perron

MP Hoogland asked whether NS's structural capacity shortage justifies a simple compensation scheme for passengers left behind on overcrowded trains. The State Secretary answered that NS has no such scheme, that individual eligibility is hard to verify, and that monitoring and an external review with consumer groups will follow instead.
Of course I will continue to closely monitor the implementation of the measures announced by NS to see whether NS continues to meet the requirements of the concession.
Uiteraard blijf ik de uitvoering van de door NS aangekondigde maatregelen nauwgezet monitoren om te bezien of de NS blijft voldoen aan de vereisten uit de concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland inzake storingen Botlekbrug

MPs Visser and Hoogland asked about recurring malfunctions of the Botlek bridge since its July 2015 opening, including costs to businesses, causes, a review team, diversion of hazardous goods traffic, and whether pressure from Rijkswaterstaat contributed to premature opening. The minister answered that the faults are being fixed and a review is underway, but declined to hold the contractor financially liable and said no commitments on hazardous goods exemptions had been made.
Rijkswaterstaat cannot hold A-Lanes liable for compensating the costs resulting from the detours.
Rijkswaterstaat kan A-Lanes niet aanspreken op het vergoeden van de kosten ten gevolge van het omrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Hoogland en Visser over onnodige files als gevolg van tunneldoseren

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister whether tunnel metering (tunneldosering) causes unnecessary traffic jams, citing VID findings, and asked about its purpose, effectiveness, use in new tunnels, and communication to drivers. The minister maintained that metering prevents jams inside tunnels, admitted uncertainty about side effects, and committed to further research into the effects on traffic flow.
Because doubts remain in the media and among road users about the effect of tunnel metering on traffic flow (a side effect), I am however willing to investigate this further.

Omdat er in de media en bij weggebruikers twijfels blijven bestaan over het effect van tunneldoseren op de verkeersdoorstroming (een neveneffect) ben ik echter wel bereid dit nog nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de veiligheid van de A4-tunnel Midden-Delfland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether cracks and detached concrete sections in the A4 Midden-Delfland tunnel were serious, whether they relate to earlier criticism and to reinforcement and monitoring. The minister answered that the damage was repaired, the structure meets all norms, monitoring continues until the municipality of Schiedam releases it, and no link to earlier criticism exists.
Rijkswaterstaat will continue to specifically monitor the repairs until the municipality of Schiedam, as competent authority (permit issuer), indicates that monitoring is no longer necessary.
Rijkswaterstaat blijft specifiek op de reparaties monitoren tot de gemeente Schiedam als bevoegd gezag (vergunningverlener) aangeeft dat monitoring niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Van Dekken, Nijboer over de stremming van het treinverkeer tussen Bad Nieuweschans en Leer

MPs asked the State Secretary about the closure of the rail bridge between Bad Nieuweschans and Leer, its duration, passenger and freight impacts, alternatives, and consequences for the Groningen–Bremen rail project's national funding and EU grant. The State Secretary answered that replacement may take 3 to 5 years, will write to the German counterpart, provides replacement buses, and says funding conditions and the EU study budget are still being assessed.
In the short term I will send my German counterpart a letter drawing attention to the current disruption.
Op korte termijn zal ik mijn Duitse ambtscollega een brief sturen, waarin ik aandacht zal vragen voor de huidige hinder
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘Mat ’64 kan tot 2017 in dienst blijven’

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Mat '64 trains could remain in service until 2017, how removing them fits the 'passenger first' principle, and why NS and the ILT gave conflicting accounts of withdrawing them. The state secretary answered that NS decides fleet deployment under the concession, that NS's safety system and parts shortages prevent longer use, and that the ILT only issued a non-binding signal, so the trains are no longer planned for service from 2016 except as emergency reserve.
Issuing such a signal gives the organisation concerned, in this case NS, an opportunity for improvement, but does not lead to a legally enforceable obligation.
Het afgeven van zo'n signaal biedt de betreffende organisatie, in dit geval NS, een kans voor verbetering, maar leidt niet tot een juridisch afdwingbare verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Hoogland over de aanvraag van een OV-begeleiderskaart

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Hoogland asked why applying for an OV-begeleiderskaart requires a five-page questionnaire and an IQ test on top of a CIZ indication, and whether these burdens could be dropped when a valid CIZ indication exists. The State Secretary agreed partly: a CIZ indication suffices as proof in one specific case (IQ test no longer required for those with an AWBZ/Wlz 24-hour care indication), reviews of the questionnaire are planned for early next year, but data exchange with CIZ is not straightforwardly permitted under privacy law.

I also want to explore with the indication body for the OV-begeleiderskaart whether the questionnaire can be made more concrete regarding required evidence, so that one piece of evidence per criterion suffices.

Ik wil daarnaast met de indicatiesteller voor de OV-begeleiderskaart bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de vragenlijst op het punt van de benodigde bewijsstukken zodanig te concretiseren dat er met één bewijsstuk per criterium volstaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Zeeland beter af met een Intercity'

MPs Hoogland and Albert de Vries asked the State Secretary about a report claiming Zeeland would benefit from an Intercity stopping only at the three largest stations and about related rail options. The State Secretary called the report a rough quickscan, said the options could be discussed in the regional public transport table, and declined to endorse the claimed figures without further study.
Without research, no accurate statement can be made about this.
Zonder onderzoek is hier geen nauwkeurige uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het sjoemelen met spitsmijden

An MP asked the minister how drivers could easily cheat the peak-avoidance (spitsmijden) scheme Wild! Van de spits, and whether such attempts at fraud should disqualify participants and how large the fraud is. The minister acknowledged the reports, described the verification controls, excluded 949 of 12,638 participants (7.5%), and said fraud is hard to prove, while promising to return to the topic in the MIRT consultation in spring 2016.
It cannot be ruled out that there are participants who knowingly break the rules.
Niet kan worden uitgesloten dat er deelnemers zijn die bewust de regels overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over een verbod op kamperende vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked whether Dutch truck drivers are forced to spend weekend rest in their cabs at unserviced parking areas, whether stricter rules in neighbouring countries drive them to Dutch parking spots, and whether the government will adopt a national ban on sleeping in trucks as proposed by CNV, or pursue harmonised EU enforcement. The minister answered that no figures exist on forced cab rest, that a ban conflicts with the policy of using secured truck parkings, and that the government supports EU harmonisation, with a Commission road package expected in 2016.
The cabinet is in favour of clear European policy, so that uniform interpretation and enforcement is achieved across the various EU member states.
Het kabinet is voorstander van een duidelijk Europees beleid, zodat eenduidige interpretatie en handhaving in de diverse EU-lidstaten wordt bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Jacobi over het wegpompen van grondwater bij de A4 Midden-Delfland

MPs Hoogland and Jacobi asked the Minister about groundwater pumping at the A4 Midden-Delfland tunnel, including its causes, responsibility, impacts and whether the road can open by year-end. The Minister confirmed the problem, said the contractor is responsible for design and construction, and deferred the outcome to a pending Hoogheemraadschap decision expected in December, while describing further measures and reporting to the Chamber if desired.
Given the ongoing procedure at the Hoogheemraadschap, I do not want to anticipate the outcome of this procedure.
Ik wil gezien de lopende procedure bij het Hoogheemraadschap niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van deze procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht “Scheurtjes in tunnel A4 Midden-Delfland”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about cracks in the new Ketheltunnel on the A4 and whether they relate to an engineer's earlier criticism of the design. The minister answered that the cracks were repaired, the structure is safe, the earlier criticism was checked by independent experts, and the opening is still planned for the turn of the year, while the groundwater pumping question is left to the water board's pending procedure.
Given the ongoing procedure at the water board, I do not wish to anticipate the outcome of that procedure.
Ik wil gezien de lopende procedure bij het Hoogheemraadschap niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst van deze procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het als nieuw verkopen van geïmporteerde sloopauto’s

An MP asked the minister about imported US salvage cars being resold as new via other EU countries, such as Lithuania, and about inspection, liability and possible EU-level measures. The minister said the RDW tracks only the last EU registration, offered RDW figures on Lithuanian imports with few WOK statuses, saw no concrete signs of inadequate Lithuanian inspection, and declined to refuse recognition of Lithuanian inspections.
I have no insight into the total number of vehicles with a damage history from the US offered in the Netherlands for re-registration via other EU countries.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de totale hoeveelheid voertuigen die met een schadeverleden vanuit de VS via andere EU-landen worden aangeboden in Nederland voor herinschrijving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht “Miljardenverspilling om bruggen te ‘verbeteren’”

An MP asked whether municipalities will spend about five billion euros replacing bridges and viaducts that may still be sound, and whether the Moerdijk bridge set an excessive structural standard. The minister said bridge safety and replacement at municipal level are not her responsibility, that the rules allow realistic traffic loads rather than Moerdijk-level loads, and that work to get better traffic measurements is under way.
As Minister of Infrastructure and the Environment, I am not responsible for the safety assessment and replacement of municipal bridges and viaducts.
Als Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu ben ik niet verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheidsbeoordeling en vervanging van gemeentelijke bruggen en viaducten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de bereikbaarheid per spoor van Dordrecht

An MP asked the state secretary whether NS plans to drop the Intercity between Dordrecht and Breda-Tilburg-Eindhoven, whether Dordrecht will remain well connected by rail, whether freight can use the HSL-Zuid, and whether he will convene the parties. The answer confirms NS plans to route the Den Haag-Eindhoven Intercity via the HSL, leaving Dordrecht without it, but says talks on keeping a Dordrecht-Breda link, including co-financing, are ongoing with a decision planned for spring 2016.
I will inform you of this decision.
Ik zal u over dit besluit informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Hoogland over vertraging van de aanpak van de verkeersveiligheid op de N35

MPs Visser (VVD) and Hoogland (PvdA) asked why improvements to road safety on the N35 between Wijthmen and Nijverdal are delayed, whether Rijkswaterstaat is blocking local 'Raalte mobiel' initiatives, and what the planning is. The minister admitted a delay caused by limited staffing of the project team, said work is expected to start in December with a participation process and reprioritisation, and insisted the 2018 realisation target and the 2014 administrative agreement still stand.
It is correct that a delay has arisen in the start of the elaboration of the measures from the administrative agreement.
Het klopt dat vertraging is ontstaan in de start van de uitwerking van de maatregelen uit de bestuursovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht 'Verkeer rond scholen onveilig voor kinderen'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a report on traffic safety around primary schools, its causes, effective measures, and the roles of local, regional and national government. The minister answered that school traffic safety is primarily a municipal responsibility, that the national government can only stimulate and facilitate, and that no national inventory of effective measures is planned.
Traffic safety around schools is primarily a responsibility of the local government.
Verkeersveiligheid rond scholen is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Hoogland over de berichtgeving rondom de fraude met emissiesoftware door Volkswagen

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Infrastructure and Environment how Volkswagen manipulated emissions tests, whether other brands or EU countries are affected, how US and EU testing differ, and what should be done to check Dutch and EU effects. The government referred several answers to earlier answers, confirmed NOx emissions in practice are much higher than the EU norm, said the RDW cannot yet determine vehicle numbers, and described that the German type-approval authority KBA has set Volkswagen a deadline for a remedy.
As soon as the necessary data are available, the RDW will determine the numbers.
Zodra de noodzakelijke gegevens beschikbaar zijn zal de RDW de aantallen achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht "NS wil corrupt Qbuzz aan Fransen verkopen"

MP Hoogland asked whether NS is secretly selling its bus subsidiary Qbuzz to the French railways in exchange for shares in Thalys, whether other units like Abellio are for sale, how this serves Dutch travellers, and whether it is linked to the Limburg tender irregularities. The Minister of Finance answered that NS is still in a strategic reorientation of its regional activities, that talks with parties are exploratory, that the government will not anticipate the outcome, and that the analysis and government view on NS's positioning will be sent to Parliament this autumn.
Until then, I do not consider it opportune or in the interest of NS and the state as shareholder of NS to anticipate the outcomes of the strategic reorientation
Tot die tijd acht ik het niet opportuun en niet in het belang van NS en de staat als aandeelhouder van NS om vooruit te lopen op de uitkomsten van de strategische heroriëntatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Haven gaat zelf treinlijn opzetten’

Two MPs asked whether the Rotterdam port authority's plan to invest in rail lines raises questions about the government's role and public control over the tracks. The minister answered that the port invests in rail services through the 'rail incubator' programme rather than in infrastructure, that the ministry has no role in strategic port choices but supports initiatives within the Havenvisie 2030, and that the port operates as an independent company with public control limited to safety rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment has no role in strategic choices of the Port of Rotterdam Authority.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu heeft geen rol bij strategische keuzes van het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over het 06-bereik in de spoortunnel Delft

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked why no mobile coverage is planned in the new Delft rail tunnel, whether providers and ProRail have made concrete agreements, and whether the provider-initiated permit system is optimal. The Secretary of State confirms there is no coverage for now, says providers declined to invest on cost grounds, that ProRail offered to share costs and proactively approached providers, and that providers remain responsible for mobile infrastructure, which he does not consider a government responsibility.
In principle the providers remain responsible for the construction and investment in mobile infrastructure.
Ten principale blijven de providers verantwoordelijk voor de aanleg en investering in mobiele infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Visser over storingen aan de Botlekbrug

MPs Hoogland and Visser asked the minister about repeated malfunctions of the new Botlek bridge since its opening, including traffic impact, the adequacy of Rijkswaterstaat's testing, cost responsibility under the DBFM contract, and the division of responsibilities. The minister acknowledged 18 malfunctions were too many, defended RWS's handling and testing as adequate, stated that the contractor bears repair costs and that no design errors were found, and announced corrective measures and a further evaluation of the testing process.
RWS has no insight into the costs incurred, because these are for the account of the contractor.
RWS heeft geen inzicht in de gemaakte kosten, omdat deze voor rekening van de opdrachtnemer zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Helvert over onjuiste informatie over treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Hoogland and Van Helvert asked the Infrastructure and Environment state secretary about inaccurate information on trains carrying dangerous goods, including inspection powers, ProRail's role, unregistered cargo and ghost/orphan wagons. The state secretary answered that the ILT's powers and resources are adequate, that ProRail is not a supervisor, that a legal duty to register non-dangerous goods is not currently warranted, and that improvement will be pursued with the sector.
The powers and enforcement options the ILT has at its disposal I consider sufficient, as are the resources available for them.
De bevoegdheden en handhavingmogelijkheden die de ILT voorhanden heeft, acht ik voldoende, evenals de daarvoor beschikbare middelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over de berichten ‘Boete voor wachtende chauffeurs’ en ‘Verstopt tussen bloemen en wasmachines; Hoek van Holland geliefde startplaats gelukszoekers’

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether truck drivers are fined under driving and rest-time rules although the stowaway problem at Calais and Hoek van Holland makes compliance unreasonable, and what is being done about port controls and infrastructure. The government says enforcement of rest times is a priority, that exceptional situations allow deviation, that the minister has raised concerns with the EU Commissioner and French and British counterparts, and that enhanced intelligence-led controls by the Marechaussee are in place without infrastructure measures for now.
It is up to the carrier to draw up a schedule within the limits of this regulation.
Het is aan de vervoerder om binnen de grenzen van deze regelgeving een planning te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Angstcultuur bij vervoersbedrijf Hermes’

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports of a fear-based culture at bus operator Hermes, the government's responsibilities, and whether concession-holders can be selected on social criteria. The minister replied that the report is not yet published, that personnel policy is the operator's responsibility, that the province and Inspectie SZW can act if concession terms or labour law are breached, and that social aspects may be included in tenders within legal limits.
At this moment the report has not yet been published, so it is not yet known what the facts are regarding the corporate culture of bus operator Hermes.
Op dit moment is het rapport nog niet gepubliceerd en is het dus nog niet bekend wat de feiten zijn rondom de bedrijfscultuur van het vervoersbedrijf Hermes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Hoogland over het gebruik van RFID-chips in kentekens

MPs Oosenbrug and Hoogland asked about a planned RFID-chip trial in licence plates, including the technical design, data access, privacy safeguards and alternatives to combat plate fraud. The government described a test at a defence training centre, deferred decisions on data access and whether to adopt the chip until results are known, and promised a later government position and parliamentary debate.
Once the results of these tests are known, the cabinet will take a position on whether or not to introduce an RFID chip in licence plates.
Op het moment dat de resultaten van deze testen bekend zijn, zal het kabinet een standpunt innemen over de wenselijkheid van het al dan niet doorvoeren van een RFID-chip in kentekenplaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over re-integratie in Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports that re-integration practice in Rotterdam amounted to intimidation of benefit recipients, and whether the state would act on the ombudsman's recommendations. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that under the Participatiewet implementation is a municipal responsibility, the municipal council is the proper overseer, no contact with the Rotterdam ombudsman is planned, and the issue is being handled locally.

Given the decentralisation of responsibilities under the Participatiewet, it is for the municipality to decide how it shapes its policy on the Participatiewet, labour market reintegration and the counter-performance.

Gezien de decentralisatie van verantwoordelijkheden in de Participatiewet is het aan de gemeente om te bepalen op welke wijze zij hun beleid met betrekking tot de Participatiewet en daarmee de arbeidstoeleiding van werkzoekenden en de tegenprestatie willen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Geen boete abonnementhouder zwartrijden’

MPs De Boer and Hoogland asked the state secretary about reports that passengers with subscriptions are fined for forgetting to check in when their travel right is already paid for, and about the Rover/Consumentenbond research and the number of disputes. The state secretary defended the mandatory check-in for uniformity and traveller benefits, said he asked carriers for a coulance policy, and that he lacks data on court appeals and on which subscriptions and carriers fine such travellers.
I have asked the carriers to come up with a joint coulance policy for this.
Ik heb de vervoerders gevraagd hiervoor gezamenlijk met een coulancebeleid te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht ‘Wegpiraat ontloopt zijn straf’

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether the number of fines for serious traffic offences had fallen sharply, what explains the drop in stops since 2007, and how the government will respond. The Minister answered that criminal traffic stops have been stable (around 84,000 a year), attributed the earlier decline mainly to lower traffic volume and the abolition of ticket quotas, said the actual detection probability cannot be determined, and noted an early start to a new repeat-offender approach from 1 January 2015.
The number of stops for criminal traffic offences has been stable in recent years.
Het aantal staandehoudingen voor strafrechtelijke verkeersovertredingen is de laatste jaren stabiel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht «Bonnenregen onterecht»

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether many motorists were wrongly fined on the N261 near Tilburg due to roadworks and unclear speed limits, and what would be done about it. The Minister of Justice replied that the public prosecutor found no evidence the fines were wrong, that individual appeals remain possible, that no separate count of wrongful fines is kept, and that no new measures are planned beyond the earlier answer.
I cannot provide such an overview. No separate registration is kept of this.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan ik niet geven. Hiervan wordt geen aparte registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over de aanpak van gevaarlijke overwegen

MPs De Boer and Hoogland asked the state secretary about dangerous unguarded level crossings in the Netherlands, including the Voslaan crossing in Winsum, and whether a risk ranking, the Groningen study, LVO or ProRail funding, and innovative solutions could be provided. The state secretary answered that 154 publicly accessible unguarded crossings exist on the passenger network, promised an integrated approach and ranking to the Chamber in May, reserved 10 million euro from the LVO for Winsum with regional co-financing, and said innovative options are being explored.
As promised to your Chamber during the General Consultation on Rail Safety on 27 November, you will receive a proposal this spring for an integrated approach to non-actively secured level crossings.

Zoals aan uw Kamer toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Spoorveiligheid op 27 november jongstleden ontvangt u dit voorjaar een voorstel voor de integrale aanpak van niet-actief beveiligde overwegen (nabo's).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Fokke over nieuw onderzoek naar de IJzeren Rijn

PvdA MPs Hoogland and Fokke asked the State Secretary about a new Flemish-led study into reactivating the IJzeren Rijn rail line, including which routes are examined, whether Dutch government funds the study, and whether outcomes are agreed in advance. The State Secretary answered that three routes will be studied, Dutch co-funding is conditional and not fixed, no agreements on outcomes exist yet, and Limburg has now been informed.
Further agreements on the study have not yet been made; Flanders intends to organise a high level meeting with the five involved governments
Verdere afspraken over de studie zijn nog niet gemaakt; Vlaanderen is voornemens een «high level meeting» met de vijf betrokken overheden te organiseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over een intercitystation in Harderwijk

An MP asked whether Harderwijk station should become an InterCity stop and whether the MIRT study into a Utrecht-Weesp-Harderwijk triangle could be accelerated. The state secretary answered that the timetable is NS's decision, that NS sees no plans to add InterCity stops given more travellers would be disadvantaged, and that the MIRT study's timing cannot be accelerated, with a decision expected in autumn 2015.
It is not possible to accelerate the decision-making on a possible MIRT exploration.
Het is niet mogelijk om de besluitvorming over een eventuele MIRT-verkenning te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat Arriva,  Veolia en Connexxion samenspannen tegen NS

An MP asked whether secret agreements among public transport operators (Arriva, Veolia, Connexxion) coordinated legal action against NS, and what the government would do given possible Mededingingswet violations. The state secretary replied that the competition regulator ACM is responsible for assessing and investigating such conduct, that exclusion from tenders requires a final conviction, and that litigation costs are not known.
It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), as an independent supervisor, to assess whether there is reason to start an investigation into a possible violation of the Competition Act.

Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om als onafhankelijke toezichthouder te beoordelen of er aanleiding is om een onderzoek te starten naar een mogelijke overtreding van de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘Storing Spijkenisserbrug duurt langer’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about repeated faults on the Spijkenisse bridge, whether regular maintenance had taken place, and what measures would resolve the problem. The minister answered that the bridge is in the regular maintenance programme, that the cause of the latest faults is not yet known, and listed measures taken, including a broader investigation and possible earlier renovation.
A comprehensive investigation has now been started to determine the cause of the faults.
Er is nu een uitgebreid onderzoek gestart om de oorzaak van de storingen te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de aanbesteding van openbaar vervoer in Limburg

An MP from the Labour Party asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the Limburg public transport tender, including whether the government will investigate it and whether the bidding is fair. The State Secretary answers that the province is the contracting authority responsible for the tender, that Veolia's bid was declared invalid, and that no investigation is planned because only the province can request one from the competition authority.

Since the Ministry of IenM is not the contracting authority for the Limburg concession, no answer can be given to questions on the accuracy of facts reported in the Volkskrant article as far as the tender is concerned.
Aangezien het Ministerie van IenM niet de aanbestedende partij is van de concessie in Limburg kan geen antwoord worden gegeven op de vragen die ingaan op de juistheid of onjuistheid van feiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de busconcessie Groningen-Drenthe

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a second extension of the Groningen-Drenthe bus concession was being challenged, and whether this conflicted with the government's focus on the traveller. The State Secretary answered that the extension is a disagreement between parties over applicable procurement law, that it could go to court, that service to travellers is not interrupted, and that the ministry has no instruments to lower tender costs.
The OV Bureau Groningen-Drenthe wants to extend this concession again by two years, to the end of 2019.
Het OV Bureau Groningen-Drenthe wil deze concessie nogmaals met twee jaar verlengen tot eind 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de veiligheid op de N36 tussen Almelo en Ommen

An MP asked the minister whether lowering the N36 speed limit to 80 km/h should be studied and which behaviour-influencing measures could improve safety on the road. The minister replied that a 2013 study found a speed reduction not effective, that eight improvement measures are planned for 2015-2018 with additional options under review, and that communication and enforcement are not warranted at present.
Based on the study, it was concluded among other things that lowering the maximum speed is not an effective measure.
Op basis van het onderzoek is o.a. geconcludeerd dat het verlagen van de maximumsnelheid geen effectieve maatregel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over het bericht “Bomalarm op station Leiden door misverstand”

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked about a bomb alarm at Leiden Central station caused by a camera rig hung there by a media agency's technician for ad-viewing measurement. The government described the sequence of events, said NS had been aware of the test but failed to communicate it internally, rejected that anyone acted knowingly, and found no criminal offence.
The incident must therefore be regarded as an unwise action combined with poor communication.
Het gebeurde moet dan ook beschouwd worden als een onverstandige actie in combinatie met gebrekkige communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de voorstellen van het Letse EU-voorzitterschap met betrekking tot het Vierde Spoorwegpakket

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Latvian EU presidency's new proposal on the PSO regulation within the Fourth Railway Package, which removes direct award of public transport rail concessions and may conflict with Dutch and European Parliament positions. The State Secretary confirmed the proposal drops direct award, said it conflicts with the Dutch position, and pledged to keep arguing for member-state choice in Transport Council meetings and bilateral contacts.
This proposal is part of the political pillar – or market pillar – of the 4th railway package.
Dit voorstel is onderdeel van de politieke pijler – of marktpijler – van het 4 e spoorpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hoogland over voortdurende agressie tegen NS-personeel

Two MPs asked the government about persistent aggression against NS rail staff, including survey figures, prosecution rates and measures taken. The minister acknowledged the problem, gave differing incident figures, said police and prosecutors do not register NS-specific cases, and listed existing and planned measures.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS-personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het SOMO-onderzoek naar misstanden op bouwprojecten waarvan Rijkswaterstaat de opdrachtgever is

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether Rijkswaterstaat, as client, checks compliance with labour rules and minimum wage/cao obligations in subcontracting chains on road projects, and whether standard contracts should refer to them. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat requires compliance with statutory rules and checks Arbeidsomstandighedenwet and foreign-worker rules, but lacks powers over cao wage compliance, which lies with cao parties, the Inspectie SZW and sectoral bodies, so no change to standard contracts or project screening is planned beyond supporting competent authorities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Poolse werknemers uitgebuit ; vakbond FNV Bouw meldt flinke reeks misstanden bij verbreding A15’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Social Affairs ministers about reports of exploitation of Polish workers on the A15 widening, including underpayment, lack of insurance and unpaid overtime. The minister said the allegations could not yet be confirmed, that the Labour Inspectorate had inspected the site in April 2014 without finding minimum-wage or working-time violations, and that investigations and new contractor-liability rules were underway.

These cases are currently being investigated by the special team of the Labour Inspectorate responsible for tackling sham constructions and supporting social partners in enforcing collective agreement conditions.

Deze zaken worden thans onderzocht door het speciale team van de Inspectie SZW dat belast is met de aanpak van schijnconstructies en de ondersteuning van sociale partners bij de handhaving van de cao-voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘Treinstoring? Binnen 45 seconden een nooddienstregeling’

An MP asked the state secretary about news reports on a PhD thesis proposing mathematical models for rapid timetable adjustment during rail disruptions, and what recommendations, implementation plans and benefits apply. The state secretary replied that timetabling is NS's responsibility, that NS supports the research and is adapting its personnel software, and that models will supplement rather than replace standard draft plans, with predefined measures to be tested in 2015.
There are no plans to replace standard draft plans with automatic computer models.
Er zijn geen plannen om standaard draaiboeken te vervangen door automatische computermodellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over een kranteninterview met NS-topman Timo Huges

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper interview with the NS chief executive on door-to-door travel, cooperation among operators, single check-in pilots, student travel and overcrowded trains. The state secretary answered that cooperation is promoted through existing platforms, pilots and concession requirements, and that NS will be held to account on capacity without any compensation obligation.
I will inform the House very shortly about the transport plan.
Ik informeer uw Kamer zeer binnenkort over het vervoerplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de uitstoot van elektrische auto’s

An MP asked the state secretary about a study claiming electric cars emit as much particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether a full lifecycle, real-world assessment of car pollution will be commissioned. The government calls the study one-sided, says electric cars emit about a third less particulate matter overall, and points to a recent CE-Delft/TNO lifecycle study showing about 35% lower CO2 but does not commit to a new independent study.
Are you willing to commission an independent study that at least includes the elements mentioned in question 4?
Bent u bereid om een onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren, waarin in ieder geval de in vraag 4 genoemde elementen worden betrokken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het ongeval op de spoorwegovergang in Winsum van 14 oktober jongstleden

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary about a fatal accident at the Voslaan level crossing in Winsum and what measures ProRail would take to prevent future accidents. The government answered that talks with the municipality on closing or securing the crossing are ongoing, that a study of 22 crossings in Winsum is underway with concrete measures being costed, and that an evaluation of the non-actively secured crossings and a follow-up approach will be requested from ProRail.
To this end I will ask ProRail to carry out an evaluation in the coming months of the effectiveness of the approach to non-actively secured level crossings in recent years.
Daartoe zal ik ProRail vragen in de komende maanden een evaluatie te doen op de effectiviteit van de aanpak van de niet-actief beveiligde overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Cegerek over het bericht ‘Akzonobel overweegt chloortransport’

MPs Hoogland and Cegerek asked about risks of a possible chlorine transport by Akzo Nobel, who responsibility if something goes wrong, the criteria for incidental transports, and the necessity given a strike-related shortage. The State Secretary replied that strict rules and ILT supervision apply, that the company is primarily responsible, that a 2002 covenant allows limited incidental transports, and that the labour conflict is a matter between employer and employees.
For incidental chlorine transports there is 100% control, meaning all chlorine transports are checked against the applicable regulations.
Bij incidentele chloortransporten is er sprake van 100% controle wat inhoudt dat alle chloortransporten op de van toepassing zijnde regelgeving worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het grote aantal klachten over reizen met de OV-chipkaart

An MP asked the State Secretary about the large number of complaints over OV-chipkaart travel, including multiple check-ins, pay-by-account travel, bank card payment and the 2.50 euro fee for refunding card balance. The State Secretary answered that pilots and NOVB discussions are underway, and committed to report progress and to raise the refund fee within the NOVB.
I undertake to raise this in the NOVB.
Ik zeg u toe dat ik dit in zal brengen in het NOVB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat toegangspoortjes op stations gevaarlijk kunnen zijn

MP Hoogland asked the State Secretary whether NS ticket gates that close suddenly are dangerous, how often people are injured, whether they meet safety requirements, and what will be done. The State Secretary answered that 25 people reported injuries to NS between January and September 2014, that the gates meet European safety rules and 76 acceptance criteria, and that NS will monitor incidents and evaluate gate timing if more occur.
I ask NS to closely monitor and evaluate incidents.
Ik vraag NS om nauwlettend incidenten te monitoren en te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over een bericht in het Eindhovens Dagblad van 28 mei 2014, dat reizen naar Brussel per Thalys goedkoper is met een kaartje naar Parijs

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked why a Thalys ticket to Brussels can be cheaper when bought as a ticket to Paris, and whether the minister would negotiate with NS to offer the cheapest possible fare. The state secretary explained that Thalys uses yield management pricing set by seat availability and expected demand, that the Thalys is not regulated by national or European rules so operators set their own fares, and that more Thalys services are expected to increase cheaper ticket options.
The Thalys is a train product that is not regulated by national or European rules.
De Thalys is een treinproduct dat niet door nationale of Europese regels wordt gereguleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Hoogland over negatieve ervaringen en klachten van rolstoelgebruikers met betrekking tot het openbaar busvervoer

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Hoogland asked about complaints from wheelchair users refused on buses, including broken wheelchair ramps, and whether the government will engage with users and operators. The government agreed accessible public transport matters, said the Human Rights Board ruling shows non-working ramps breach rules, noted operator Veolia is taking measures, and said the IenM state secretary will urge the sector to clarify rights for electric wheelchair users.
A recent ruling (no. 2014-50) of the Human Rights Board makes clear that a non-working wheelchair ramp is inconsistent with the Dutch rules on accessibility for wheelchair users.

Uit een recent oordeel (nr. 2014–50) van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens komt duidelijk naar voren dat een niet-werkende rolstoelplank zich niet verhoudt met de regels die in Nederland gelden voor toegankelijkheid van mensen met een rolstoel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Otwin van Dijk over het oordeel van het College voor de Rechten van Mens over het door Veolia gemaakte onderscheid op basis van handicap of chronische ziekte

MPs Hoogland and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about a College for Human Rights ruling that transport operator Veolia discriminated against a wheelchair user by not providing temporary assistance. The State Secretary said the ruling reinforces the need for broader accessibility measures, that the province as concession grantor is responsible and has held talks, and that he will bring the ruling to the attention of the concession-granting bodies' associations.
I will also bring this to the attention of the province of Limburg, which manages the concession, by letter.
Ik zal dit ook per brief onder de aandacht brengen van de provincie Limburg die de concessie beheert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over de gebrekkige dekking van telefoonproviders in het spoor- en metronettunnels

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked the State Secretary about poor mobile coverage in rail and metro tunnels, including whether ProRail and telecom providers can improve it and who is responsible for new tunnels. The State Secretary replied that providers initiate permit applications which ProRail assesses for safety and interference, that constructive talks are underway, that metro networks are primarily the responsibility of municipalities, and that he will raise the issue with local authorities.
ProRail has informed me that several permit applications are currently being processed and that constructive consultation is taking place on them.
ProRail heeft mij geïnformeerd dat er momenteel verschillende vergunning-aanvragen in behandeling zijn en dat hierover constructief overleg plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat EBS buslijnen met een sociale functie schrapt

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that EBS was cutting bus lines with a social function after a costly tendering miscalculation, and whether service, cao compliance, tender costs and legal risks were affected. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies with the Stadsregio Amsterdam and EBS, that the changes are seen as an improvement by the Stadsregio, that consumer groups are broadly positive, and gave tender cost figures, while declining to take responsibility for staff policy.
In this matter, responsibility therefore lies with the Stadsregio Amsterdam as concession grantor and with bus company EBS as concession holder.
In deze kwestie ligt de verantwoordelijkheid dan ook bij de stadsregio Amsterdam als concessieverlener en bij het busbedrijf EBS als de concessiehouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over problemen met de wissels op het spoor

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked the state secretary about railway switch failures and related ProRail maintenance and knowledge gaps, including the lack of spare parts and whether preventive replacement was done. The state secretary answered that no specific repair deadlines are set in the management plan, that spare parts were procured via a Swedish counterpart and urgent order, and that the ILT and Safety Board investigations are ongoing with ILT results expected in Q3 2014.
The ILT investigation focuses on the role of the switch and the rolling stock in the derailment and the operation of the signals.
Het onderzoek van de ILT richt zich op de rol van het wissel en het materieel bij de ontsporing en de werking van de seinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over de toename van agressie tegen treinpersoneel

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked the ministers about rising aggression against rail staff, the measures taken with NS, the role of passengers and bystanders, use of Burgernet, and the arrest rate and sentences for offenders. The minister answered that NS takes measures such as cameras, security teams, training and a 24-hour control centre, that bystander e-learning and a publicity campaign are planned, that Burgernet is unsuitable, and that offender statistics are not registered separately and referred to an earlier study on sentencing.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen in die systemen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Jacobi en Monasch over de spoorverbinding met Leeuwarden in verband met het besluit Leeuwarden te nomineren als Culturele Hoofdstad 2018

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary how rail services to Leeuwarden will cope with extra visitors if it is Culturele Hoofdstad 2018, and whether NS will offer incentives or a cultural-capital train. The state secretary answered that rail choice is up to travellers, that organisers should contact NS early about visitor numbers, that discounts and marketing are commercial matters for NS, and that Leeuwarden and NS should take up the train-promotion ideas themselves.
This is primarily a consideration for NS.
Dit is primair een afweging voor NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht in de Telegraaf “Fyra-debacle dupeert reiziger”

MP Hoogland asked whether travel by Thalys to Brussels is too expensive, how its fares compare with the Fyra, and whether the government will negotiate cheaper Thalys tickets. The Secretary of State explained that Thalys fares follow yield management, noted Fyra fares were somewhat lower in the introductory period, and declined to press for changes because planned extra frequencies will add cheaper tickets.
Given the planned increase in frequencies, more tickets at lower fares will become available. For this reason I see no reason to press for further adjustments.
Gezien de geplande verhoging van het aantal frequenties komen meer kaartjes met lagere tarieven beschikbaar. Hierdoor zie ik geen reden aan te dringen op verdere aanpassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen, De Rouwe en Hoogland inzake het meenemen van de fiets in de Fyra en de Thalys

Three MPs asked why bicycles cannot be carried on the Fyra trains between Rotterdam/Breda and Den Haag/Brussel and on the Thalys, despite suitable space, and how this fits EU rail passenger rules. The state secretary explained that high-speed line safety management excludes loose bicycle transport, that folding or dismantled bikes are allowed as hand luggage, and that adjustments to the safety system are being examined.
For the Intercity to Brussels and the domestic connections on the high-speed line, it is currently being examined whether there is a solution to allow loose bicycle transport.
Voor de Intercity naar Brussel en de binnenlandse verbindingen over de hogesnelheidslijn wordt momenteel onderzocht of er een oplossing is om los vervoer van fietsen mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Jacobi over het bericht voorstellen van Rederij Doeksen om de winterdienstregeling te versoberen en de tarieven te verhogen

MPs Hoogland and Jacobi asked the state secretary about Doeksen's plan to cut winter ferry services and raise fares to Terschelling and Vlieland due to competition from EVT, which sails at dumping prices while the concession is suspended pending a court case. The state secretary said he is consulting the island municipalities on short-term options and will report later this summer, and that the best solution is for the concessions to become final, which depends on the pending appeal.
The concessions becoming final would be the best solution to the problem.
Het onherroepelijk worden van de concessies zou de beste oplossing voor het probleem zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen, Hoogland en De Rouwe over aanleg en beheer van wandel- en fietsroutes

MPs asked about the state of national walking and cycling route networks, their financing after central funding ended, obstruction by waterboards and infrastructure, and planning protection. The government replied that responsibility for these networks now rests with the regions, that it will not intervene, and that it will not add new reporting obligations.
With the signing of the Nature Governance Agreement, care for the national route networks is the responsibility of the regions (mainly provinces, municipalities and recreation boards).
Met de ondertekening van het Bestuursakkoord Natuur is de zorg voor de Landelijke Routenetwerken de verantwoordelijkheid van de regio (met name provincies, gemeenten en recreatieschappen).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Tanamal over het bericht  “fouten bij chloortransport Amersfoort”

MPs Hoogland and Tanamal asked the state secretary about reported errors in a chlorine transport through Amersfoort, including whether deviations from the plan raised risk, the ILT's role, and the Betuweroute. The state secretary said deviations were found but risk can only be concluded after the ongoing criminal investigation, and declined to send a finished investigation because none exists yet.
Whether there was an increased risk can only be concluded on the basis of the criminal investigation, which is still ongoing.
Of er sprake is geweest van een verhoogd risico kan pas worden geconcludeerd op basis van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, De Rouwe, De Boer en Dik-Faber over het geluidsniveau langs de HSL-Zuid

MPs asked when TNO's noise measurements and the pilot along the HSL-Zuid in Lansingerland would be reported and completed, whether the 57 dB(A) limit is exceeded, and about costs, planning, speed reduction and a local residents' plan. The state secretary replied that five of eight measured homes will likely exceed the limit in the end situation by 1 to 6 dB, that the first pilot phase costs about 5.5 million euros with effect measurements planned for autumn, and that speed reduction is undesirable and not legally possible under the Spoorwegwet.

TNO currently concludes that for five of the eight homes (in the municipalities of Hoogmade and Lansingerland) where noise was measured, the calculated noise load in the final situation will be higher than the limit values in the Tracébesluit, namely 57 dB(A).

TNO concludeert op dit moment dat bij vijf van de acht woningen (in de gemeenten Hoogmade en Lansingerland) waar het geluid is gemeten, de berekende geluidbelasting in de eindsituatie hoger zal zijn dan de grenswaarden uit het Tracébesluit, namelijk57 dB(A).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Hamer over ‘het algemeen verbindend verklaren van de cao Railinfra’

MPs Hoogland and Hamer asked whether the Railinfra collective labour agreement should be declared generally binding quickly, whether staff should transfer with concessions, and whether Dutch language skills of rail workers are ensured for safety. The minister replied that the new CAO is for social partners to request, that the government will not intervene in the rail contracting market, and that the Inspectorate found no evidence language problems caused unsafe situations, while noting existing working conditions rules.
However, the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment and I do not wish to intervene in the market of rail contractors.
De Staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ik willen echter niet interveniëren in de markt van spooraannemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Groningen is ontsnapt aan een treinramp met gevaarlijke stoffen

Two Labour MPs asked the state secretary whether a near-accident at Groningen Europapark rail yard in March 2012, where a train carrying dangerous goods was routed onto the wrong track, was serious and what caused it. The state secretary answered that the cause was an incorrect drawing and missing acceptance checks, that ProRail has since added drawing checks and physical tests, and that the Inspectorate continues to monitor, with results expected in autumn 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Mei Li Vos over afspraken tussen spooraannemers over de prijs van onderhoud van het spoor

MPs Hoogland and Mei Li Vos asked whether rail contractors Volker Rail, BAM Rail and Strukton Rail were engaging in unlawful price agreements on track maintenance, whether the competition authority should be consulted, and how the government would respond to a pending court ruling on performance-based maintenance (PGO) tenders and the experience with those contracts. The state secretary replied that there were no concrete indications of cartel behaviour, that the NMa supervises competition and may investigate, that ProRail was vindicated and may proceed with the Eemland award, and that PGO contracts have raised quality and lowered costs according to ProRail, with further inspection research underway.
At this moment I have no concrete indications that this is the case regarding the agreements between rail contractors.
Op dit moment heb ik geen concrete aanwijzingen dat daarvan in het geval van de afspraken tussen spooraannemers sprake is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Achterhoek is spoorproblemen spuugzat»

MPs Hoogland and Otwin van Dijk asked the state secretary about reported rail problems on the Arnhem–Winterswijk line and whether he would talk with the province and municipalities. The state secretary attributed the disruption mainly to new rolling stock and single-track vulnerability rather than train sharing, gave punctuality figures, and said the responsibility for train operations is decentralised and he is willing to discuss infrastructure issues if asked.
The responsibility of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment in principle concerns only the rail infrastructure.
De verantwoordelijkheid van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu betreft in principe alleen de spoorweginfrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat regionale treinen mogelijk duurder worden

An MP asked whether NS plans to make regional rail operators pay more for travel information and whether a dispute over it could be resolved quickly. The state secretary said the cost-sharing history was proportional, that talks are ongoing under the NMa decision, and that she cannot guarantee continuity of travel information but will hold operators to their shared responsibility.
I cannot give you guarantees, but I will certainly hold the operators to their shared interest and responsibility to properly secure travel information for the traveller.
Ik kan u geen garanties geven, maar ik zal vervoerders zeker aanspreken op hun gezamenlijke belang en verantwoordelijkheid om reisinformatie goed te borgen voor de reiziger.

m: Motie van de leden Meulenkamp en Vedder over vaart maken met het verder concretiseren van geborgde en structurele emissiereductie
Asks the government to speed up concretising secured and structural emission reduction, using existing sector documents as a basis and consulting stakeholders.
requests the government to speed up further concretising secured and structural emission reduction
verzoekt de regering vaart te maken met het verder concretiseren van geborgde en structurele emissiereductie
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Meulenkamp ter vervanging van nr. 63 over verhoogde griffiekosten bij bouwzaken
Raises court fees in administrative appeals on housing-related planning decisions to 500 euro for individuals and 1,000 euro for others, making appeals more costly for citizens.
Raising the court fees may mean that people who wrongly lodge objections and appeals must make a fairer contribution to the legal system.
Het verhogen van de griffiekosten kan ervoor zorgen dat mensen die onterecht bezwaar en beroep aantekenen een eerlijkere bijdrage aan het rechtssysteem moeten voldoen.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Meulenkamp ter vervanging van nr. 52 over verhoogde griffiekosten bij bouwzaken

Raises the court filing fee to 1,000 euros for appeals against permits, development projects and zoning plans concerning housing construction, making challenges to housing projects more costly for citizens.
the increase in the court fee is intended to encourage a consideration
de verhoging van het griffierecht is bedoeld om een afweging te stimuleren
Amendement van het lid Wijen-Nass c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 50 over ambtshalve bepalen niet op een tweede zitting te behandelen
Lets the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State decide on its own motion not to hold a second hearing in certain housing permit appeals after a case has already been heard.
the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State may, in appeals against a decision on an environmental permit application for construction activity
kan de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State bij beroepen tegen een beslissing op een aanvraag om een omgevingsvergunning voor een bouwactiviteit
Amendement van het lid Meulenkamp over verhoogde griffiekosten bij bouwzaken

Amendment raising court fees (griffierecht) to 1,000 euro for natural persons and others appealing permits, project decisions and environmental plans in building cases, making appeals more costly for citizens.
