Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handel in apen voor dierexperimenten door RC Hartelust bv (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister for detailed figures on primate imports, origins, transport deaths, housing and inspections at RC Hartelust bv, a Tilburg primate trader for animal experiments, and about why a visit by the Party for the Animals was refused. The minister declined to give company-specific data citing the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur and privacy law, pointed to general CITES and Wod rules, said the 2005 transport deaths were handled by the VWA without criminal enforcement, and stated the company may decide whom it admits.
Under the Government Information (Public Access) Act and the Personal Data Protection Act, I cannot provide specific company information about individual businesses.
In het kader van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en de wet bescherming persoonsgegevens kan ik over individuele bedrijven geen specifieke bedrijfsinformatie verschaffen.
Vragen van het lid Koopmans (CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de edelhertenpilot Meinweggebied (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

An MP asked the minister about the planned red deer reintroduction pilot in the Meinweg area, including the cross-border protest statement, damage compensation, fencing, traffic safety, consultation with North Rhine-Westphalia and landowners. The minister answered that the permit application had been withdrawn, so a substantive response to the arguments was no longer considered appropriate, and that the applicant bears responsibility for public support.
Now that the exemption application has been withdrawn, a response to their arguments no longer seems appropriate to me.
Nu de ontheffingsaanvraag is ingetrokken, lijkt een reactie op hun argumenten mij niet langer opportuun.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de situatie van de opgevangen Orcinus orca (orka) (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the care of a stranded orca, including the rules for rescuing sick marine mammals, the conditions for its release, whether it would be used for research, and how it ended up alone in the Wadden Sea. The minister answered that a Flora- and faunawet exemption covers the Dolfinarium Harderwijk's care protocol, that release will be decided by its scientific leadership, that there are no plans to track it for research, and that the cause of its separation cannot be reconstructed.
There is no research method available to reconstruct how this weakened orca ended up in the Wadden Sea.
Er is geen onderzoeksmethode voorhanden om te reconstrueren hoe deze verzwakte orka in de Waddenzee verzeild is geraakt.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de illegale hondensmokkel uit het Oostblok (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about illegal dog smuggling and trade exposed by a TV documentary, including enforcement effectiveness and whether a trader should lose the right to keep dogs. The minister answered that no conclusions can be drawn from the broadcast, pointed to registration plans and a 2009 enforcement programme with 24 official reports, and declined to give case details because of investigative interests.
in the context of the investigative interest no substantive information can be provided about investigations
in het kader van het opsporingsbelang kan geen inhoudelijke informatie worden verstrekt over onderzoeken
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de gevolgen van nachtelijke recreatie voor wild (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP asks the minister about the effects of night-time recreation on wildlife on the Veluwe, including the number and type of nighttime activities, supervision and norms for disturbance, the role of night-time culling, and whether areas should be closed to night recreation. The minister only sends a procedural notice that answers will follow later because information must be gathered from several managing, licensing and enforcement bodies.
You will receive the answers to the questions as soon as possible.
U zult de antwoorden op de vragen zo spoedig mogelijk ontvangen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het hoge antibioticagebruik in de veehouderij (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

An MP asks the ministers of Agriculture and of Health about high antibiotic use in livestock farming, the resistant Clostridium bacterium, carry-over of medicines into ordinary feed, and whether advertising and a feed ban should be introduced. The answer is only a notice that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because interdepartmental coordination takes extra time.
The reason is that the interdepartmental coordination of the answers requires extra time.
De reden hiervoor is dat de interdepartementale afstemming van de antwoorden extra tijd vergt.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de vervolging van een klokkenluider (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

An SP MP asks the minister whether a whistleblower who leaked a VWA report on slaughterhouse and export-collection-point failings is still being prosecuted, and whether the government should stop the investigation. The minister replies that the person did not follow the official whistleblower procedure, that a criminal complaint led to a Rijksrecherche investigation and a further judicial investigation is ongoing, and that it is not for the minister to influence the prosecutorial decision.
It is not up to me to influence that decision.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg die beslissing te beïnvloeden.

Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitgestelde versoepeling van het maatregelenpakket inzake Q-koorts (ingezo

An MP asked whether the agreed easing of the Q-fever measures would take effect in full once all dairy goat and sheep farms were vaccinated, and why easing for sheep farms was postponed although they appear fully vaccinated. The ministers answered that easing requires full vaccination of all dairy goat and sheep farms and no expert signals to reconsider, and that they will inform parliament in June; they decided to ease only once both sectors are fully vaccinated.

Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Q-koorts en melkschapenbedrijven (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

An MP asked whether the names of goat dairy farms that had not yet vaccinated against Q-fever could be released, and when all dairy goat farms would be vaccinated. The minister refused to release the names, citing the Dutch freedom of information and data protection acts, and estimated that the vaccination campaign on dairy farms would be completed by mid-July, with enforcement orders issued to non-compliant farms.
No, on the basis of the Freedom of Information Act and the Personal Data Protection Act it is not possible to release the names of these dairy goat farms.
Nee, op grond van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens is het niet mogelijk om de namen van deze melkgeitenbedrijven vrij te geven.

Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitgestelde versoepeling van het maatregelenpakket inzake Q-koorts (ingezo

An SGP MP asks whether the promised easing of Q-fever measures will apply in full once dairy goat and sheep farms are vaccinated, whether vaccination on sheep farms was timely and complete, and why the sheep-farm measures were not eased. The minister only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline due to interdepartmental coordination.

The questions posed by MP Van der Vlies (SGP) on the postponed easing of the Q-fever measures cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period due to the necessary interdepartmental coordination.

De door het Kamerlid Van der Vlies (SGP) gestelde vragen over de uitgestelde versoepeling van de Q-koorts maatregelen kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord vanwege de benodigde interdepartementale afstemming.
Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de opvang van 1500 kansarme en zieke dieren (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MP Van Velzen asks the minister about a court-imposed 1 October 2010 deadline for the Stichting Dierenthuis animal shelter, whether to reactivate the Commissie van Goede Diensten, and what the government will do to limit harm to the animals. The minister confirms awareness of the deadline and that the interim relocation to Lelystad is more difficult than expected, but says the outcome of talks between the municipalities of Almere and Laarbeek cannot be anticipated.
I cannot anticipate the outcome of this consultation.
Op de uitkomsten van dit overleg kan ik niet vooruitlopen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de bijzondere omstandigheden van met Q-koorts besmette melkschapenbedrijven met bedreigde landbouwrassen (ingezonden 21 april

An MP asked the minister about the special situation of Q-fever-infected dairy sheep farms with rare breeds, including whether surviving animals could be tested individually and what support and breed-preservation measures would be taken. The minister answered that individual testing cannot give certainty, described existing support schemes, and said the culling does not threaten the Friese/Zeeuwse melkschaap breed.
The number of culled animals and animals under a lifelong breeding ban on these two infected farms do not pose a threat to the survival of the breed.
Het aantal geruimde dieren en dieren met een levenslang fokverbod op deze twee besmette bedrijven vormen geen bedreiging voor het voortbestaan van het ras.
Vragen van het lid Pieper (CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over Amerikaanse brulkikkers (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MP Pieper asks the minister about the American bullfrog, its threat to native species and chytrid fungus, Belgian and Dutch management status, and EU coordination on invasive species. The minister confirms the risks, notes a pending Dutch decision on management, and says the Netherlands favours a more coordinated EU approach.
For the Netherlands, I will decide on the approach to the American bullfrog based on the information in the above risk analysis.
Voor Nederland geldt dat ik een besluit zal nemen over de aanpak van de Amerikaanse brulkikker in Nederland op basis van de informatie in bovengenoemde risicoanalyse

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het gebruik van dieren in amusementsprogramma's (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether using animals in TV entertainment, such as a TROS game show with live eels, is acceptable for public broadcasting, and whether a binding code of conduct on animal welfare should be drawn up. The minister said use of animals is acceptable if welfare is not harmed without reasonable purpose, that this cannot be determined outright for this programme, and that broadcasters' own codes of conduct, which they set themselves, are the appropriate instrument.
It is up to them to determine the form and content of this code of conduct and to decide whether the code regulates the treatment of animals in television programmes.
Het is aan hen om de vorm en de inhoud van deze gedragscode te bepalen en te besluiten om in de gedragscode de omgang met dieren in televisieprogramma's te reguleren.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over misplaatste uitlatingen van ambtenaren (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the agriculture minister whether measures were taken against the authors of a satirical piece mocking an MP, whether the ministry and minister are responsible for it, and how to view a 2006 newspaper report of officials aiming to undermine the party. The minister answers that the officials were confronted, fully accept that the remark was misplaced, measures were taken to prevent recurrence, and the matter is closed for her as ultimately responsible.
With this, the matter is closed for me as the ultimately responsible person.
Hiermee is voor mij als eindverantwoordelijke de zaak afgesloten.
Vragen van het lid Mastwijk (CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de boktor (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the minister whether growers who imported no risk plants from China should bear the costs of the Anoplophora (boktor) controls and destructive sampling as ordinary entrepreneurial risk, and why compensation under Article 4 of the Plant Health Act should not cover them. The minister answers that growers bear this risk as entrepreneurs, that Article 4 only compensates disproportionate damage from Article 3 measures and not imagoschade or trade effects, and that individual requests will be assessed case by case.
I will assess any requests for compensation for disadvantage individually against this background.
Ik zal eventuele verzoeken tot nadeelcompensatie tegen deze achtergrond individueel beoordelen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over bijensterfte en niet aangepaste zaaimachines (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether maize seed is still being sown with unadapted seed drills lacking bee-protection deflectors, whether the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (AID) would enforce this, and whether that is acceptable. The minister confirmed that the deflector requirement applies from 1 July 2010 after a sell-off period set by the Ctgb, that 22 AID preventive checks found no violations, and that a fine can be imposed for future breaches.
The Ctgb has thereby anticipated Commission Directive 2010/21/EU of 12 March 2010.
Het Ctgb heeft daarmee vooruitgelopen op Richtlijn 2010/21/EU van de Commissie van 12 maart 2010
Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over pluimveebedrijven die op slot zitten door besmet biologisch veevoer (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An MP asked the minister how dioxin contamination in Ukrainian organic maize reached poultry farms before detection, what import and Ukrainian inspection procedures apply, the cause of the contamination, where the 2500 tonnes went, and why organic feed is imported from Ukraine. The minister answered that Ukrainian authorities did not test for dioxin, that the Dutch VWA's risk-based sampling missed the batch and a private lab's false-negative result, that the VWA and RIKILT are investigating, that the batch was traced, and that domestic feed production is insufficient.
The VWA, in cooperation with RIKILT, has started an investigation into this.
De VWA is, in samenwerking met het RIKILT, hiernaar een onderzoek gestart.

Vragen van het lid Ormel (CDA) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de bestrijding van de eikenprocessierups (ingezonden 12 mei 2010).

MP Ormel (CDA) asks the ministers of Agriculture and of Health whether the oak processionary caterpillar has spread since 2004, what the government has done to contain it, and whether it poses a public health risk requiring a national coordinated control programme. The government reply is a holding notice only: the questions cannot be answered within the usual period because of interdepartmental coordination.
cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period because of the necessary interdepartmental coordination
kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord vanwege de noodzakelijke interdepartementale afstemming
Vragen van het lid Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over een uitbraak van mond- en klauwzeer in Oost-Azië (ingezonden 12 mei 2010).

Ormel (CDA) asked the minister for an overview of the foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in East Asia, whether Chinese authorities concealed outbreaks from the OIE, the import of fresh pork from China, and what measures address FAO's call for heightened vigilance. The minister listed reported cases in China, Japan and South Korea, said the rumours of concealment could not be confirmed as the ministry has no insight into China's reporting, noted fresh pork imports from China are prohibited, and described increased passenger checks on flights from Japan and South Korea plus a requested risk analysis.
I have no insight into what China does or does not report to the OIE.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hetgeen China al dan niet meldt aan de OIE.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de voorgenomen teelt

MP Ouwehand asks ministers whether BASF's planned cultivation of the genetically modified Amflora potato as seed potato should be opposed, given contamination risks to conventional and organic seed potato chains, antibiotic resistance gene concerns and export and reputational effects. The minister answers that the EU authorisation and mandatory cultivation and marketing measures, co-existence agreements and low outcrossing risk make negative effects unlikely, that a ban is not justified, and that the government is working at EU level to give member states power to regulate GMO cultivation nationally.
No, the Netherlands voted in favour of authorising the cultivation of the Amflora potato in the EU at the Agriculture Council in July 2007.
Nee, Nederland heeft in de Landbouwraad van juli 2007 voor toelating gestemd van de teelt van de Amflora-aardappel in de EU.

Vragen van het lid Polderman (SP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over toelating van het genetisch gemodificeerde organisme (ggo) Am

An MP asks ministers whether approval of the GM potato Amflora conflicts with Dutch GM policy, whether the Netherlands should oppose it, and whether tolerating 0.9% technical contamination in food is safe. The minister answers that the policy was revised after a Council of State ruling, the risks were assessed as acceptable by EFSA and national authorities, and no opposition or cultivation ban is planned.
Since then the policy has meant that the presence of an antibiotic resistance gene does not automatically mean a GMO cannot be authorised, but each application is assessed case by case for risks.
Het beleid houdt sindsdien in dat de aanwezigheid van een antibioticumresistentiegen niet op voorhand betekent dat het ggo niet kan worden toegelaten
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over vluchtgedrag als gevolg van jachtdruk (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether wild boar moving into built-up areas reflect the effectiveness of culling policy, and how the minister assesses scientific publications linking hunting pressure to flight behaviour and disrupted social structure, and whether earlier answers contradict them. The minister says the policy aims at a target population, that fencing is needed to keep boar out of towns, that assessing the publications is not for the minister, and refers to earlier reports and letters.
It is not for me to assess scientific publications.
Het is niet aan mij om wetenschappelijke publicaties te beoordelen.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat Nederland opnieuw is gestegen op de lijst van landen waar m

An MP asked the agriculture and interior ministers whether the Netherlands rising on a list of countries with widely reported animal suffering is shameful, whether the rise reflects awareness or incidence, and whether the government will act in the Caribbean and home territories. The minister says the underlying method provides too little information to judge the ranking or its cause, points to growing public awareness, and says the Netherlands Antilles are autonomous on animal welfare, so Dutch animal welfare law does not apply there.
However, there is insufficient information to make valid statements about this top ten.
Het ontbreekt echter aan voldoende informatie om valide uitspraken te doen over deze top tien.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Atsma (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de medewerking van Staatsbosbeheer aan de realisatie van een fietspad over de Gouden Bodem (ingezonden 27

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Staatsbosbeheer refuses to cooperate on a walking and cycling route over the Gouden Bodem, a Natura 2000 island, and whether it should reconsider with local initiators. The minister confirmed awareness, described the area's protected bird values and rest needs, and said she will await the regional development rather than commit to new talks.
I want to wait for this development.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over bijensterfte en niet aangepaste zaaimachines (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether maize seed drilling machines without bee-protecting deflectors are still in use, whether the AID inspectorate will refrain from checking them, and whether measures will be taken. The minister only announced that the answers would be delayed because coordination with the AID and the Ctgb takes extra time.
The questions from MP Thieme on bee mortality and unadapted seed drilling machines cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het lid Thieme inzake bijensterfte en niet aangepaste zaaimachines, kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over onderzoeken in het kader van de voortgaande bijenvolksterfte (

An MP (Thieme, PvdD) asks ministers about the Alterra report on public green space for bees, its drachtplant lists, the planned three-year research into bee decline including pesticides, and whether that research is adequate. The minister defends the report as a first step, says the lists are a preliminary aim for a more practical list, and says the research will examine causes including pesticides.

The report was not intended to state what green and land managers can do to improve bee stocks, but to examine the extent to which municipalities take the significance of public green for bee forage into account in their green management and policy.

Het rapport had niet tot doel aan te geven wat groen- en terreinbeheerders kunnen doen om de bijenstand te verbeteren, maar om te onderzoeken in hoeverre gemeenten bij hun groenbeheer en -beleid rekening houden met de betekenis van openbaar groen voor de dracht van bijen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de hoge aantallen edelherten op de Veluwe (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Ms Thieme (PvdD) asked the minister whether the Veluwe red deer population of over 1660 exceeds the target, on what ecological grounds the target was set, and whether pre-emptive culling and vehicle traffic were properly weighed. The minister replied that the target is based on long experience, that the required culls were missed by the Wildbeheereenheid Veluwe, that the Veluwe uses a social-support model while the Oostvaardersplassen use an ecological one, and that traffic and population counts are outside the ministry's remit.
Collecting data on the number of cars passing on the Veluwe motorways and on the number of residents in the various Veluwe regions does not fall within the remit of my ministry.

Het verzamelen van gegevens over het aantal auto's dat over snelwegen op de Veluwe passeert en over het aantal inwoners in verschillende regio's van de Veluwe, behoort niet tot de taak van mijn ministerie.
Vragen van de leden Jager en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over te rigoureuze toepassing Natura 2000 (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

MPs Jager and Koppejan (CDA) asked the minister whether the implementation of Natura 2000 is too rigorous, citing press criticism of overly technical ecological precision and its effect on public support. The minister acknowledged the complexity and public-support concern, said the detailed rules stem from EU law, and pointed to flexibility already sought through the Crisis- en herstelwet and management plans, without committing to new structural changes.
I share the concern in the article. The implementation of Natura 2000 is complex, which does not contribute to public support for nature.
Ik deel de zorg in het artikel. De implementatie van Natura 2000 is complex, hetgeen niet bijdraagt aan het draagvlak voor natuur.
Vragen van het lid Polderman (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de proef «bovengronds aanwenden mest» (ingezonden 12 maart 2010).

The MP Polderman asked why the Staatscourant publication of the surface manure application trial came only on 5 March, delaying the start of the trial, and whether the trial should be extended by a year. The minister replied that the advice from the Technical Commission Bodem arrived only in mid-February, that she does not consider a one-year extension necessary, but will extend the trial so that two full fertilisation periods fall within it, counted from the date the exemption is granted.

Vragen van het lid Cramer (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over vergoeding van schade door Aardappelspindelknolviroïde (PSTVd) in kuipplanten (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

An MP asks the agriculture minister whether growers damaged by the PSTVd viroid in pot plants, some of whom stopped litigation on ministry advice in 2007, should get compensation, since the Board found the damage was not fully a normal business risk. The minister says the ministry gave no advice to stop, grants compensation in the four cases the Board ruled on and some later cases, but will not reopen decisions from growers who did not appeal.
It was the choice of the pot plant growers themselves whether or not to start an appeal procedure.
Het is een keuze van de kuipplantentelers zelf geweest om al dan niet een beroepsprocedure te starten.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat Nederland opnieuw is gestegen op de lijst van landen waar m

An MP asks ministers about a report that the Netherlands rose on a list of countries with large-scale reports of animal suffering, and whether this reflects greater reporting or higher incidence, and what the government will do. The item is a notice that the answers will be delayed because interdepartmental coordination takes extra time.
The reason for the delay is that the interdepartmental coordination of the answers requires extra time.
De reden van uitstel is dat de interdepartementale afstemming van de antwoorden extra tijd vergt.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het importeren van reuzenpanda’s uit China (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asked the minister about plans by Dierenpark Emmen to import giant pandas from China, the welfare trade-off, the applicable rules and supervision, international breeding agreements, and the loan arrangements with China. The minister answered that the plans are still exploratory, that the conditions and any loan agreement are not yet known, and that the import is governed by CITES, EU transport and veterinary rules enforced by the AID, NVWA and Customs.
The conditions on the Chinese side are not yet known, but it is clear that they will be high.
De voorwaarden van Chinese zijde zijn nog niet bekend, maar wel is duidelijk dat deze hoog zullen zijn.

Vragen van de leden Polderman, Jansen en Van Velzen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over betrokkenheid bij illegale ontbo

Three SP MPs asked ministers whether Dutch firms Unilever and Neste Oil use palm oil from IOI, linked to illegal deforestation in West Kalimantan, and what the government would do about sustainability criteria, biofuel mandates and EU classification of plantations. The minister answered that the government does not track palm oil suppliers, that Unilever stopped using West Kalimantan palm oil, that biofuel sustainability criteria apply from 2011 while non-fuel palm oil has no such rules, and that the government supports the voluntary RSPO process without intervening directly.
The government does not keep data on who the suppliers of these companies are.
De overheid houdt geen gegevens bij met betrekking tot wie toeleveranciers van genoemde bedrijven zijn.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over bijenvolksterfte door onduurzame maïsteelt (ingezonden 9 maart

An MP asks the Ministers of Agriculture and Housing/Environment whether neonicotinoid-treated maize seed causing bee colony losses is being addressed sustainably, and whether a moratorium is warranted. The government answers that deflectors and seed-dust limits reduce drift, denies that a moratorium is needed, and says the bee-decline research results will come in 2011.
No, pollen and nectar have not been analysed in the Netherlands for imidacloprid content.
Nee, stuifmeel en nectar zijn in Nederland niet geanalyseerd op het gehalte aan imidacloprid.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het stoppen van de afschot van ganzen in weidevogelgebieden (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

The MP asks whether afschot of geese in meadow-bird areas during breeding season is undesirable, whether the government will add rules, whether manure policy should be tightened to help meadow birds and reduce goose problems, and how successful meadow-bird policy has been. The minister replies that permits are a provincial matter, that no direct link between manure and geese is shown though manure does affect meadow birds, that the subsidy scheme is being adjusted with longer resting periods, and that the policy is on the right track despite recent declines.
Issuing such a permit is a matter for the provinces, so it is for them to decide on it.
Het afgeven van een dergelijke ontheffing is een aangelegenheid van de provincies, het is dan ook aan hen hierover te beslissen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over dierexperimenten voor

Ouwehand (PvdD) asks ministers how a government-funded programme to reduce methane from cattle rumen through feed works, whether animal experiments such as rumen fistula cows comply with the Animal Experiments Act, and how it relates to a feed company's study. The minister answers that the EUR 6 million programme (co-funded 5 million by industry, 2010–2014) needs animal trials for fundamental rumen research, that no ethics committee application exists yet, that the Animal Experiments Act permits such work for food/health purposes, and that fistula cows are not excluded.
Therefore it cannot be stated which methods will be applied and how many animals will be involved.
Daarom is niet aan te geven welke methoden worden toegepast en hoeveel dieren er betrokken zijn.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over in beslag genomen honden (ingezonden 29 januari 2010).

An MP asked the agriculture minister about the status, validation and cost of the aggression test used on seized dogs, the euthanasia of dogs that cannot be tested, owner involvement, shelter protocols and welfare controls. The minister answered that the test is a risk assessment by recognised experts that is only partly validated, that euthanasia advice is rarely given without a full test, that owners need not be present, and that shelter standards are set by contract with inspection by the Algemene Inspectiedienst and Dienst Regelingen.
Inspection data from the Algemene Inspectiedienst and Dienst Regelingen on shelter operators and locations are not actively made public.
Controlegegevens van de Algemene Inspectiedienst en Dienst Regelingen over opslaghouders en locaties, worden niet actief openbaar gemaakt.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Justitie over de handhaving van het verbod op het couperen van honden (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP asks the Agriculture and Justice ministers how the Dutch ban on cropping dogs' ears and tails is enforced, including imports of cropped dogs from abroad, whether possession should be made punishable, and how the motion on dog trade is being implemented. The minister acknowledges cropped dogs exist, explains that possession and sale of legally cropped foreign dogs are not punishable under EU law, and gives enforcement figures (about 12 reports per year, sanctions in about half of prosecuted cases) while committing to no new action.
It is not prohibited in the Netherlands to sell, offer, buy or exhibit a dog that was lawfully cropped abroad.
Het is in Nederland niet verboden om een in het buitenland rechtmatig gecoupeerde hond te verkopen, aan te bieden, te kopen of tentoon te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de directeur Communicatie die na het verschijnen van de glossy Gerda van baan verandert (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether she approved the publication of a glossy magazine and why responsibility was now shifted to the communications director, and whether she was warned of parliamentary criticism. The minister answered that she is personally responsible for the magazine and that she knew its design and had voluntarily participated in the photo shoots.
I myself am responsible for publishing the magazine.
Ik ben zelf verantwoordelijk voor het uitbrengen van het magazine.

Vragen van het lid Van Velzen (SP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de directeur voorlichting die na het verschijnen van de glossy Gerda van baan wisselt (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

MP Van Velzen asks whether the ministry's communications director is leaving after the controversial 'Gerda' magazine, and whether this is linked to the House's condemnation and a motion of censure while the minister stays in office. The minister confirms the director's move and says there is a link to the magazine events, pointing to her earlier letter and the debate for the consequences she has drawn.
There is a link with the events surrounding the magazine.
Er is een relatie met de gebeurtenissen rond het magazine.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de jaarlijkse slachting van dolfijnen op de Faröer Eilanden (ingezonden 30 maart 2010).

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of the annual pilot whale (grind) slaughter on the Faroe Islands, how they judged it, and whether they would raise it with Denmark and internationally. The minister said she rejects the ritual, but the government has limited means since the Faroes are a Danish overseas territory outside ASCOBANS, and she will raise it with her Danish colleague at the next Agriculture Council.
At the upcoming Agriculture Council I will again raise this point with my Danish colleague.
Tijdens de komende Landbouwraad zal ik wederom mijn Deense collega op dit punt aanspreken.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over 25 verwaarloosde Shetlandpony's (ingezonden 19 maart 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the neglect of 25 Shetland ponies, including whether the owner was warned earlier, how the dead animals were missed despite supervision, and whether Staatsbosbeheer and the inspection services acted. The minister answers that 13 carcasses were found, that the owner had prior reports handled in 2008 and 2009, that Staatsbosbeheer is not the owner of the animals, and that the AID made agreements with the owner with a re-inspection planned.
There was no supervision by the LID in this case.
Van toezicht van de LID was in dit geval geen sprake.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de mishandeling van een hond met de dood tot gevolg (ingezonden 8 maart 2010).

The MP asks the minister of Agriculture about the starvation death of a dog, the outcome of the inspectorate's investigation, the possible charges and penalties, and whether a standalone keeping ban should be introduced. The minister confirms a proces-verbaal was drawn up for prosecution, explains the available penalties, prefers a keeping ban as a special condition over a standalone ban, and states that the court data on imposed bans cannot be retrieved.
It is not possible to make this data available from the OM's business process system because special conditions attached to a sentence are not registered separately as such.
Het is niet mogelijk deze gegevens inzichtelijk te maken met het bedrijfsprocessensysteem van het OM omdat de bijzondere voorwaarden bij een straf niet als zodanig uitgesplitst worden geregistreerd.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het illegaal vissen van Europa in West-Afrika (ingezonden 5 maart 2010).

MP Ouwehand asks ministers whether European fishing vessels fish illegally off Western Sahara, how much Dutch fishing is involved, and whether fishing-partnership revenues reach the local population and what standards and oversight apply. The minister answers that fishing there is not per se illegal, that only one Dutch vessel fished under the agreement for about six weeks, that the Commission monitors benefits to locals, and that 25% of catch is sold locally while 75% goes to other markets.
The European Parliament is currently consulting with the European Commission on the economic involvement of the original population in this fishing. I am following this discussion closely.
Het Europees Parlement overlegt momenteel met de Europese Commissie over de economische betrokkenheid van de oorspronkelijke bevolking bij deze visserij. Ik volg deze discussie op de voet.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een dierenasiel met een belangrijke regiofunctie dat d

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture and the State Secretary of Interior about a rabbit shelter in Oldenzaal that faces closure over building-permit and zoning violations, and about national responsibility for stray-pet intake. The minister replies that the municipality is responsible and that shelter siting must comply with law, declines to assess the shelter's counterfactual impact, and points to municipal autonomy and ongoing VNG consultation.
Judging the municipality's conduct is for the municipal council, and for the concrete decisions and enforcement actions of the municipality, for the courts.
Het oordelen over het optreden van de gemeente is aan de gemeenteraad, en voor wat betreft de concrete besluiten van en het handhavend optreden door de gemeente, aan de rechter.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over hyperflexie en andere trainingsmethoden bij paarden (ingezonden 24 februari 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked the minister about the FEI's ban on hyperflexion (rollkur) in horse training, the status of research on horse welfare and training methods, the precautionary principle, enforcement, and the sector action agenda. The minister welcomed the FEI decision as the sport taking responsibility, said the welfare research is inconclusive, declined a statutory ban and the precautionary principle, and left enforcement and disciplinary rules to the sports bodies.
I have informed the Dierenbescherming that I will not ban this training method.
Ik heb de Dierenbescherming laten weten dat ik deze trainingsmethode niet zal verbieden.
Vragen van het lid Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over vleermuizen (ingezonden 22 maart 2010).

An MP asks whether demolition of vacant houses in Hengelo was blocked by the minister's refusal of an exemption over possible bats, despite no bats found, and whether EU rules require summer surveys and whether winter-sleeping bats halt demolition across the country. The minister answers that no survey has yet been done so no decision could be taken, that bat roosts are protected year-round, and that bat protection under the Flora- and faunawet generally does not delay projects where surveys are part of planning.
In this case no research on bats has yet been carried out, while the planning area may well be suitable habitat for bats.
Er is in dit geval nog geen onderzoek naar vleermuizen uitgevoerd, terwijl het plangebied mogelijk wel geschikt leefgebied voor vleermuizen vormt.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over naleving van het coupeerverbod door de paardensector en dierenwelzijn op hengstenkeuringen (ingezonden 24 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister why tail-docked stallions can win prizes at Dutch horse inspections despite the tail-docking ban, how the sector's stated opposition to docking is reflected in practice, and how horse welfare around stallion inspections is checked and whether minimum age rules apply. The minister answers that legally docked foreign horses may compete in Dutch events because a ban would not be legally tenable, that the sector's private rules and organisations handle welfare and age checks, and that the state sees this as largely not its task, acting only in cases of excess.
I do not consider this a government task.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over een inval bij een varkenshouderij in verband met het overtreden van milieuvoorschriften (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister about a raid on a pig farm in Lierop suspected of breaking environmental rules, including manure processing, and about possible animal welfare violations and prior offences. The minister confirmed the raid, said criminal and administrative investigations are ongoing and declined to specify the suspicions, and noted past violations and future monitoring by supervisory authorities.
During these investigations I cannot go into what exactly the persons involved are suspected of.
Gedurende deze onderzoeken kan ik niet ingaan op hetgeen waarvan betrokkenen precies worden verdacht.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de registratie van fok en handel in gezelschapsdieren in Nederland (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

Opposition MP Ouwehand asked the minister how many dog and cat breeders are registered, how many animals they breed and trade, and whether the RDA's call to map missing pet data should be followed. The minister said breeder registration now sits with the Gezondheidsdienst voor Dieren, that exact animal numbers would require a costly mandatory registration of all pet keepers which she declines to impose, and that she will not update the 2006 RDA report.
An overview of the number of animals bred and traded annually by breeders and traders of dogs and cats is not available.
Een overzicht van het aantal dieren dat jaarlijks door fokkers en handelaars van honden en katten gefokt en verhandeld wordt, is niet beschikbaar.

Vragen van de leden Polderman en Van Velzen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over arbeidsomstandigheden en reorganisatie bij de Voedsel en Ware

MPs Polderman and Van Velzen asked about reported poor working conditions at the VWA food safety laboratory in Wageningen (no heating, no toilets, wet floors, noise, smoking, missing protective gear), a possible Arbeidsinspectie inspection, the dismissal of a temporary worker seen as a whistleblower, and whether the reorganisation harms quality. The minister denied the picture was accurate, said the Arbeidsinspectie found no violations, and said the reorganisation was unrelated to the laboratory situation.
At no point were there harsh working conditions, so the VWA's work was not harmed either.
Er is op geen enkel moment sprake geweest van barre werkomstandigheden, dus het werk van de VWA is ook niet geschaad.
Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de Nederlandse interpretatie en implementatie van de Habitatrichtlijn (ingezonden 5 maart 2010).

MP Van der Vlies asks the agriculture minister how the Dutch Natura 2000 law (Natuurbeschermingswet articles 19a-19f) relates to the Habitats Directive on protecting habitats and species, including how species and habitat targets were set, prioritisation, and public access to data. Minister Verburg answers in detail, defending the national approach as consistent with EU law, explaining the 2004 reference point and the blauwgrasland targets, and promising to revisit the wording in a future integrated nature law.

It is reasonable, since the questioning shows there may be uncertainty about this, to again explicitly examine, in the forthcoming bill integrating nature legislation that will incorporate the Natuurbeschermingswet 1998, whether a provision requiring weighing of the interests present can nonetheless be included.

Het ligt echter in de rede, nu hieromtrent blijkens de vraagstelling onduidelijkheid kan bestaan, bij het op te stellen wetsvoorstel tot integratie van de natuurwetgeving, waarin de Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 zal worden opgenomen, nog eens nadrukkelijk te bezien of toch een bepaling dat een afweging van de aanwezige belangen moet plaatsvinden, kan worden opgenomen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het niet dalen van het aantal damherten ondanks de toegestane jacht (ingezonden 30 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister why deer numbers on Kop van Schouwen have not fallen despite permitted hunting, whether predation or space and food regulate the population, and whether counts should be done by non-interested certified counters. The minister answered that the province aims to stabilise rather than reduce the herd at 325 deer, that Alterra is still analysing the count data, and that the province and faunabeheereenheid decide on management.
It is for the Provincial Executive and the Wildlife Management Unit to make choices about the implementation of wildlife management.
Het is aan Gedeputeerde Staten en de Faunabeheereenheid om keuzes te maken over de uitvoering van het faunabeheer.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Financiën over de aantasting van biodiversiteit door de akke

An MP asked ministers about a study linking agricultural pesticide use to declining wild plant biodiversity, the government's biodiversity targets, and EU costs of species loss. The minister acknowledged the study, backed integrated pest management and a national action plan due in 2012, but saw no special national consequences and declined to specify ecosystem-service losses in the budget.
I regard the study as support for the effort to achieve integrated crop protection, giving priority where possible to non-chemical methods.
Ik beschouw het onderzoek als een ondersteuning van de inzet om te komen tot een geïntegreerde gewasbescherming waarbij waar mogelijk voorrang wordt gegeven aan niet-chemische methoden.

Vragen van de leden Mastwijk en Atsma (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het bericht dat Staatsbosbeheer sinds 2006 taxateurs opdracht geeft om erfpachtkavels ver boven de werkelij

CDA MPs asked the minister whether Staatsbosbeheer instructs appraisers to value long-lease plots above market value and ignore lease restrictions, and about canon and inflation calculation. The minister confirmed the practice is legally permitted in private leases, said the appraisal instructions are public, and that the government asked Staatsbosbeheer to implement expert advice on a 75% base value, a revised canon formula and an objective, transparent method.
I have asked Staatsbosbeheer to implement this advice on lease policy as soon as possible.
Ik heb Staatsbosbeheer gevraagd dit advies over het erfpachtbeleid op zo kort mogelijke termijn te implementeren.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over een in beslag genomen vos (ingezonden 9 februari 2010).

MP Thieme asks the minister about a fox seized in January 2010 after a raid in Westervoort, whether it was placed with an unauthorised shelter, what will happen to it, and how often wild animals are seized. The minister confirms the seizure, says the fox was placed with a licensed custodian, withholds its location citing agreements with contract holders, declines to say what will happen pending the criminal investigation, and says no further measures are needed.
Due to the agreements made with IBG contract holders, it is not possible to publicly state where the fox is currently located.
In verband met de afspraken die gemaakt zijn met contracthouders van IBG, is het niet mogelijk in het openbaar aan te geven waar de vos zich nu bevindt.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over een toename in het aantal vossen ondanks het toestaan van jacht (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister whether culling foxes increases their numbers, since survival and litter size may rise, and whether further research on predation of meadow birds is planned. The minister answers that populations stay stable once territories are full, that culling can still help protect meadow bird areas before breeding season, and that predation research by Landschapsbeheer Nederland and SOVON continues.
When all territories are full, the population no longer increases.
Als alle territoria vol zijn, neemt de stand niet meer toe.

Vragen van de leden Ormel, Pieper en Schreijer-Pierik (allen CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over een banner met de tekst «Wolven in Nederland» op de website van het ministerie (ingezonden 2

The CDA MPs asked the minister why a banner promoting 'Wolves in the Netherlands' appeared on the ministry website, whether it will be replaced, how far wolves have spread, whether rabies and Habitats Directive protection apply, and whether the wolf is an invasive species. The minister answered that the banner ran one week to respond to public questions, was removed, that no specific wolf policy exists, that only one incidental wolf has been sighted about 100 km from the border, and that a wolf arriving naturally would be a protected native species under the Habitats Directive.
The banner was removed on 24 March.
De banner is verwijderd op 24 maart.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het toestaan van het uitzetten van edelherten in het Meinweggebied (ingezonden 17 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether Staatsbosbeheer applied for a permit to release red deer in the Meinweg, how the application is assessed, whether population management and a German-side objection were considered, and whether a fauna management plan exists. The minister confirmed the application, said it is based on a report to be considered, that population management is not currently needed but may be later, that the permit will be assessed under the reintroduction policy with local support including German border support weighed, and that a chapter on red deer will be added to the management plan if granted.
I rule out that red deer will be released in the Meinweg area as long as no habitat has been established on the German side of the border.
Ik sluit uit dat er in het Meinweggebied edelherten worden uitgezet zo lang aan de Duitse kant van de grens geen leefgebied is gerealiseerd.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het bericht dat Nederland 18,4 miljoen aan Brussel moet terugbetalen vanwege fouten in de controle en registratie (ingezonden

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that the Netherlands must repay EUR 18.2 million to Brussels over control and registration failures, including insufficient substitution checks on export restitutions in 2003-2004 and inadequate controls on slaughter premiums for cattle. The minister confirmed the amounts, explained the control shortcomings and the changes made since, and said future corrections are unavoidable given the complexity of CAP payments.
The shortcoming is attributable to the incorrect application of EU rules on the minimum number of substitution checks to be carried out in 2003 and 2004.
De tekortkoming is terug te voeren op het niet correct toepassen van de EU-regelgeving over het minimum aantal uit te voeren substitutiecontroles in de jaren 2003 en 2004.
Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over Gemeenschappelijk Visserijbeleid in niet Europese wateren (ingezonden 15 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister about EU fisheries partnership agreements with non-EU countries, including payments to countries such as Mauritania and whether they hinder developing countries' self-reliance. The government answers by pointing to the Commission's published overview, arguing the agreements are not a fix for EU overcapacity, admitting mixed effects on developing countries, and committing to a review of the agreements' structure.
The Netherlands agrees with the Commission that the current structure of the EU agreements should be reviewed.
Nederland is het eens met de Commissie dat de huidige structuur van de EU-overeenkomsten tegen het licht moet worden gehouden.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de bestrijding van Q-koorts, en de kosten en proportionaliteit daarvan (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the cost of culling goats during the Q fever outbreak, the lack of data on health-care and labour costs, how many residents received letters about nearby infected farms, and whether the goat sector should be restructured. The minister gives cost estimates of about 23 million euro for compensation and 11 million for implementation, says economic losses from sick workers were not studied, and says the measures already in place are sufficient.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de zandhaai en de identificatie van aangespoelde haaien (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked the minister about a sandtiger shark listing in an encyclopedia, why two stranded sharks were not identified to species, and whether discarded sharks are normal bycatch. The minister defended reliance on expert identification, said she did not know why the sharks were not identified to species, and described a discards sampling programme begun in 2009.
I do not know why it was not identified at species level.
Ik weet niet waarom niet op soortniveau geïdentificeerd is.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over CO2-uitstoot als gevolg van walvisjacht en visserij (ingezon

MP Ouwehand asks the ministers whether whaling and commercial fishing release CO2 that worsens climate change, and whether that is counted in national emissions. The government answers that carbon in dead whales ends up in the atmosphere anyway, that fishing emissions from vessels (about 0.9 Mton CO2-eq) are reported, and that the carbon effect of removing marine life is not quantifiable and is excluded from the agreed inventory methodology.
The contribution to climate change from removing organisms from the marine environment cannot be quantified.
De bijdrage aan klimaatverandering door het onttrekken van organismen aan het mariene milieu is niet te kwantificeren.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over de vernietiging van de Raad van State van reconstructieplann

An MP asked ministers whether the Council of State's partial annulment of Brabant reconstruction plans shows the approval of those plans was careless, and whether the reconstruction policy should be revised or its funds redirected. The ministers answered that the ruling has limited consequences, that approval was given in line with national policy, that provincial plan-making is the province's responsibility, and that they will not redirect the funds.
Drafting reconstruction plans is a responsibility of the province.
Het opstellen van reconstructieplannen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie.

Vragen van het lid Polderman (SP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Berenschotrapport met betrekking tot antibioticagebruik door veeartsen (ingezo

MP Polderman asked the ministers whether a withdrawn press release claiming that 5% of veterinary practices account for 80% of antibiotic use in livestock is correct, and whether the Berenschot report would be sent to parliament quickly. Minister Verburg confirmed the report's finding, said she will explore with the KNMvD a targeted approach to these practices, and stated the report was sent to the Tweede Kamer on 8 March.
I sent the report to the House of Representatives on 8 March.
Ik heb het rapport op 8 maart jl. aan de Tweede Kamer toegezonden
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het aanpassen van uiers voor melkrobots (ingezonden 11 februari 2010).

PvdD MP Thieme asked the minister of Agriculture whether vets adjusting cows' teats for milking robots violates the Ingrepenbesluit and whether the AID acted and whether this crosses animal-welfare limits. The minister confirmed the procedure is not permitted without veterinary necessity, that the AID investigated and issued official written warnings to a vet practice and three farmers, and that enforcement communication will follow.
The concerned veterinary practice and the three livestock farmers were given an official written warning.
Aan de betrokken dierenartsenpraktijk en de 3 veehouders is een officiële schriftelijke waarschuwing gegeven.
Vragen van het lid Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over vroege aardappelteelt (ingezonden 25 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister about the July 15 restriction on Reglone use in early potato cultivation on Tholen, whether no other European country has it, and whether it threatens the sector and 150 growers. The minister confirms the restriction in the usage instructions, says Reglone is permitted elsewhere in Europe without such a date, and states that the Ctgb will decide on any change in April.
The Ctgb is currently assessing a study by the Reglone license holder on the effects of the product on breeding birds.

Momenteel wordt door het College voor toelating van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden (Ctgb) een studie van de toelatinghouder van Reglone beoordeeld naar de effecten van het middel op broedende vogels.
Vragen van de leden Irrgang en Polderman (beiden SP) aan de minister voor Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over visserijrechten (ingezonden 4 februari 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the development minister about EU fisheries partnership agreements, including payments to Mauritania, whether they are a form of development aid, and what happens to unspent EU development funds. The minister answered that the payments partly fund sustainable fisheries policy and partly are licence fees paid directly by EU vessel owners, that the agreements have not yet sufficiently supported local fisheries, that these payments are not ODA-funded, and that unspent EDF funds roll over to later periods rather than being diverted.
In addition, the partnership agreements must support and strengthen the structural development of local fisheries sectors in the countries concerned.
Daarnaast moeten de partnerschapsovereenkomsten de structurele ontwikkeling van de locale visserijsectoren in betrokken landen ondersteunen en versterken.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het houden van grote vogels als oehoes (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP asked the minister about keeping large birds such as eagle owls, their welfare and flight needs, whether a zoo's claim that an escaped owl could survive was sound, and the lack of data on bird shows and private keepers. The minister answered that keepers must ensure welfare and flight opportunities, that the owl had returned, and that no registration of shows or private keepers exists, while citing existing rules as adequate.
The annual number of bird shows is not known, because this is not registered.
Antwoord 7 en 9 Het jaarlijkse aantal vogelshows is niet bekend, want dit wordt niet geregis treerd.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de deelname van de minister aan de opening van het kreeftenseizoen (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether attending the opening of the lobster season was appropriate given welfare concerns, whether lobster licences were excessive, and whether crustaceans should be covered by animal welfare policy. The minister declined to attend, said current fishing pressure is possibly too high and fewer licences are being discussed with the sector, and held that scientific evidence on crustacean pain is not yet conclusive so no change to welfare priorities is planned.
In light of this, the possibilities for reducing the number of licences are currently being examined in consultation with the sector.
Gelet hierop wordt thans in afstemming met de sector bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om alsnog te komen tot een vermindering van het aantal vergunningen.
Vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand (beiden PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over 50 rondvliegende zebravinken in een café (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the minister whether 50 zebra finches that died after being released in a Breda café during carnival amounted to animal abuse, whether the owner could be prosecuted without proven intent, and how such birds are traded and given as gifts. The minister called the act unacceptable, said the Animal Welfare Inspectorate filed a report and prosecution is for the public prosecutor and courts, and described an information centre set up to prevent impulse purchases of pets.
In this case, an official report was drawn up by the National Animal Welfare Inspectorate (LID).
In het onderhavige geval is proces-verbaal opgemaakt door de Landelijke Inspectiedienst Dierenbescherming (LID).
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het opzetten van palingkwekerijen in Afrika (ingezonden 5 maart 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked the minister whether the government's research institute IMARES helps a private company set up eel farming in Madagascar, and how sustainability and animal welfare are ensured given concerns about declining eel stocks. The minister replied that IMARES is funded entirely by the foreign company, that LNV does not support it, that the contract contains sustainability terms LNV has not seen, and that the minister lacks details of the farming process.
LNV has not had access to the contract.
LNV heeft geen inzage gehad in het contract.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de gevolgen van een eventueel vervoersverbod (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about whether pig farms have enough emergency housing space to hold animals during a transport ban after an animal disease outbreak, and whether this forces healthy animals to be culled. The minister answered that emergency housing is not legally required, that it is the sector's own responsibility under a general duty of care, and that the government will promote awareness through a farmers' network but will not impose rules.
There is no legal obligation for pig farms to have emergency housing.
Er is geen wettelijke verplichting voor varkensbedrijven om een noodopvang te hebben.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het beschikbaar maken van de bijsluiter bij diergeneesmiddelen (ingezonden 3 maart 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether veterinarians should be required to give animal owners the package leaflet for medicines they administer, and about online information and vet error rates. The minister said vets are trained to weigh risks themselves, the leaflet usually comes after administration, owners may request it, and no data on vet errors are known; no regulatory change is planned.
No, I am not aware of how often in the last five years veterinarians have made errors when administering medication.
Nee, mij is niet bekend hoe vaak het in de laatste vijf jaar is voorgekomen dat dierenartsen fouten hebben gemaakt bij het toedienen van medicatie.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Jager (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over verschillende beoordeling van buitendijks gerealiseerde natuur ten opzichte van ontpolderingsnatuur (ingezo

Two CDA MPs asked the minister why a weighting factor limits the ecological value counted for the Waterdunen nature project in the Westerschelde, and why estuarine nature is weighted differently from polder-restoration nature. The minister answered only that the Zeeland province is responsible for the project and referred the MPs to the province for answers.
For answers to the questions posed, I refer you to the province.
Voor antwoorden op de gestelde vragen verwijs ik u naar de provincie.

Two PvdA MPs asked the caretaker government whether roughly 400,000 euro of public money was spent on a glossy titled 'Gerda' honouring outgoing minister Gerda Verburg, and whether it risked looking like an election stunt. Minister Verburg answered that about 405,000 euro was spent on the anniversary publication for the ministry's 75th year, that it could not be withdrawn for non-substantive reasons, and that the name was a deliberate eye-catcher; she did not address the election-stunt concern substantively.
No, in total 405,000 euro was spent on the anniversary publication 'Gerda'.
Neen, in totaal is € 405.000 besteed aan het jubileumblad «Gerda».

An MP asks the agriculture minister about the growth of live animal transport, whether it threatens animal and public health, why the Wijffels committee's recommendations (no long transports or cattle markets by 2010) are not yet implemented, and whether Dutch law should limit transport duration. The minister acknowledges risks from long transports, says the Wijffels work is still in progress, and states that transport conditions are mainly set at EU level, so unilateral Dutch limits are not possible.
Unilaterally imposing a maximum transport duration for Dutch territory alone is not possible in the European context.
Het eenzijdig opleggen van een maximalisering van transport voor alleen Nederlands grondgebied is in Europese context niet mogelijk.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten ten aanzien van invloeden op broedvogelaantallen (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

MP Ouwehand asks the minister how she views new research on breeding bird declines, including the finding that agricultural intensification and eutrophication are major threats, the case for raising groundwater levels over individual nest protection, and whether current policy should be revised. The minister acknowledges the findings with limits, points to the Weidevogelverbond project and the subsidy scheme, says provinces are responsible for implementation and will be informed of the research, and agrees with the conclusion on species-specific management.
I will bring the insights mentioned to the attention of the provinces.
Ik zal de in het genoemde inzichten onder aandacht van de provincies brengen.

An MP asked the agriculture, nature and food quality minister whether the sale of the Biltse Duinen natural area, now split into two private estates, has cut public access and breached recreational functions, and whether more safeguards are needed for such areas. The minister replied that owners may close private land, the municipality of De Bilt is responsible for assessing the situation, the provincial supervisor found no reason to intervene under the Natuurschoonwet, and existing instruments plus tax incentives are considered sufficient.
In my view the existing instruments offer sufficient means to safeguard the recreational function of an area.
Naar mijn oordeel biedt het bestaande instrumentarium voldoende mogelijkheid om de recreatieve functie van een gebied te waarborgen.

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether the current law allows foxes to be trapped and shot at close range during pregnancy, whether those responsible for a dead fox left as a prank on Texel should be pursued, and how the perpetrators are being traced. The minister answered that foxes are on the national exemption list and may be controlled year-round including during pregnancy, that a close gunshot is considered humane, that there is no evidence foxes were released on Texel, and that there are no perpetrators in the sense of lawbreakers.
There are no indications that foxes were released on Texel.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat op Texel vossen zijn uitgezet.

MPs Schreijer-Pierik and Pieper asked whether feral domesticated greylag geese need a provincial designation to be shot, whether hybridisation with wild geese is harmful, and whether one exemption could cover all greylag geese and their variants. The minister answered that domesticated geese need a designation under Article 67 for the means of culling, that hybridisation is undesirable ecologically, that the wild population is not threatened, and that the two decisions are legally distinct so the existing legal regime will not change, with the provinces responsible for implementation.
I see insufficient reason to amend the statutory regime for this.
Ik zie onvoldoende reden om het wettelijk stelsel hiervoor aan te passen.

An MP asked the minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about 19 dead tope sharks washed ashore at Kerkwerve, including their bycatch by Dutch fishing vessels, the cause of the strandings, protection measures and implementation of the EU shark action plan. The minister replied that the find was actually fish waste (17 cod and two unidentified sharks), outlined a bycatch and discard monitoring programme, a subsidy scheme and an IMARES study, and noted lowered catch limits for several shark and ray species.

Following the EU shark action plan, I asked IMARES to write a state-of-the-art report on the condition of sharks and rays, the catches by Dutch fishers in the North Sea and possible protection measures.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van het EU-haaienactieplan, IMARES gevraagd een «state of the art»-rapport te schrijven over de toestand van de haaien en roggen.

MP Thieme asks ministers whether the broadcaster's programme giving away pets as prizes breaches the Animal Health and Welfare Act and whether the broadcaster should be held to account. The minister confirms the programme breached the prohibition on awarding animals as prizes, says the broadcaster was called to account and the programme has stopped, and states the government favours careful, non-impulsive pet acquisition.
As minister of LNV I called the broadcaster in question to account on this and asked it to take appropriate measures so the provision in the law is no longer breached.
Als minister van LNV heb ik de desbetreffende omroep hierop aangesproken en gevraagd passende maatregelen te nemen zodat de bepaling in de wet niet meer wordt overtreden.

An SP MP asks the agriculture minister about gas anaesthesia before castration of piglets, including its use, welfare effects, German practice, and whether castration should be banned. The minister refers to a recent evaluation, says pig farmers' reasons for not using gas anaesthesia are not known, points to alternatives abroad, and states an aim to end castration by 2015 without a fixed ban.
For an answer to these questions I refer to my letter on the results of gas anaesthesia castration in practice (reference AKVL2010/279).
Ik verwijs voor een antwoord op deze vragen naar mijn brief inzake de resultaten gasverdoofd castreren in de praktijk (kenmerk AKVL2010/279).

An MP asked the agriculture minister about the shooting of imported reindeer that escaped onto the A7, including whether the import, keeping and police action were lawful. The minister answered that police shot the animals for road safety, that the import papers were in order, and that no official report was needed against the owner.
Under these rules there is no prohibition on importing animals for specific purposes such as entertainment.
Er is op grond van deze regels geen verbod om dieren in te voeren voor specifieke doeleinden zoals bijvoorbeeld amusementsdoeleinden.

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether ministry official dinners and canteens should be made vegetarian for sustainability reasons. The government answered that it supports more sustainable food consumption and sustainable catering criteria but rejects mandatory vegetarian dinners or meat-free days, leaving choice to individual officials and ministers.
The suggestion to offer departmental civil servants no meat at all goes too far for the cabinet.
De suggestie om aan de departementsambtenaren helemaal geen vlees meer aan te bieden, gaat het kabinet te ver.

MPs Atsma and Jacobi asked whether the minister would support eierzoeken (egg collecting with aftercare) against It Fryske Gea's ban on it in its nature areas, and how to persuade the organisation to reverse course. The minister acknowledged the ban, respected the landowner's choice, said Gedeputeerde Staten of Fryslân decide under the Flora- en faunawet, and saw no role for herself.
It is therefore also the responsibility of the Provincial Executive to determine in which areas egg collecting, combined with aftercare, may or may not take place and under which conditions.
Het is dus ook de verantwoordelijkheid van Gedeputeerde Staten om te bepalen in welke gebieden eierzoeken, in combinatie met nazorg, wel of niet kan plaatsvinden en onder welke voorwaarden.

An MP asks the minister of Agriculture whether livestock transports under 8 hours escape vehicle inspection and temperature sensors, and whether animal welfare in cold weather and closed ventilation breaches EU Regulation 1/2005. The minister answers that short transports need no inspection or temperature registration, but vehicles must still protect animals from extreme temperatures and ventilate adequately, and enforcement will act on violations.
Under the transport regulation, all vehicles must be designed and used so that they protect animals against extreme weather conditions and extreme temperatures.
Op basis van de transportverordening dienen alle vervoermiddelen wel zodanig te worden ontworpen en gebruikt dat zij dieren beschermen tegen extreme weersomstandigheden en extreme temperaturen.
